home.captionEn: Bring our customers their drinks, Manjuus! And be careful so you don't drop them!
home.caption: 小家伙们，把这些饮料分发出去吧！注意拿稳了哦~

login.captionEn: ello there! How about a glass of delicious and nutritious carrot juice? ...Wait, stop, not that one! THIS one's for you! Phew... Disaster averted...
login.caption: 欢迎回来！来一杯营养又美味的胡萝卜汁吧！……啊，等等，拿错了！这杯才是没问题的！好险好险——

main_1.captionEn: Shaking the bottle? Pfft, that's the oldest trick in the book. I'll teach you a newer one, Commander!
main_1.caption: 摇汽水？指挥官，那已经是过时的恶作剧手法啦！我教你一些新的吧~

main_2.captionEn: Oh bollocks! It's Nelson! Quick, Commander, I need a place to hide!
main_2.caption: 呜哇，是纳尔逊妈妈！指挥官，快让我躲一下！

main_3.captionEn: You're silly, Erebus. All I asked for was a little inspiration, not the full recipe for some kind of magic potion!
main_3.caption: 黑暗界，我是想要获得一些配方上的灵感啦，不过这个配方参考……总有种女巫炼药的感觉？

touch_body.captionEn: Bottoms up, like adults do! Drink up, Mark I!
touch_body.caption: 来像大人一样地干杯吧！MarkI也一起！

home.captionEn: Bring our customers their drinks, Manjuus! And be careful so you don't drop them!
home.caption: 小家伙们，把这些饮料分发出去吧！注意拿稳了哦~

login.captionEn: ello there! How about a glass of delicious and nutritious carrot juice? ...Wait, stop, not that one! THIS one's for you! Phew... Disaster averted...
login.caption: 欢迎回来！来一杯营养又美味的胡萝卜汁吧！……啊，等等，拿错了！这杯才是没问题的！好险好险——

main_1.captionEn: Shaking the bottle? Pfft, that's the oldest trick in the book. I'll teach you a newer one, Commander!
main_1.caption: 摇汽水？指挥官，那已经是过时的恶作剧手法啦！我教你一些新的吧~

main_2.captionEn: Oh bollocks! It's Nelson! Quick, Commander, I need a place to hide!
main_2.caption: 呜哇，是纳尔逊妈妈！指挥官，快让我躲一下！

main_3.captionEn: You're silly, Erebus. All I asked for was a little inspiration, not the full recipe for some kind of magic potion!
main_3.caption: 黑暗界，我是想要获得一些配方上的灵感啦，不过这个配方参考……总有种女巫炼药的感觉？

touch_body.captionEn: Bottoms up, like adults do! Drink up, Mark I!
touch_body.caption: 来像大人一样地干杯吧！MarkI也一起！

complete.captionEn: Those girls you sent out are back? I'll whip up some drinks for them later.
complete.caption: 委托队的同伴们回来了吗？我等下准备点喝的吧。

home.captionEn: We're meant to be closed for the day, but I'm all ears if you've got any requests~
home.caption: 虽然已经打烊了，不过，如果需要什么帮助的话，和我说一声就好了~

login.captionEn: Welcome, Commander! It's kind of odd saying "welcome" when I'm lying down, but hey.
login.caption: 指挥官，欢迎光临~用这幅样子说“欢迎”总觉得很不可思议呢~

mail.captionEn: Mail always finds its way to you wherever you go, huh?
mail.caption: 总感觉指挥官在哪里，信件就会送到哪里呢~

main_1.captionEn: Taking orders, moving dishes, and cleaning tables, that's this job in a nutshell. Never gets boring as long as you do 'em in rotation!
main_1.caption: 点单、送餐、打扫……只要几样工作轮着做，就不会无聊了呢。

main_2.captionEn: Honestly, not a fan of the liquor menu. All the drinks on there make my head spin...
main_2.caption: “大人的饮料”啊……那个喝了之后，头会晕晕的，我不喜欢……

main_3.captionEn: Earlier today, I was caught gawking at my coworkers while they were mixing drinks. I was so distracted that Bismarck herself called me out for it.
main_3.caption: 今天看同伴调制饮料的时候，一不小心看入迷了……结果被俾斯麦店长提醒了才反应过来呢。

mission.captionEn: We've still got missions to do! See? You do need my help~
mission.caption: 还有任务没完成吗？指挥官果然还是需要我的帮助呢~

mission_complete.captionEn: Finished a mission, huh? I say you've earned yourself a drink.
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了吗？要不要喝点什么犒劳下自己？

touch_body.captionEn: I'm no marionette, ya hear!
touch_body.caption: 我不是洋娃娃啦~

touch_special.captionEn: This stuff won't fly during open hours, ya hear?
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，可不能在营业的时候这么做哦？

home.captionEn: Thank you for your leadership in battle, Commander. Would you like tea? Our seniors in the Dragon Empery taught me, so I hope you like it...
home.caption: 作战辛苦了，指挥官要来一杯茶吗？我和东煌的前辈们学了一下泡茶的技巧，希望你能喜欢。

login.captionEn: I must learn to be a proper model, at least until I'm worthy of this dress... Oh. Welcome back, Commander. Do you have orders for me today?
login.caption: 我得好好学习模特的技巧，至少要配得上这身漂亮的衣服呢……啊，欢迎回来指挥官~今天有什么吩咐吗？

main_1.captionEn: Feeling the nighttime breeze on the veranda, the comforting fragrance of flowers... Hm? You thought that looked good and took a picture? U-umm... Th-that's a little sudden, no? I wasn't even posing yet...
main_1.caption: 没想到像这样在阁楼上吹着晚风、闻着淡淡的花香，也很惬意呢~咦？刚刚的感觉很好所以拍下来了？欸，有点太突然啦，指挥官！我还没摆好姿势呢……！

main_2.captionEn: Relaxing walks in the forest are nice, but there's a slightly more unique vibe right here. Do you feel it, Commander?
main_2.caption: 虽然和森林浴的感觉不太一样，但是这里有一种别样的风情呢~指挥官也来这边试试吧？

main_3.captionEn: Is it easy to move in this dress? Umm... Well, I can fight and do chores just fine... Oh, shall I wear it to secretary duty tomorrow? Hm? You won't be able to focus? But why...?
main_3.caption: 是问这套礼服会不会不方便？嗯……战斗、做饭和家务的话都没什么问题呢。秘书舰的工作……不如明天就穿着这样去工作吧？欸？会让你分心？为什么？

touch_body.captionEn: Tickles a little... Do you want a photo like this, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 会有点痒……指挥官是想拍这里吗？

touch_special.captionEn: C-Commander, perhaps we should show restraint for now...
touch_special.caption: 指、指挥官，在这里姑且还是收敛点……

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back? I can't leave the pool now, so... You do the reception thing, please.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了吗？指挥官，现在的阿尔萨斯暂时无法离开水中，还请你自行……

home.captionEn: Wheeew... Okay, one needs to stay in the water to keep one's emotion module regulated. Just don't think of the Commander... Commander... Ahh... Hahh... ♡
home.caption: 呼~果然还是泡在水里，阿尔萨斯的感情模块才能平稳运行……不能再去想指挥官……指挥官……指挥官的……哈，哈……

login.captionEn: Goodness, you're panting and drenched in sweat... Did my bikini do this – making you hot and craving action in broad daylight? ...N-no, Alsace, you mustn't harbor these thoughts!
login.caption: 指挥官看起来很热的样子……难、难道说是指挥官看到了这样的阿尔萨斯要在邮轮上光天化日之下就……！不、不不行！阿、阿尔萨斯必须停止这种想法……

mail.captionEn: Your letters would just get wet if I brought them... Pl-plus, I'd make you... you know.
mail.caption: 阿尔萨斯身上的水会弄湿邮件……也会，弄湿指挥官的……没，没关系么……？

main_1.captionEn: Me, fuming even more than usual? Well, yes, because this cruise with you is just that fun... You've rendered my barely-serviceable emotion module completely nonfunctional.
main_1.caption: 阿尔萨斯和平时的感觉不太一样……？难、难道是和指挥官一起旅行太开心……感情模块的抑制功能失效了……

main_2.captionEn: You think this bikini looks cute on me? N-now you're going out of your way to make me overheat! And it's working so well it's making me all dizzy! Ahh... Give it to me already... ♡
main_2.caption: 盛夏形态的阿尔萨斯非常可爱……指、指指挥官一定是故意说这种话的吧！这个战术非常有效，阿尔萨斯现在已经被迷得神魂颠倒……哈啊……有些迫不及待了……！♡

main_3.captionEn: W-wait! My brainwave interceptor fell off... Thank you... Aahh... Am I imagining it, or is the pool heating up all of a sudden?
main_3.caption: 等、等一下！阿尔萨斯的指挥官电波遮断器又掉了！谢谢你帮我捡……哈……你、你说水温突然升高了……是什么意思……

main_4.captionEn: S-so, we're the only ones here... Try not to lose control of yourself like I do, okay? Ahh, hahh... Oh god... Just thinking about having you all to myself is making me have all kinds of wild thoughts... ♡
main_4.caption: 虽、虽然现在是和指挥官独处……但请不要像阿尔萨斯一样无法控制自己……哈、哈啊……怎、怎么办，一想到只有我们两人，阿尔萨斯就不行了……♡

mission.captionEn: Commander, there are still holy tasks awaiting you... This one's talking "like that" again? Yes. The temperature has decreased slightly in one's emotion module.
mission.caption: 指挥官，你还有任务尚未完成。口吻变了？嗯……阿尔萨斯感情模块的温度暂时降下来了。

mission_complete.captionEn: A holy task has been accomplished. One needs to get back in the pool immediately... *pant*... Before the temp gets too high...
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了，阿尔萨斯必须立刻回到水中……哈啊……温度又……

touch_body.captionEn: It doeshn't make senshe... I'm underwater, and I'm shtill sho hot...
touch_body.caption: 等、等一下……明明泡在水里为什么又感觉很燥热了……

touch_head.captionEn: A headpat? One doesn't particularly need it... W-wait, one must turn on the Commander brainwave interceptor... Aahh! Hahh... N-nooo... Don't beam me so hard! You're making me hot even in the water!
touch_head.caption: 摸头吗……阿尔萨斯倒是不介意……等、等一下，阿尔萨斯的指挥官电波遮断器掉了……！哈……哈啊……不行，被注入了指挥官电波以后就算在水里身体还是燥热起来了……

touch_special.captionEn: Ahh... Commander... I won't stop you if you wanna do it here... ♡
touch_special.caption: 哈……指挥官……阿尔萨斯在这里也可以……

complete.captionEn: Running commissions in this kind of heat is no easy feat. Let’s go properly reward our hardworking girls.
complete.caption: 这么热的天气执行委托很辛苦呢~可要好好奖励她们一下~

login.captionEn: Phew... it sure is hot during the summer. Eh? Why is your face all red? Are you having heat stroke?
login.caption: 呼呼，夏天很热呢~咦，指挥官怎么满脸通红？难道是中暑了？

main_1.captionEn: Kendo sword and sunglasses... Takao, did you really come here for vacation?
main_1.caption: 木刀、墨镜…高雄你真的是来度假的吗？

main_2.captionEn: Commander, you can join me under my parasol if you get too hot.
main_2.caption: 指挥官，热了的话我这里有阳伞哦

main_3.captionEn: Commander, want to watch me play beach volleyball?
main_3.caption: 指挥官想看我打沙滩排球吗？

touch_body.captionEn: The best type of swimsuit? Definitely a bikini. Don’t you agree, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 说到泳衣，当然就是比基尼，指挥官你也这么认为吧

touch_special.captionEn: Oh my. There may only be one Earth, but Commander certainly has two hands~.
touch_special.caption: 哎呀呀，太阳只有一个，指挥官的手却有两只呢～

home.captionEn: Commander, snack. For you.
home.caption: 指挥官，给你好吃的

login.captionEn: Commander, let's play.
login.caption: 指挥官，陪我玩

main_1.captionEn: Commander, hair bun, big... Want to touch it?
main_1.caption: 指挥官，你看，头上的球，好大，摸摸看？

main_2.captionEn: Commander, glasses, cute?
main_2.caption: 指挥官，眼镜，好看吗？

main_3.captionEn: Commander, cherry flower. Watch. (Eldridge's lock of hair is taking the form of a cherry flower petal.)
main_3.caption: 指挥官，樱花，看（埃尔德里奇的呆毛画出了一片樱花花瓣）

touch_body.captionEn: Stress...? Eldridge can't emit stress.
touch_body.caption: 电……？那是静电，我不会电指挥官

home.captionEn: Watch... Eldridge's performance?
home.caption: 要看埃尔德里奇……表演吗？

login.captionEn: Commander, Eldridge... has become a kitty...
login.caption: 指挥官，埃尔德里奇，变成喵喵了……

main_1.captionEn: Kitties... don't listen...
main_1.caption: 喵喵们，不是很听话……

main_2.captionEn: Commander... don't forget to... support Eldridge...?
main_2.caption: 指挥官，记得给埃尔德里奇应援……？

main_3.captionEn: Kitty gloves... Want to feel...?
main_3.caption: 喵喵手套……指挥官，要摸摸看……？

touch_body.captionEn: ...Commander, meow?
touch_body.caption: …指挥官，喵？

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, bad. (Eldridge flicks your forehead with her cowlick)
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，不行（埃尔德里奇用呆毛戳了戳你的头）

complete.captionEn: A commission is done. I hope you're not considering sending ME out to meet the team...
complete.caption: 委托完成了。…你不会想要我去迎接吧……

home.captionEn: I estimated you'd be back around this time, so I prepared tea and a snack. My work here is done... right?
home.caption: 算好指挥官回来的时间，把茶水和点心备上……很好，这样就没问题了，应该？

login.captionEn: You again. Ahem... Good morning, Mast– Never mind, I'm not doing it!
login.caption: 是你啊。咳、早上好，主……果然还是算了！

main_1.captionEn: Damned manjuu... You're in my way! Move! What do you think you'll achieve by being stuck under me?
main_1.caption: 这小家伙……碍着我了，闪一边去！被我压着就一点也动不了了吗？

main_2.captionEn: Would one call cleaning a part of the banquet preparations? The hall will be a mess by end of it anyway, so why bother?
main_2.caption: 扫除是宴会准备的一环？反正之后都会弄得乱七八糟的，为什么现在要……

main_3.captionEn: Damn you, August... I do NOT take kindly to being treated as a maid! ...Are you even listening?
main_3.caption: 帕塞瓦尔好像乐在其中呢……光是“被当成女仆”这事我就很不甘心！你有在听吗？

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Now go claim the rewards.
mission_complete.caption: 任务结束了。去拿你的报酬吧。

touch_body.captionEn: ...Hwuh?!
touch_body.caption: ……呜!?

touch_special.captionEn: What the–?! I'll have you know I never volunteered for this position!
touch_special.caption: ……！？早知道就不当什么女仆了！

complete.captionEn: That commission is done. Now go. Those girls deserve some appreciation for working on a holiday.
complete.caption: 委托完成了哦。去吧，别冷落了在节日还在辛苦付出的同伴们。

home.captionEn: Even lords of the sea need to rest. Why don't you sit down and enjoy the soothing aroma in the air?
home.caption: 叱咤海洋的猛兽，也有需要休息的时刻。正好屋内有静心养神的香薰，到我身边来好好坐会吧？

login.captionEn: You're back. Heheh, missed me, did you? Or are you just tired?
login.caption: 回来了？呵呵，是想我了么？还是只是单纯的累了？

main_1.captionEn: How does one hold a brush? Like this? Or like... this? Ugh... I refuse to believe you don't know the proper technique. Stop gawking and come show me!
main_1.caption: 毛笔……应该怎么握来着？这样？还是……这样？嗯……我知道你会这个，别光看着了，快来教教我！

main_2.captionEn: So that's what their dragon dance is like... When I first heard of it, I thought they would use a dragon-like rigging, similar to what we have in the Iron Blood.
main_2.caption: 原来“舞龙”是这样的啊……当初听到这个名字时，我还以为要弄一个像铁血舰装那样“龙”呢。

main_3.captionEn: Brünhilde, is this bowl an Empery antique of yours? I must admit, the workmanship is remarkable. Hmph, I suppose you do have a refined taste.
main_3.caption: 布伦希尔德，这些是你收藏的东煌古玩么。这个碗确实做工精致……你的品位还挺不错的。

mission.captionEn: All these missions leave you with no time to enjoy the holiday... That is unacceptable. Hmph, I'll assist you with them.
mission.caption: 正值佳节时，指挥官却因任务而无法抽身……这种事情我可不允许，我也来帮你一把好了。

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. You may now concentrate on celebrating.
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了，接下来就该专心享受节日了。

touch_body.captionEn: Go on a stroll together, you say? I could do that... But first, put my heels on my feet, would you?
touch_body.caption: 要出去走走吗？好啊。那就帮我把鞋子穿上吧？

touch_head.captionEn: Don't you touch my horn ornaments without my permission!
touch_head.caption: 喂，角上的挂饰不是拿来玩的！

touch_special.captionEn: Wha–?! You made me spill ink everywhere! I, I'll clean it up myself!
touch_special.caption: 等，等一下？！都怪你，墨汁沾到上面了……我，我自己擦就行了！！

home.captionEn: Hey, Commander, order a glass of OJ! ...No, it's for me! Staff can't just order drinks for themselves, y'know? That's weird.
home.caption: 指挥官，帮我点一杯柠檬汁，谢啦！…你看，我现在姑且还是店员嘛，所以自己点单不太合适吧？

login.captionEn: Welcome, Commander! Uh, watch your step!
login.caption: 指挥官，欢迎光临！还有那个…小心地滑哦！

main_1.captionEn: Turns out North Carolina is like, a bunny girl expert! I never knew that.
main_1.caption: 说起来，关于兔女郎这方面，我请教了北卡小姐哦！之前完全看不出来她是这方面的专家啊…

main_2.captionEn: No, Cooper! No adult drinks, got it? Ask the commander to order you some juice instead! Hehehe~
main_2.caption: 库珀，你还不能喝酒哦！让指挥官帮你点杯果汁吧~

main_3.captionEn: Sooo... You like bunny girls, Commander? Asking for a friend.
main_3.caption: 盯——难道指挥官的癖好是兔女郎服装？这可要记下来才行~

touch_body.captionEn: You know what, it's comfier to sit and take it easy, so I'm gonna stay put for now.
touch_body.caption: 好像就这么坐着偷会懒也不错…所以晚点再扶我起来吧~

touch_special.captionEn: Hey! You can't grope a staff member!
touch_special.caption: 对，对店员出手可是不行的！

home.captionEn: Hey, Commander, order a glass of OJ! ...No, it's for me! Staff can't just order drinks for themselves, y'know? That's weird.
home.caption: 指挥官，帮我点一杯柠檬汁，谢啦！…你看，我现在姑且还是店员嘛，所以自己点单不太合适吧？

login.captionEn: Welcome, Commander! Uh, watch your step!
login.caption: 指挥官，欢迎光临！还有那个…小心地滑哦！

main_1.captionEn: Turns out North Carolina is like, a bunny girl expert! I never knew that.
main_1.caption: 说起来，关于兔女郎这方面，我请教了北卡小姐哦！之前完全看不出来她是这方面的专家啊…

main_2.captionEn: No, Cooper! No adult drinks, got it? Ask the commander to order you some juice instead! Hehehe~
main_2.caption: 库珀，你还不能喝酒哦！让指挥官帮你点杯果汁吧~

main_3.captionEn: Sooo... You like bunny girls, Commander? Asking for a friend.
main_3.caption: 盯——难道指挥官的癖好是兔女郎服装？这可要记下来才行~

touch_body.captionEn: You know what, it's comfier to sit and take it easy, so I'm gonna stay put for now.
touch_body.caption: 好像就这么坐着偷会懒也不错…所以晚点再扶我起来吧~

touch_special.captionEn: Hey! You can't grope a staff member!
touch_special.caption: 对，对店员出手可是不行的！

home.captionEn: Hey! Welcome back, Commander! Quick, swap personas! We've got a case to do, partner!
home.caption: 哦哦！欢迎回来，指挥官！快点进入角色状态，继续我们的搭档任务吧~

login.captionEn: PhantoM has come! The treasure I'll be stealing today is your heart! How's that for giving you palpitations?
login.caption: 怪盗、参上！艾伦·萨姆纳今日要盗取的宝藏是——指挥官你的真心哦~怎么样，有动心吧？

mail.captionEn: You've got a letter, Commander! ...Come to think of it, I should send out some calling cards, too.
mail.caption: 有你的新邮件，指挥官！……啊，对了，正好趁这个时候把预告信寄出去！

main_1.captionEn: "The world-renowned phantom thief has come. The treasures I called out are now mine!" ...Yeah! I referenced some other movies and came up with this line. I'd say I nailed it!
main_1.caption: “——在下~世界第一大盗是也！预告的物品，就归我咯~”……嗯！我借鉴了一些其它电影的台词风格，现在这版听起来就很有气势呢！

main_2.captionEn: Leaving a calling card and putting your target on edge, then stealing their treasure with ease despite the high security... Now THAT'S a challenge worth taking on, heehee.
main_2.caption: 要先发出预告函，等治安者们设下天罗地网后才能出动，一举拿下目标——嘿嘿，这才是怪盗应该去挑战的、不得了的任务哦！

main_3.captionEn: A police officer and a phantom thief think and operate completely differently, but I'm the flexible type, so I can switch between the two like it's the most natural thing ever!
main_3.caption: 治安者和怪盗，是完全不同的两种生活方式呢……啊哈，不过我是更自由的那一派，所以在两者间切换也完全没有问题！

main_4.captionEn: You can change costumes from police to thief in an instant with just one easy trick. Wanna know it? I'll tell you if you're interested!
main_4.caption: 只要一点点小技巧，就可以快速完成从治安者到怪盗的变装哦~怎么样，指挥官想学的话我就教给你！

main_5.captionEn: Is there any treasure only I could steal? Shh, it's daytime, and I'm still a police officer! Let's save this convo for Miss Terious to answer later tonight! Heehee♪
main_5.caption: 有一件珍宝只有我才能拿到？哎呀，现在还是白天，我还是治安者的身份哦！珍宝的事情就留到晚上让怪盗「Mystic」来想办法吧，嘻嘻~

touch_body.captionEn: Sheesh, it's not easy playing your role, Commander. Do you need script revisions or direction? Don't be shy to ask for anything you need!
touch_body.caption: 嚯嚯，指挥官出演的角色想要演好也不容易呢。需要台词和演技方面的指导吗？别不好意思，来找我嘛来找我嘛~

touch_special.captionEn: Heheh. Who's your favorite between policewoman Allen and phantom thief Allen?
touch_special.caption: 嘿，指挥官是喜欢作为治安者的那一面……还是喜欢作为怪盗的那一面呢~？

home.captionEn: My, you're so excited, Commander♪ I knew you were looking forward to the beach~
home.caption: 指挥官斗志昂扬呢……果然也在期待着沙滩吧~

login.captionEn: Commander, don't forget to stretch before going into the ocean, okay?
login.caption: 指挥官，在下水之前，不要忘了先热身哦？

main_1.captionEn: Commander, could I ask you to apply sunscreen to my skin next time we go to the beach?
main_1.caption: 指挥官，去海边的时候，防晒油能麻烦你吗？

main_2.captionEn: Long hair is quite inconvenient when you're swimming... Which way of tying up my hair is your favorite, Commander?
main_2.caption: 到了要游泳的时候长发就显得不是很方便呢…指挥官喜欢什么样的盘发发型呢？

main_3.captionEn: Oh, Commander~ Since we're going to the beach, why not change into your swim gear ahead of time? Oh, no, I definitely don't want to see how it looks on you, not at all~
main_3.caption: 指挥官～接下来要去沙滩的话，你也先换上泳装怎么样？我不介意的哦~

touch_body.captionEn: Go on ahead without you? Why, a secretary can't just casually part from her Commander, can she? I'll be right here waiting for you♪
touch_body.caption: 我可以先去海边？真是的，身为秘书舰，怎么会丢下指挥官呢，我会等你的~

touch_special.captionEn: It seems as summer comes forth, so too does your passion~
touch_special.caption: 到了夏天，指挥官也变得热情了起来呢

home.captionEn: You know what comes next? Mhm! Tell me what's on your mind and your worries will all go away, Commander♪
home.caption: 这个时候……啊，我知道了，到了听取指挥官的烦恼，然后一鼓作气解决问题的时候了吧！

login.captionEn: "Welcome back, Master~" – Just like how all the Royal Maids do it~
login.caption: “欢迎回来，主人~”我看皇家的女仆们都是这么问好的呢～

main_1.captionEn: Wouldn't it be lovely if these stuffed toys could join me for a dance~?
main_1.caption: 兔子先生和公鸡先生，要是能随着我的舞蹈动起来就好了呢。

main_2.captionEn: I've heard people describe their dreams as astonishing or romantic. I wonder, have you had any fascinating dreams like that, Commander?
main_2.caption: 在梦里总是能见到很多奇怪而又浪漫的事情呢，指挥官，你做过什么有趣的梦吗？

main_3.captionEn: I'm more fond of imparting my passion to others through actions than through words while sitting down~
main_3.caption: 比起安静舒适地坐在一旁，我还是喜欢挥洒自己的能量，用行动把热情传递给别人~

touch_body.captionEn: Hehe~ I will perform a little number called "The Maid's Dance" for you~
touch_body.caption: 那么，就由我给指挥官献上“女仆之舞”吧~

touch_special.captionEn: This sort of lust is not what romance is about!
touch_special.caption: 这样的热情，可是不能称作是浪漫哦？

home.captionEn: You know what comes next? Mhm! Tell me what's on your mind and your worries will all go away, Commander♪
home.caption: 这个时候……啊，我知道了，到了听取指挥官的烦恼，然后一鼓作气解决问题的时候了吧！

login.captionEn: "Welcome back, Master~" – Just like how all the Royal Maids do it~
login.caption: “欢迎回来，主人~”我看皇家的女仆们都是这么问好的呢～

touch_body.caption: 那么，就由我给指挥官献上“女仆之舞”吧~

touch_special.caption: 这样的热情，可是不能称作是浪漫哦？

complete.captionEn: The errand girls have returned. Let us see what they've brought... "Well, well. These aren't half-bad spoils."
complete.caption: 夜之使者们归来了。让我看看，今日的战利品有哪些吧~「嚯，还挺丰富的嘛。」

home.captionEn: It matters not whither you flee, for you will inevitably return hither, my dear human♡ "After all, a human that's wholeheartedly submitted to Emden can never truly escape. Heehee♥"
home.caption: 无论你奔往何处，最后的终点都将是此处哦~「你的内心早就屈服了，你是无法离开我们的，不是么？」

login.captionEn: "You're late, human." How will you make recompense for the time you kept Emden waiting, hmm? My darling human♡
login.caption: 「动作有些慢了呢，人类」那么，该你用实际行动补偿这份怠慢了，我可爱的人类~

mail.captionEn: There is a letter for you. Emden shall read it first, then you may take it after, my darling human.
mail.caption: 信件啊……我可爱的人类，等我读完了，我会把它交给你的。

main_1.captionEn: Vampire hunters... A rather barbarous kind, aren't they? "They will learn who truly rules the night."
main_1.caption: “吸血鬼猎人”么……是些难缠的家伙呢。「该让她们知道，谁才是司掌这片黑夜的神了」

main_2.captionEn: You may borrow my human if you wish, Yorck. Please do keep in mind, though, that you are only BORROWING my human.
main_2.caption: 约克，我允许你把人类借走。但是，你要记住，我准许你的，只有“借”哦~

main_3.captionEn: By all means, use your holy artifacts as a means of meager resistance. "I will savor every moment as I slowly crush your rebellious spirit♥"
main_3.caption: 想用所谓的“圣物”反抗我也可以的哦~「我们不介意一次次地把你的小把戏，连同你的叛逆心一起，慢慢地碾成碎片~」

mission.captionEn: A new mission has come in. Have no fear, my darling human. The night shall show you the way.
mission.caption: 新的任务来了。不用害怕，我可爱的人类，黑夜会指引你前进的方向。

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission completed. You have done well, my darling human. You are hereby given the privilege of sharing a toast with Emden.
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了。做得不错，人类。这次，就赐予你与我共饮一杯的权利吧~

touch_body.captionEn: Embrace the night, and the night shall embrace you. "Now, are you ready to offer yourself?"
touch_body.caption: 若你能接受名为黑夜的镣铐，我便许诺你初拥之仪……「如何，考虑清楚了吗？」

touch_head.captionEn: "You have some gall, human." Emden can tolerate a dash of self-indulgence♡
touch_head.caption: 「人类，胆子挺大的嘛。」…无妨，这种程度的任性，我还是准许的~

touch_special.captionEn: Close your eyes and let Emden show you a dream. A rapturous dream wherein all is possible. "A paradise of perpetual night."
touch_special.caption: 闭上双眼吧，我会赐予你甘甜的美梦。那里，有你所期望的一切……「那里，便是永夜的乐园~」

complete.captionEn: The errand girls have returned. Let us see what they've brought... "Well, well. These aren't half-bad spoils."
complete.caption: 夜之使者们归来了。让我看看，今日的战利品有哪些吧~「嚯，还挺丰富的嘛。」

complete.captionEn: Wh-why is a commission fleet coming back now of all times? ...Commander, I'll— *hic*...! I don't think I should go like this after all...
complete.caption: 唔，在这种时候还有委托队回来么，要不要我去——哎，抱歉，现在的我好像帮不上忙……

home.captionEn: Everyone was greeting me one after another at the party, and there I was basking in their attention, so... I started toasting everyone, and... Ugh! Why am I so childish...?!
home.caption: 宴会上，大家一个接一个的向我问好，我当时想，“原来我也是这么受欢迎吗！”，一时冲动就把敬过来的酒全接下来了…咕…！还是太嫩了啊…！

login.captionEn: Sorry, Commander, but could you give me a hand? ...Ugh, why is the hem of this dress so long...
login.caption: 那个，指挥官，能扶我一下吗？谢谢。哎，为什么礼裙的拖尾要弄得那么长啊……

main_1.captionEn: I even got Mr. Eagle here all decked out~ Looks pretty sharp and spiffy, right?
main_1.caption: 我给鹰酱也准备了一套特别的礼服。你看，现在的它是不是很有管家的感觉？

main_2.captionEn: Hey... Commander, um... Yeah, so... have you ever seen Enterprise get drunk before? Ah, no, I was just asking out of curiosity... I mean, it's almost impossible to picture that happening to her, right?
main_2.caption: 请问...指挥官，那个，你有见过……企业前辈她喝醉过么？只是有点好奇哦，毕竟完全想象不出来前辈醉酒的样子……

main_3.captionEn: Commander, don't worry about me. Don't you think you should head back to the venue before the others start to wonder where you went?
main_3.caption: 啊，指挥官，我休息一会就好，不用担心我。如果指挥官离席太久的话，反而会成为被大家担心的对象吧？

mission.captionEn: We've got new work? Um, I really hope my head clears up soon... Ugh, everything's still spinning...
mission.caption: 新的任务吗？那，那我得赶快调整好状态才行——唔，脑，脑袋还是有点晕……

mission_complete.captionEn: Did the mission rewards already get here? Th-thank god...
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励收到了？那，那就好……

touch_body.captionEn: One more cup... Just one more! Commander, here! Cheers! Thanks for everything you're always doing for us. This is... a token of gratitude from me... *hic*!
touch_body.caption: 只再来一杯的话...指挥官，这一杯敬你——！指挥官平时为大家做了这么多，这算是我的一点感谢之情吧。

touch_special.captionEn: Commander! Jeez, what are you doing... Did you also have a bit too much to drink? What am I going to do...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官！你这是在干什么啊——！难，难道你也喝醉了！这，这可怎么办才好……

complete.captionEn: Com-mish-shuns... We have to wait until everyone's back, right?
complete.caption: “委托”…要等大家回来…对吧？

home.captionEn: Teacher, where are you...? I can't swim on my own... Oh! Teacher! Ehehe♪
home.caption: 老师，去哪里了…？安克雷奇，一个人，没法好好游…啊！老师！诶嘿嘿♪

login.captionEn: Mm... Um, Teacher...? Is Anchorage doing it right? Kick like this... I-I think I'm sinking again..
login.caption: 嘿咻…嗯…老师…？安克雷奇，做得好吗？蹬腿…好，好像又要掉下去了…

mail.captionEn: Don't let the mail fall in the water... Mmm... There!
mail.caption: “邮件”，不能掉到水里…嗯…做到了！

main_1.captionEn: Teacher, can you teach me even in my dreams...? Ehehe.
main_1.caption: 老师，在梦里，也会教安克雷奇很多吗…？诶嘿嘿~

main_2.captionEn: Baltimore's so good at swimming...! Can Anchorage learn to swim like that? Ehehe, if Teacher teaches me, then maybe...
main_2.caption: 巴尔的摩，好会游…！安克雷奇，能变得那么会游吗？诶嘿嘿，老师教我的话，一定…

main_3.captionEn: The shark is so slippery... I'll do my best not to fall off! Yeah!
main_3.caption: 鲨鱼，滑溜溜…安克雷奇，努力不掉下去！嗯！

touch_body.captionEn: You're all wet... Teacher, are you okay...?
touch_body.caption: 湿透了…老师，没事吗…？

touch_special.captionEn: Teacher, do you like touching...?
touch_special.caption: 摸摸…老师…喜欢？

complete.captionEn: Com-mish-shuns... We have to wait until everyone's back, right?
complete.caption: “委托”…要等大家回来…对吧？

mail.caption: “邮件”，不能掉到水里…嗯…做到了！

main_3.captionEn: The shark is so slippery... I'll do my best not to fall off! Yeah!
main_3.caption: 鲨鱼，滑溜溜…安克雷奇，努力不掉下去！嗯！

touch_body.captionEn: You're all wet... Teacher, are you okay...?
touch_body.caption: 湿透了…老师，没事吗…？

touch_special.captionEn: Teacher, do you like touching...?
touch_special.caption: 摸摸…老师…喜欢？

complete.captionEn: Anchorage didn't go on the commission trip... I want to go next time...
complete.caption: 委托……没有带安克雷奇……下次……想一起去……

home.captionEn: Teacher, welcome back... A boat ride? Just you and me...? Okay! Let's go see the moon...!
home.caption: 回来了，老师……坐船？老师和安克雷奇……一起？去看月亮……！

login.captionEn: Anchorage was so lonely waiting for you... Hug me, teacher... The moon? Wow... We're gazing at the moon together...!
login.caption: ……安克雷奇，一直在等老师……好寂寞……抱抱……月亮好漂亮……安克雷奇和老师……一起看！

mail.captionEn: Mail... It's too hard for me... You understand mail, Teacher? Wow...
mail.caption: 新邮件……好难懂……老师，能看懂……好厉害……

main_1.captionEn: The wind feels good... Teacher, do you want to try? ...Hm? This is dangerous...? Okay... Anchorage will be careful!
main_1.caption: 风，好舒服……老师……也试试？……危险？哦……安克雷奇……会注意安全！

main_2.captionEn: Teacher, look...! The moon and the lights are all bright and pretty...! Anchorage is, too...? Hehehe... Anchorage loves the moon and the lights, too! And... Teacher, too!
main_2.caption: 老师……快看！月亮和灯…都漂亮！安克雷奇也漂亮……？嘿嘿~安克雷奇，喜欢！月亮和灯……还有老师，也喜欢……

main_3.captionEn: The boat is all rocking and swaying... Spending time with you is so fun... I love it...!
main_3.caption: 船，摇摇晃晃的……站不稳……但是，和老师一起游湖……开心！喜欢！

main_4.captionEn: ...Pictures? Pose? Like this...? You think it's cute...? I do, too!
main_4.caption: ……拍照？……pose是什么……这样？……老师说好看……安克雷奇也觉得好看！

mission_complete.captionEn: The mission is complete! Teacher, can we play now...? A boat ride, and looking at the moon...? Yay...!
mission_complete.caption: 任务……完成了！老师要陪安克雷奇……？游湖！看月亮……！开心……！

touch_body.captionEn: Touch, touch... Anchorage wants to touch you, too...
touch_body.caption: 摸摸……安克雷奇也想……摸摸老师……

touch_head.captionEn: Pat pat...? That feels good... Anchorage likes it...
touch_head.caption: 摸摸头？……舒服……安克雷奇，喜欢……

touch_special.captionEn: Do you... like this, Teacher? This... "pose"? I don't get it... But if you like it, then Anchorage likes it, too!
touch_special.caption: 这里……老师会开心？pose……这样？好难懂……老师喜欢……安克雷奇也……！

home.captionEn: "H-Hiii! You want to dance with me?" ...Oh god, no, that's way too forced. I need to sound natural for– Eep! W-when'd you get here, Commander?!
home.caption: “有荣幸能邀请您共舞一曲吗？”……不对不对，太僵硬了，要再自然一点才行……欸，指，指挥官？什么时候回来的？！

login.captionEn: Oh, you can sit here if you want to, Commander. I'll just... stand here for a while and accustom myself to this look.
login.caption: 啊，指挥官要休息的话可以在这里坐会哦。我？我还是稍微站会适应一下好了…

main_1.captionEn: I should've gone with a less cumbersome outfit, shouldn't I? Maybe something like Cleveland's suit... Yeah, that would've worked...
main_1.caption: 要是能换身更便于活动的礼服就好了，嗯，就像克利夫兰那样的…

main_2.captionEn: I'll bet tons of girls want to share a drink with you tonight, right, Commander? Go on, chat with them before I get you wasted. Or you can just stay here, hahahah.
main_2.caption: 应该有不少人想在宴会上与指挥官干杯吧，可别在我找你干杯之前就倒下了哦？哈哈哈

main_3.captionEn: The mirror? It's so I can see my– Oh god!
main_3.caption: …我身后有什么东西吗？…镜子……？啊！

touch_body.captionEn: Woah?! Ah, thanks... Guess it's a real uphill battle, getting used to these high heels...
touch_body.caption: 唔哇？！…谢、谢谢，差点站不稳…看来还要花点时间习惯这高跟鞋才行…

complete.captionEn: A commission's been completed! The girls definitely deserve a li'l victory gesture.
complete.caption: 委托完成了！要为伙伴们送上胜利的祝福才行。

home.captionEn: Nice job out there! I like to think you heard me cheering for you. Hahahah! All that matters is you remember we're all waiting for you back at port.
home.caption: 出击辛苦了！我的应援也传达到了吗？哈哈，只要你能记得港区有大家在等着你就足够了。

login.captionEn: Commander, give me a "Hell yeah"! The race is about to start!
login.caption: 打起精神来，指挥官！下一场比赛快要开始了！

main_1.captionEn: Waving a flag around might look easy, but it's sweaty work... Oh, crap, sorry. I shouldn't be doing that.
main_1.caption: 就算只是应援，这样挥着旗子也会出不少汗呢。…啊，抱，抱歉。果然还是会很在意…吧？

main_2.captionEn: How about you give racing a go sometime, Commander? Don't worry about any stakes, it'd just be an exhibition race.
main_2.caption: 指挥官也参加比赛试试吗？不要紧的，模拟比赛而已，不用在意输赢~

main_3.captionEn: Fun fact: it was Bremerton who came to me for help. I know, right? Even the ever-reliable Bremerton needs a hand sometimes. I was just as surprised as you.
main_3.caption: 其实这次之所以来帮忙，是因为布莱默顿找我商量来着。“那个布莱默顿也会找人商量？”——对对，我那时也跟现在的指挥官一个表情呢~

mission.captionEn: The race– I mean, the mission's started, Commander!
mission.caption: 赛车……不对是任务开始了！指挥官！

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission rewards are in. This calls for a bottle of champagne.
mission_complete.caption: 是任务报酬哦。打开香槟庆祝吧。

touch_body.captionEn: You want me to say the line, am I right? Alright... "Hit it, Commander! Full speed! You're on the final lap!"
touch_body.caption: 啊，指挥官也想看“那个”吗？好的……“指挥官！加油！加速！最后一圈了！”

touch_head.captionEn: Ohh...
touch_head.caption: 啊…

touch_special.captionEn: Eep! D-don't touch me there...
touch_special.caption: 呀？！你，你在摸哪里……

complete.captionEn: Our commission team is back? Bring them here. I'll play a piece for you and them.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了？叫她们过来，一起听我演奏吧。

home.captionEn: Wh-wh-where did my katana go?! I can't play music like this... H-hmph! You're bold, trying to take advantage of my moment of weakness! Well, I won't fall victim to your schemes!
home.caption: 刀刀刀刀去哪了？！这下可搞不了什么音乐了……哼！居然妄想利用白龙我的弱点，真是胆大包天！不会让你得逞的！

login.captionEn: Heh, how'd you like that piece? Oh, you're so awed by my skill that you're speechless, huh? Yeah?
login.caption: 哼哼，刚才的曲子如何？嗯，无话可说么。是因为太好听连话都说不出来了吗？对吧？

main_1.captionEn: F-forget about my katana! Just focus on the song I'm playing! Got it?!
main_1.caption: 刀，刀的话无需担心！你只需要专注于我奏出的旋律！明白了吗！？

main_2.captionEn: What? I'm being too loud? Hmph, you're just as much of an unrefined ruffian as I thought. We may fight on the battlefield often, but never forget to improve your tastes!
main_2.caption: 什么？很吵？哼，你果然是个不懂风雅的粗人。就算再怎么驰骋沙场，也不能忘记磨炼高雅情操！

main_3.captionEn: Think I'd like a drink... Tch, we don't have any proper appetizers to go with booze, do we? Fine. I'm going out shopping.
main_3.caption: 真想喝一杯……啧，这里连能当做下酒菜的东西都没有吗。没办法，我出一趟门采购吧。

touch_body.captionEn: ♪~ Try and guess what song that was. ...No, it was not improvised!
touch_body.caption: ♪～猜猜这是什么曲子吧。…可不是即兴演奏！

touch_special.captionEn: My katana isn't there, either! ...That's not why you touched me?!
touch_special.caption: 刀可不在这里！…你不是来找刀的吗？！

login.captionEn: Commander, what would you say to a stroll on the beach?
login.caption: 指挥官，一起在沙滩上走走吧？

main_1.captionEn: Taking in the ocean, feeling the sea breeze, letting the sounds of the waves lap against my ears... I feel completely at peace here.
main_1.caption: 看着大海，吹着海风，听着海浪声，总觉得，整个人都平静了下来呢

main_2.captionEn: Coming to the beach with my Elders, and of course with the Commander, to spend a day off is so delightful.
main_2.caption: 能和前辈们还有指挥官一起在海边度过假日，我真是个幸福的人呢

main_3.captionEn: Commander, Elder Hermes has been talking about this "Summer Duel Tournament" that's about to begin. Why don't we go watch together?
main_3.caption: 指挥官，竞技神前辈似乎在那边举办夏日决斗大会的样子，去看看吗？

touch_body.captionEn: Commander, is this pose okay? How about my expression? Hehe, all right then, make sure you get my good side.
touch_body.caption: 指挥官，这个姿势和表情可以吗…？嘻嘻，那么请把我拍得好看些哦

home.captionEn: Houston, wait up... Sigh... How many times have I told her not to run off randomly...
home.caption: 休斯顿，等一下——哈啊，都提醒过她好多次了，不要突然就跳进泳池里……

login.captionEn: What wonderful weather to go for a swim. Mm, I'm sure everyone who's come to this pool has thought the same thing.
login.caption: 今天天气不错，很适合游泳。嗯，我觉得来泳池的大家都是这么想的呢。

main_1.captionEn: I've heard that you're the port's best-kept secret when it comes to athletic prowess. I'd like to see it for myself.
main_1.caption: 我听说指挥官是港区里深藏不露的运动高手，我想见识一下呢。

main_2.captionEn: Unlike when I'm wearing my rigging, I get to stretch my body when I go swimming. In that sense, it's a kind of relaxation, isn't it?
main_2.caption: 和穿着舰装时不同，在水里游泳时能尽情舒展自己的身体。某种意义上来说算是一种放松？

main_3.captionEn: Hornet? I've heard that she prefers the beach to the pool. You might run into her if you head on over.
main_3.caption: 你说大黄蜂吗？她好像更喜欢海那边一些。如果去沙滩上放松的话，说不定能看到她。

touch_body.captionEn: Ahahaha... I told you I'm ticklish...
touch_body.caption: 啊哈哈……都，都说了我有些怕痒了——

touch_special.captionEn: S-stop that...! *blushes*
touch_special.caption: 不，不可以——///！

complete.captionEn: Master, what do you think about handing some red envelopes to the hardworking girls still out on commissions?
complete.caption: 指挥官，给努力委托的孩子发个红包您觉得怎么样？

home.captionEn: I baked this pastry for a certain Master who is so absorbed in work to the point of forgetting to eat. Please enjoy it.
home.caption: 请用，指挥官，这是为今天仍不忘工作的您特意准备的糕点

login.captionEn: Welcome back, Master. I specially procured some different teas from the Dragon Empery. Which one would you like to try first?
login.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。我特意准备了来自东煌各地的不同茶叶哦，请问今天想要哪一种呢？

main_1.captionEn: A variety of culinary techniques and seasoning methods... the food culture of the Dragon Empery is truly eye-opening.
main_1.caption: 烹饪的手法与技巧，以及如何调味……东煌的美食文化真是令人大开眼界……

main_2.captionEn: It's customary in the Dragon Empery for everyone to get together on New Year's to have a banquet? Ahh, so many people to serve... my maid's soul is trembling!
main_2.caption: 东煌的新年习俗是大家在一起聚餐吗……呵呵，要让所有人都得到满足，女仆之魂在蠢蠢欲动呢

main_3.captionEn: Only a few girls from the Dragon Empery have joined our fleet. Because of that, I can't afford to let them feel lonely.
main_3.caption: 舰队中来自东煌的姐妹虽然只有寥寥数位，不过也正因为如此，不能让她们觉得受到冷落呢

touch_body.captionEn: Despite the fact that it is a holiday, I am still ready to sortie.
touch_body.caption: 贝尔法斯特，值此新春佳节，依然任凭差遣

touch_special.captionEn: I see, Master. The biggest drawback of this qipao is its ability to rob you of your self-control.
touch_special.caption: 看来，这件旗袍最大的缺点，是会让指挥官把持不住呢~

complete.captionEn: Maybe I should keep this outfit on and give the commission team a real surprise when they return... Hehehe~ I'm just joking.
complete.caption: 就以这身打扮去让委托组的伙伴们大吃一惊吧？呵呵，开玩笑的~

home.captionEn: Could you help out with my ribbon? It's a bit too close for my liking... Ah, thank you.
home.caption: 能帮我整理一下蝴蝶结吗？嗯，这样子距离有些近啊…啊，谢谢了。

login.captionEn: Welcome back, dear! Is there anything you need a hand with?
login.caption: 欢迎回来~有什么我能为你服务的吗？

main_1.captionEn: Whew. This feels so liberating! ...And not in any indecent sense, or anything.
main_1.caption: 呼~感觉有种让人神清气爽的开放感呢~啊，不是指那方面哦？

main_2.captionEn: Did Washington manage a proper smile today? She's got features as sharp as a knife, so it's easy to misinterpret her expression.
main_2.caption: 华盛顿有露出自然的笑容了吗？那孩子眼神有时候看起来挺凶的，很容易让人误解呢…。

main_3.captionEn: I am genuinely interested in bunny girl things, but it's quite awkward to actually tell people about them...
main_3.caption: 对兔女郎倒是确实多少有点兴趣，不过，被人请教兔女郎的事情还是有点不好意思呢…

touch_head.captionEn: It's true – you need the ears, or you can't call yourself a bunny girl. Hehehe~
touch_head.caption: 果然没有了“耳朵”就不能称作兔女郎了呢。呵呵~

touch_special.captionEn: I'll take that to mean you really like this outfit, am I right? Hehehe~
touch_special.caption: 指挥官果然很喜欢这个吧？呵呵~

complete.captionEn: Maybe I should keep this outfit on and give the commission team a real surprise when they return... Hehehe~ I'm just joking.
complete.caption: 就以这身打扮去让委托组的伙伴们大吃一惊吧？呵呵，开玩笑的~

home.captionEn: Could you help out with my ribbon? It's a bit too close for my liking... Ah, thank you.
home.caption: 能帮我整理一下蝴蝶结吗？嗯，这样子距离有些近啊…啊，谢谢了。

login.captionEn: Welcome back, dear! Is there anything you need a hand with?
login.caption: 欢迎回来~有什么我能为你服务的吗？

main_1.captionEn: Whew. This feels so liberating! ...And not in any indecent sense, or anything.
main_1.caption: 呼~感觉有种让人神清气爽的开放感呢~啊，不是指那方面哦？

main_2.captionEn: Did Washington manage a proper smile today? She's got features as sharp as a knife, so it's easy to misinterpret her expression.
main_2.caption: 华盛顿有露出自然的笑容了吗？那孩子眼神有时候看起来挺凶的，很容易让人误解呢…。

main_3.captionEn: I am genuinely interested in bunny girl things, but it's quite awkward to actually tell people about them...
main_3.caption: 对兔女郎倒是确实多少有点兴趣，不过，被人请教兔女郎的事情还是有点不好意思呢…

touch_head.captionEn: It's true – you need the ears, or you can't call yourself a bunny girl. Hehehe~
touch_head.caption: 果然没有了“耳朵”就不能称作兔女郎了呢。呵呵~

touch_special.captionEn: I'll take that to mean you really like this outfit, am I right? Hehehe~
touch_special.caption: 指挥官果然很喜欢这个吧？呵呵~

complete.captionEn: Getting tired? The commissions should be done just around this time. Shall we go to the docks to welcome them back?
complete.caption: 是不是有点累了？正好委托应该完成了，散步去港口迎接姐妹们吧

home.captionEn: Great work, Commander. Do you want a back massage?
home.caption: 指挥官辛苦了，我来给你捶捶背吧

login.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander!
login.caption: 指挥官，欢迎肥……回来！

mail.captionEn: Hey hey, you've got mail
mail.caption: 呐呐~有新邮件！

main_1.captionEn: Let's work hard for the whole day!
main_1.caption: 今天一天也好好加油吧！

main_2.captionEn: Fwa... I don't like to feel nonexistent. I'm gonna strike back~
main_2.caption: 呼啊……讨厌存在感稀薄，我要逆袭~

main_3.captionEn: I'm very lucky!
main_3.caption: 标枪可是很幸运的哦！

mission.captionEn: Commander, Commander, new missions have been issued!
mission.caption: 指挥官指挥官，新的任务下达了呢

mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, Commander! Let's go check out the rewards!
mission_complete.caption: 指挥官指挥官，快看看奖励都有什么吧？

touch_body.captionEn: Commander, I'm pumped up!
touch_body.caption: 指挥官累了吗？那就来休息下聊聊天吧~？

touch_head.captionEn: Commander, I'm feeling energetic!
touch_head.caption: 指挥官，标枪很有精神哦！

touch_special.captionEn: Kyaa~! Commander, perverted behaviour is bad!
touch_special.caption: 嘎哦——！指挥官，工口是不行的哦！

wedding.captionEn: Commander, what's wrong? Your face looks frozen... Eh? ... Wait, my heart isn't ready... what to do, what to do, my hair is messy and I haven't put on any makup or a dress... Commander, wait for me! Definitely wait for me!
wedding.caption: 指挥官，怎么了，一脸慎重的样子……欸？……等等，标枪还没有做好心理准备，怎么办怎么办，头发还有些乱，也没有打扮过……指挥官，等我一下，绝对要等我哦！

login.captionEn: Commander, you're taking too long!
login.caption: 指挥官，你好慢啦！

main_1.captionEn: Commander, the others are rushing us. Let's finish strong, so we can join them on the beach!
main_1.caption: 指挥官，那边在催我们呢，工作加油呀，我们一起去海边！

main_2.captionEn: Look at all our friends out there! Commander, if you don't mind, I'll go prepare some extra lunches!
main_2.caption: 去海边玩的姐妹们有好多呢，指挥官，不忙的话我去多做几份便当可以吗？

main_3.captionEn: Commander, let's make a bunch of unforgettable memories on the beach this year as well!
main_3.caption: 今年也在海边留下难忘的回忆吧，指挥官！

touch_body.captionEn: Commander, your hands are freezing cold! Jeez, it's payback time! Take this! And this!
touch_body.caption: 指挥官你的手好凉！看我戳回来，哎，嘿！

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, if you want to be more popular, you'll have to treat your girls better~
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，要更加珍惜女孩子，才会受欢迎哦？

complete.captionEn: Once the commission fleet has finished dropping off their supplies, let's invite them to the banquet as well.
complete.caption: 委托组把物资存放完毕后，让她们也来参加宴会吧

home.captionEn: Let us raise our glasses to the heroes who have returned from battle.
home.caption: 就用这杯红酒来慰劳从战场回来的勇士吧

login.captionEn: How's your work coming along, Commander?
login.caption: 公务都处理完成了吗，指挥官？

mail.captionEn: Even at the most lavish banquet, it is your responsibility as commander to be well-informed should the situation change.
mail.caption: 即使在最盛大的宴会中，一旦有新的情报也必须马上进入状态，这也是领导者的职责

main_1.captionEn: Commander, would you invite Tirpitz for me? Apologies, I'm... still not sure how to ask her myself.
main_1.caption: 指挥官，能帮我邀请一下提尔比茨吗？抱歉，我……不知道该怎么亲自去邀请她

main_2.captionEn: I can keep a lot of people satisfied merely by sitting here with a smile... but only because of my status as the fleet leader of the Iron Blood.
main_2.caption: 我只要像这样坐在这里，稍微露出一些笑容，很多人就会心满意足……但那只是因为我是铁血舰队的领导者

main_3.captionEn: As a leader, I must sometimes say and do things that I do not believe in. Commander, I hope you never lose sight of who you are.
main_3.caption: 作为领导者，有时候不得不说一些违心的话，做一些违心的事……指挥官，永远不要忘了自己是谁

mission.captionEn: Having unfinished work will turn even the finest wine into vinegar. Isn't that right, Commander?
mission.caption: 还有没完成的事的话，酒也会变得乏味，你说对吧，指挥官？

mission_complete.captionEn: A decoration for the banquet? Splendid work.
mission_complete.caption: 用这些来装点宴会吗，有劳了

touch_body.captionEn: A dance...? Oh, no, I wouldn't turn one down, I just haven't been asked until now...
touch_body.caption: 舞蹈……？……不，我并不是在拒绝，只是，过去从来没有人邀请过我

touch_special.captionEn: C-Commander... don't tease me like that...
touch_special.caption: 指、指挥官，不要故意逗我……

home.captionEn: Commander, don't expect me to save your life even if you're drowning~ ...Oh, Zara already taught you to swim? Hmph... Lucky you.
home.caption: 指挥官，下海了就算溺水了我也不会救你哦？…和姐姐学过游泳所以没问题？哼…让人羡慕呢

login.captionEn: I do say, if you want to watch the game from over there, don't come crying to me when you get hit by a stray ball. Got it?
login.caption: 哎呀，既然想在那观战就应该有被砸中的觉悟吧？这不是当然的吗？

main_1.captionEn: ...Isn't this swimsuit... a bit too tight...?
main_1.caption: …这泳装，好像有点太紧了…

main_2.captionEn: This obstinate starfish... C-Commander, come give me a hand here... Eek?!
main_2.caption: 这烦人的海星……指、指挥官，帮我一下……哇！？

main_3.captionEn: Littorio, how about a 2v2? Heheh, though having Veneto on your team would be too much of a handicap, so how about I lend you the commander?
main_3.caption: 利托里奥，要来2v2？哼哼，带维内托的话让我们太多了，就把指挥官借给你吧

touch_body.captionEn: What are you staring at? Hehe, spit it out already... Just what were you thinking about?
touch_body.caption: 眼睛在看着哪里呢？嘻嘻~有什么想法的话，都赶紧给我吐出来吧？

touch_special.captionEn: Jeez, Commander... I know you're the impatient type, but are you sure you want to suffer the same fate as this manjuu?
touch_special.caption: 真是的~指挥官？就算再怎么心急，你也要想想自己会不会和这小家伙走上一样的命运吧？

complete.captionEn: Here are the results from the commission... Please look over them.
complete.caption: 军事委托的成果……可以验收了。

home.captionEn: Commander, would you like something to drink...? If you don't want something alcoholic, how about some of the juice that New Jersey recommended...?
home.caption: 指挥官，要喝点什么吗？不能喝酒的话……这个新泽西推荐的果汁怎么样？

login.captionEn: Huff... I guess I'll be able to relax for the time being–– Huh? C-Commander?!
login.caption: 呼……趁空闲的时候休息一下——欸，指，指挥官？

mail.captionEn: Commander, there's new mail waiting for you. Please don't forget to read it...
mail.caption: 指挥官，新的邮件。记得看……？

main_1.captionEn: Honolulu, you don't like standing out either...? T-then, how about relaxing over here with me?
main_1.caption: 火奴鲁鲁，你也不喜欢引人注目的感觉吗……？那，要不也来这边休息下？

main_2.captionEn: I'm not very good at singing... sorry, Commander...
main_2.caption: 欸，要唱歌吗？我，我不行的啦，对不起…

main_3.captionEn: The music is a bit too loud for me...
main_3.caption: 唔……这里的音响，声音有点大……

mission.captionEn: Commander, there are still missions to finish. It'd be best to not forget about them...
mission.caption: 指挥官，还有任务哦。最好不要忘记……

mission_complete.captionEn: Umm, Commander, I reminded you earlier, but... please collect the mission rewards at some point.
mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，我想我应该提醒你……已经可以收取任务报酬了哦。

touch_body.captionEn: My handkerchief? Ah, umm, thank you...
touch_body.caption: 手帕？嗯，谢谢你……

touch_head.captionEn: Is something wrong... with my rabbit ears...?
touch_head.caption: 兔耳装饰……没有歪吧？

touch_special.captionEn: I, I don't think you should be doing this... *blush*
touch_special.caption: 这，这样不好吧……

wedding.caption: 不仅是单纯的战斗或者工作，我希望今后能在更多的地方帮上你。如果你愿意接纳这样的我的话……（深呼吸）嗯，指挥官，以后请多多指教了哦~

home.captionEn: One boba milk tea, no ice and half the sugar please! Oh wait, let me get one more for the poor Commander who's carrying my luggage!
home.caption: 我要一杯珍珠奶茶，不要冰只要一半糖！啊，帮拿东西的指挥官也加一杯！

login.captionEn: Hey Commander, on a scale from 1 to 10, how do I look today? And no wishy-washy answers like saying I look "cute" or "pretty," got it?
login.caption: 指挥官，给我今天的服装一些评价吧！先说好，想用“好看”“可爱”这种简单的词语是行不通的哦~？

main_1.captionEn: Affection's somethin' that goes up bit by bit, so don't underestimate the power of dates!
main_1.caption: 感情就是在每一次相处中一点一滴地积累的，可不要小看了每一次约会哦？

main_2.captionEn: You want a taste? Ah... No need to get all flustered about it, go ahead! Take a sip!
main_2.caption: 你也想喝珍珠奶茶？喏，喝吧！……指挥官，你的脸好像有些红呢！

main_3.captionEn: Obviously we're gonna walk all around town when we're on a date! Let's head over to that store next!
main_3.caption: 约会这种事情，自然是想走到哪就走到哪——接下来就去那家店看看吧！

touch_body.captionEn: You wanna rest up a bit more? Haha, I guess I am the one who invited you out~ Hmm, all right. Let's stay here for a bit longer.
touch_body.caption: 想多休息一会？哈哈，毕竟一直是我拉着你跑来跑去的~唔…那…要不再休息一会？

touch_special.captionEn: What's your endgame here?
touch_special.caption: 这是想干什么呢?

complete.captionEn: Commission team just got back. You know what that means: we gotta give 'em a true kung-fu hero welcome!
complete.caption: 委托组的大家回来了！作为正义的一方得去迎接大家才行！

login.captionEn: Hoo! Hi-yaaah! Whew... 'sup, Commander? Came to watch? Cool, cool. Never mind me though, check out this ballin' backdrop Akashi hooked me up with!
login.caption: 喝！哈！…呼……指挥官？你是来参观的吗？哈哈，先不说我这身，明石准备的这套布景还是挺厉害的吧？

main_1.captionEn: Have you seen Ning and Ping's mad acrobatic skills? The stuff they can do legit blows my mind...
main_1.caption: 居然能做出那么厉害的功夫动作，平海和宁海还真是厉害…

main_2.captionEn: Hi-yaaah! Oh yeah, frickin' nailed it! Aw, hang on, Juustagram DM just came in!
main_2.caption: 喝啊啊啊！好！气势出来了！唔？哇哇哇收到新消息了！

main_3.captionEn: "My final move! Spinning Bird: Thunder Whip!" ...Ow, ow, ow! Lesson learned: this move's too advanced for my lacking motor skills...
main_3.caption: “必杀！旋风腿！闪电五连鞭！”…啊，好疼！…唔，我的运动神经要做这么高难度的动作还是不太行啊…

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission donezo! Got another scene coming up, so we'd better go get those rewards now.
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成！在拍下个镜头之前把奖励给领了吧！

touch_body.captionEn: Ooh, that's good... Your muscles get real stiff after so much action.
touch_body.caption: 嗯嗯~很舒服~…做这些武打动作还是挺累人的呢…

touch_head.captionEn: I know hairbuns are cliché, but I wanted to change up my style, y'know?
touch_head.caption: 虽然包子头算是约定俗成，不过还是会想换点别的发型试试呢。

touch_special.captionEn: Heheh, you really wanna taste my kung-fu fury that badly?
touch_special.caption: 哼哼，想尝尝这种的厉害吗？

complete.captionEn: Yo, commission team is back. Let's go talk to 'em – we'll continue your consultation sesh after!
complete.caption: 委托组的大家回来了。烦恼的话等下再继续听，现在先去迎接大家吧！

home.captionEn: Hang on, I'mma go fetch the aroma lamp! Lemme know if you want a particular scent.
home.caption: 啊，我去开下香薰加湿器！要是指挥官有喜欢的香味之类的也请告诉我，不用客气的。

login.captionEn: Oh man, I feel like a million bucks in these PJs! C'mon, Commander, let's get you into some sleepwear!
login.caption: 换身衣服之后活过来了！来来，指挥官也快点换上吧~

main_1.captionEn: I call this a counseling corner, but it's really just a repurposed section of my own room. Hey, stop surveying the place!
main_1.caption: 说是烦恼咨询室，其实也就是把平时我的房间稍微装饰了下。别，别一直盯着看啦。

main_2.captionEn: You're welcome! I can't do athletic stuff like Baltimore, but counseling is a piece of cake!
main_2.caption: 不用谢哦！虽然我不像巴尔的摩那样擅长运动，但是在给建议方面不在话下的！

main_3.captionEn: Hmm... I can't decide on the last photo to post to my Juustagram... Which do ya think looks the be– Wait, that album is off limit!
main_3.caption: 嗯…上传juus的最后一张照片好难决定啊……指挥官觉得哪张比较好？啊，不是那个相册啦…！

touch_body.captionEn: Heheh, pretty comfy rug, right? Whaddya say we lie down?
touch_body.caption: 呵呵，这个地毯很舒服吧？一起躺躺看？

touch_special.captionEn: Hey, uh... Sorry, but I'm in counselor mode right now♪
touch_special.caption: 现在是烦恼咨询模式哦。不好意思啦♪

complete.captionEn: The tide tells a tale... Ah, Champion, so the commission company has returned.
complete.caption: 粼粼的波涛所传达而来的故事是……委托的伙伴们回来了，英雄大人。

home.captionEn: Tales of adventure in the briny blue... This could make for an entertaining piece, Champion.
home.caption: 深海的冒险之旅……也能写出很有意思的诗歌呢，英雄大人。

login.captionEn: Gazing from a ship's deck leaves me wanting. Just imagine the fathomless secrets that lay beneath these waves.
login.caption: 光乘船俯瞰海面的话是不够的哦。这蔚蓝的大海里，可是包含着字面意义上“无比深邃”的秘密呢。

mail.captionEn: The tide brings new mail. There... This ought to keep it dry.
mail.caption: 有新的邮件……嗯，这样一来就可以不弄湿地拆封它了。

main_1.captionEn: Champion, there is much that I wish to tell Richelieu and the others about these ruins. May I spin a hymn here and now?
main_1.caption: 也想把这片遗迹的风景告诉黎塞留她们呢～要不要试着作一首赞颂美景的赞美诗？

main_2.captionEn: An adventuring party? I would be happy to serve as your sage... Worry not. You are more than valorous enough to lead the vanguard, Champion.
main_2.caption: 冒险团吗？我的职业肯定是贤者——啊，不用担心。以英雄大人您的勇气，一定可以担当好前卫的。

main_3.captionEn: We must protect these seas, including the most dangerous places—even if they have their own faults, much like my beloved Champion. Heehee!
main_3.caption: 包含危险的地方在内，都属于我们要守护的大海。就如同您虽有一些小缺点，但也是我所喜欢的英雄大人一样哦～

mission.captionEn: Might we be blessed with a quest to delve into these ruins?
mission.caption: 有没有调查这片遗迹的任务呢？

touch_body.captionEn: How I'd love to take such pretty coral home with me, but perhaps it is best left as a memory.
touch_body.caption: 本想带一些漂亮的珊瑚回去做纪念品，不过还是作为回忆放在心里就好。

touch_special.captionEn: My, my... What's come over you?
touch_special.caption: 哎呀呀…突然怎么了？

complete.captionEn: The girls just came back from that commission! I wonder if Drake was with them?
complete.caption: 委托队回来啦！不知道德雷克有没有一起？

home.captionEn: Hey Owner, what do you think of everyone's dresses? Are there any outfits you want to see me in? ...I look gorgeous in my current one? Squeeee! I love you, Owneeeeer~♡
home.caption: 亲爱的觉得其他小伙伴们的服装怎么样呀？有没有想看柴郡穿哪套？现在这套就很棒？呀~亲爱的真是的~♡

login.captionEn: Owneeeeeer! ...Oopsies, that was improper of me! I'm dressed like a refined Dragon Empery lady, so I need to act the part!
login.caption: 亲~爱~的~！…啊，不行，柴郡现在可是东煌淑女，得再“得体”一些才行♪

main_1.captionEn: My beloved Owner~♡ Squeeze, cuddle, sniiiiff~ I love being with you so much~♡
main_1.caption: 亲·爱·的~我蹭我蹭~嘿嘿，和亲爱的在一起真开心~♡

main_2.captionEn: Sexy cleavage, trendy fashion, and obligatory kitty ears: the perfect package of cuteness~ How do you like it, Owner?
main_2.caption: 开叉很Sexy，化妆很Fashion，耳朵自然是无比Cute♪亲爱的觉得呢？

main_3.captionEn: Relax and get cozy, Owner~ Now's not the time for work, it's time to hang out with me!
main_3.caption: 亲爱的~放松放松~今天是放下工作，和柴郡一起游玩的时间哦？

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! Let's claim those rewards right meow, Owner~
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成啦！亲爱的，快确认奖励吧~♪

touch_body.captionEn: Is there something I can do for you, Owner?
touch_body.caption: 有什么想要柴郡做的事情吗？

touch_special.captionEn: I'm always okay with getting intimate with you, Owner~
touch_special.caption: 亲爱的的话，这点肌肤接触OK的♪

home.captionEn: Owner, could you lift my dress's train for me? It'll drag along the ground otherwise... Aww, thank you~♪
home.caption: 亲爱的，能帮我提下裙子吗？这段路不是很好走呢……嗯嗯，谢啦~

login.captionEn: We'd better get going soon, Owner! My horse here is starting to get restless~
login.caption: 亲爱的，我们快出发吧！这孩子已经有些按捺不住了呢~

main_1.captionEn: Think we'll meet any magical creatures out in this forest, Owner? You know... Like fairies? I once read a nursery tale about those!
main_1.caption: 你说，在森林里会不会碰到一些有趣的东西？比如说……雪之精灵之类的！童话里不就有这样的嘛~

main_2.captionEn: Owner! Lookie! I found a twelve-sided snowflake! Aww, it melted...
main_2.caption: 亲爱的，快看快看！这里有一片十二角星的雪花哦！啊，化掉了……

main_3.captionEn: Offer you my hand...? I don't get it. I'm happy just to take your hand and cuddle like we always do! Rubrub~ Squeeze~
main_3.caption: 搭手礼…是要怎么样来着？唔，感觉好麻烦。我和亲爱的还是简单随意的牵手就好啦！嘿嘿~蹭蹭~

touch_body.captionEn: Myeh-heh♪ Your eyes are just glued to me, aren't they, Owner? Ahem... "You may feast your eyes; gaze all you wish"~♪
touch_body.caption: 被柴郡迷到目不转睛了吗？嗯嗯，喜欢就多看看~

touch_special.captionEn: You're silly, Owner~ You know what I think about surprise touchies~
touch_special.caption: 呀！亲爱的怎么老喜欢偷袭啦！真是的~

home.captionEn: Owner, could you lift my dress's train for me? It'll drag along the ground otherwise... Aww, thank you~♪
home.caption: 亲爱的，能帮我提下裙子吗？这段路不是很好走呢……嗯嗯，谢啦~

login.captionEn: We'd better get going soon, Owner! My horse here is starting to get restless~
login.caption: 亲爱的，我们快出发吧！这孩子已经有些按捺不住了呢~

main_1.caption: 你说，在森林里会不会碰到一些有趣的东西？比如说……雪之精灵之类的！童话里不就有这样的嘛~

main_2.captionEn: Owner! Lookie! I found a twelve-sided snowflake! Aww, it melted...
main_2.caption: 亲爱的，快看快看！这里有一片十二角星的雪花哦！啊，化掉了……

main_3.captionEn: Offer you my hand...? I don't get it. I'm happy just to take your hand and cuddle like we always do! Rubrub~ Squeeze~
main_3.caption: 搭手礼…是要怎么样来着？唔，感觉好麻烦。我和亲爱的还是简单随意的牵手就好啦！嘿嘿~蹭蹭~

touch_body.captionEn: Myeh-heh♪ Your eyes are just glued to me, aren't they, Owner? Ahem... "You may feast your eyes; gaze all you wish"~♪
touch_body.caption: 被柴郡迷到目不转睛了吗？嗯嗯，喜欢就多看看~

touch_special.captionEn: You're silly, Owner~ You know what I think about surprise touchies~
touch_special.caption: 呀！亲爱的怎么老喜欢偷袭啦！真是的~

complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned...? Excellent. You may go now.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了…？嗯，做的很好，你们可以去休息了~

home.captionEn: A toast to your splendid victory, Commander... Hehe~
home.caption: 这一杯，庆祝指挥官的胜利…呵呵呵

login.captionEn: Commander, are you enjoying Akagi's banquet? If it is entertainment you desire... Ehehe. You can ask me for anything, you know?
login.caption: 指挥官，赤城的宴会如何？如果想看点余兴节目的话…呵呵呵，请不要客气，尽管吩咐赤城就好~

main_1.captionEn: What's the matter, Commander? Hehe, worry not. Kaga will eliminate any pests that seek to squirm into our banquet tonight~
main_1.caption: 指挥官怎么了？呵呵呵，什么都不用担心哦。为了今天的宴会，我已经让加贺把碍事的全部排除掉了呢~

main_2.captionEn: Oh, would you look who showed up... Do remember to be on your best behavior tonight, 5th~ Car~ Div~♪
main_2.caption: 哎呀，还以为是谁呢…宴会场合注意点，可别失了礼数哦，五・航・战♪

main_3.captionEn: Hiryuu, you're going to get tired from sitting in a kneeling position all night... As the Commander is perfectly relaxed here, you should also do likewise and enjoy yourself~
main_3.caption: 飞龙，一直正坐着会累的呢…指挥官也放松点，今天可以不用那么拘谨哦~

mission_complete.captionEn: This reward... shall serve as an exquisite dessert to the banquet~
mission_complete.caption: 奖励……作为宴会的下酒菜而言十分丰厚了呢~

touch_body.captionEn: Let us partake of each other's drink, Commander~
touch_body.caption: 来喝交杯酒吧，指挥官~

touch_special.captionEn: Ah, Commander... Ahahaha~♡
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……呵呵呵♡

complete.captionEn: Tooooot! The commission team has come back, Commander! ... No surprise: this tuba's reminding potential is totally next-level♪
complete.caption: 指挥官，委托组回来了哦~嗯嗯，用大号提醒的效果真不错

home.captionEn: Did my pre-sortie motivational song serve you well, Commander?
home.caption: 指挥官，出发前我吹的出征曲有没有派上用场呀？

login.captionEn: My marching solo will wake you up, Commander!
login.caption: 指挥官，让我来给你提提神吧！

main_1.captionEn: Let me play you a motivational song, Commander! Tooooot! ... Wh-what? That's annoying...? Sorry!
main_1.caption: 指挥官，我来为你加油鼓劲吧……欸，太吵了吗？对不起~

main_2.captionEn: You should learn an instrument so we can play a song together, Commander!
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你也去学个乐器我们一起来演奏嘛~

main_3.captionEn: Oh yeah, what do you think about my dress, Commander? Does it suit me? I absolutely adore it, it's all fluffy and stuff!
main_3.caption: 话说，指挥官，你觉得我穿洋装合适吗？轻飘飘的我很喜欢呢

touch_body.captionEn: Do you wanna hear a song, Commander? You got it! Manjuus, you all ready to go?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官，想要听演奏吗？好呀，蛮啾们，准备好了吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Whuah! ... Don't expect me to feel bad if I smack you with this thing, Commander!
touch_special.caption: 呀！……指挥官，大号砸到你我可不管哦

complete.captionEn: Looks like the commission team's back. Are you really gonna go alone?
complete.caption: 委托组好像回来了。指挥官一个人能应付得过来吗？

home.captionEn: Welcome back with aaa... big splash! Heehee~ Get wet from head to toe!
home.caption: 欢迎回来，然后……哗啦哗啦～！诶嘿嘿，指挥官浑身湿透吧！

login.captionEn: Why don't you snap another? Oh, oh my~ You'll do it because you wanna, and not because I told you to?
login.caption: 再来一张怎么样？啊呀，我不是说了么～不是初月想被拍，而是指挥官想拍初月才对～

main_1.captionEn: (Aaand set on home screen♪ Now the Commander will see my adorable swimsuit forever and ever♡)
main_1.caption: （把这张照片设为指挥官的屏保♪～好啦指挥官，就一辈子看着初月可爱的装扮吧♡）

main_2.captionEn: Hmph. Why are you looking at other girls? I'm not saying you can't, I just want you to look at ME right now.
main_2.caption: 唔……盯着别的同伴看了？倒不是说不可以，但现在希望你只看着初月哦。

main_3.captionEn: Silly Wakatsuki, if you wanna have fun, just change into a swimsuit and jump into the pool... Although, it's too late to nab the Commander now – I have exclusive dibs♪
main_3.caption: 若月也真是的，既然想玩就换上泳装一起进泳池不就好了……算了，都这时候了，就算她过来，指挥官也已经是初月的了，才不会让给她♪

touch_body.captionEn: Ahahah! Are you teasing me back now?
touch_body.caption: 哈哈哈哈！真是的，指挥官怎么也来恶作剧了？

touch_head.captionEn: Heeheehee♪
touch_head.caption: 嘻嘻♪

touch_special.captionEn: I know I can't do anything about it... Still, I'm sorry they're not bigger...
touch_special.caption: 就算你说不用在意……抱歉哦？毕竟没什么分量……

home.captionEn: My Commander, let me clean up the few remaining insects troubling you.
home.caption: 指挥官大人，要是还有害虫没有清理干净，就让大凤去吧

login.captionEn: I've been waiting for you, my Commander.
login.caption: 指挥官大人，大凤一直在等着您哦

main_1.captionEn: My Commander, you just stole a glance at another girl, didn't you?
main_1.caption: 指挥官大人，您刚才看了别的人一眼，对吧？

main_2.captionEn: My Commander, if I were to drink a little too much, do you think you could take me home?
main_2.caption: 指挥官大人，大凤要是醉了的话，就要麻烦您把大凤送回去了呢

main_3.captionEn: My Commander, it's safe for you to attack me when no one's around~
main_3.caption: 指挥官大人，没有人的时候，突然袭击大凤也是可以的哦~

touch_body.captionEn: My Commander, how would you like to go for a stroll somewhere private?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官大人，和大凤两个人去僻静无人的地方走走吧？

touch_special.captionEn: Yesss, that's it, my Commander, give all your love and attention to Taihou alone...
touch_special.caption: 这样就对了，指挥官大人，您只需要关注大凤一个人……

home.caption: 指挥官大人，要是还有害虫没有清理干净，就让大凤去吧

main_3.caption: 指挥官大人，没有人的时候，突然袭击大凤也是可以的哦~

touch_special.caption: 这样就对了，指挥官大人，您只需要关注大凤一个人……

home.captionEn: Club... activities? How could I let such insignificant matters get in the way of our precious time together, my Commander?
home.caption: 社团活动…吗？怎么能让这些杂事妨碍了放学后和指挥官大人共处的时间呢…您说是吧，指挥官大人？

login.captionEn: My Commander, would you like to go somewhere with Taihou? An after-school date, perhaps~♡
login.caption: 呵呵，正好也放学了，要不要和大凤去哪里逛逛呀？放学后的约会哦，指挥官♡

main_1.captionEn: My Commander, whatever your heart desires, no matter what it is, Taihou shall grant it to you~♡
main_1.caption: 只要指挥官希望，无论怎样的“课外活动”，大凤都会奉陪到底的~

main_2.captionEn: What am I writing about in my notebook...? You, of course~♡ Hehe, do you want to take a look?
main_2.caption: 笔记本上记着什么…？当然是关于指挥官的……呼呼呼，您想要看看吗，指挥官？

main_3.captionEn: A-A-A-Albacore?! ...D-don't scare me like that, my Commander. I'm telling you, that girl can pop out from just about anywhere...
main_3.caption: 大大大大青花鱼！？！！不、不要吓人啦，指挥官大人…虽然总觉得她随时有可能从不知道哪里冒出来……

touch_body.captionEn: Want a feel, Commander? ––Then, here you go~ The little kitty, or Taihou? Take your pick, hehe~♡
touch_body.caption: 指挥官大人想要摸摸吗？——无论是大凤还是小猫咪都可以随您喜欢哟？嘻嘻……

touch_special.captionEn: Taihou belongs to you, mind, body, and soul~ Heheh... Here, put your hands on me as you please~♡
touch_special.caption: 大凤的一切都是属于指挥官大人的，所以…请您自由地——

home.captionEn: I offer you a song of joy ♡ my Commander ♪
home.caption: 让我为您弹奏一首欢乐的乐曲吧，指挥官大人

login.captionEn: My Commander, do tell me what song I might serenade you with?
login.caption: 指挥官大人，您想要听什么样的曲子呢？

main_1.captionEn: For you, my Commander, I could face any challenge...! Oh, but that little gremlin from the Eagle Union... something must be done...
main_1.caption: 只要是为了指挥官大人，无论是什么样的挑战，大凤都会积极去尝试的…！啊，白鹰的话……只、只要绕开那个捣蛋鬼…

main_2.captionEn: If I can only keep my Commander's gaze fixed on me for just a little bit longer, all my efforts will have paid off~
main_2.caption: 呼呼…只要指挥官大人的视线能在大凤身上多停留一会，大凤的努力就有价值了~

main_3.captionEn: If only I could become like the women in those stories... those Empyreal romances Master Yat Sen spoke of~
main_3.caption: 从逸仙师父那里，大凤听说了许多东煌历史上动人的爱情传说…真想成为那些故事里的女主角呢~

touch_body.captionEn: Did you enjoy my performance...? Oh, my Commander~ My efforts, seeking out Master Yat Sen, the study, the practice, all that hard work... it was truly worth it~!
touch_body.caption: 您喜欢大凤的曲子吗？呵呵，这样的话，拜在逸仙师父门下，从容姿到琴技，这一番苦功就没有白费了呢

complete.captionEn: Another commission is done. You don't have to lift a finger, my Commander; leave it to me.
complete.caption: 委托结束了。指挥官大人什么都不用做，交给大凤就好♪

home.captionEn: Heehee, we're all alone again... I'm like putty in your hands right now, my Commander... Hahaha! Come right out and say anything you want to me.
home.caption: 呵呵，又和大凤二人独处了…仿佛大凤的全部都在指挥官大人的掌心之中——呵呵，指挥官大人，请将一切都毫无保留地告诉大凤吧♥

login.captionEn: You and I, walking on the beach together... I'm so happy that you're here with me, my Commander! Do you feel the same way?♥
login.caption: 大凤和指挥官两个人，在白沙滩上漫步…指挥官大人能在大凤身边，太令人开心了~指挥官大人也这么觉得对吧♥

mail.captionEn: You have new mail. Heehee, does it smell like me...?
mail.caption: 新邮件来了。呵呵，有大凤的味道吗…？

main_1.captionEn: This shirt? Actually, I snuck into your room and... Hm? I didn't say a thing♪
main_1.caption: 你说衬衫吗？其实是偷偷从指挥官大人的卧室里……嗯？大凤什么都没说哦♪

main_2.captionEn: You'd like to lie next to me and listen to the ocean? O-okay! If that's what you want, then I'll stay as long as you'd like... *blushes*
main_2.caption: 想和大凤一起躺下来听大海的声音吗？好，好的！如果指挥官大人如此希望的话，大凤会一直待在您身旁的…///

main_3.captionEn: I'd love to just get washed away to a deserted island with you... No, this is your home. Even I understand that much.
main_3.caption: 不如就这样和指挥官大人漂流到孤岛好了…不，这里才是指挥官大人该在的地方，即使是大凤也是明白这点的。

touch_body.captionEn: Be careful not to catch a cold? Aww, my Commander, you're too sweet~♥
touch_body.caption: 小心感冒…？指挥官大人～♡

touch_special.captionEn: Come, my Commander...♥
touch_special.caption: 来吧…指挥官大人♡

home.captionEn: Outstanding work! I will provide tonight's entertainment act! As soon as I come up with something entertaining... Hmm...
home.caption: 指挥官辛苦了！想看岛风的表演吗？什么都可以哦~如果岛风能做到的话…嗯…

login.captionEn: I'm positively brimming with energy! Tonight, let us "party hard," Commander!
login.caption: 今天也是干劲十足呢！指挥官，一起好好享受吧！

main_1.captionEn: Abukuma invited me to go fishing with her! So, I'm going out to meet– Y-you think it's best if I change clothes first?
main_1.caption: 阿武隈邀请我一起去钓鱼！我现在就去……这、这个打扮太显眼了吗？

main_2.captionEn: Suruga! You should try a bunny girl costume too! ...Y-you wouldn't be caught dead in one? Isn't that a little extreme, even for an aversion?!
main_2.caption: 骏河也试穿一下兔女郎吧？就、就算死也不穿？这么严重吗！？

main_3.captionEn: These frills fit around my ears perfectly! Which is good, because I'd become lethargic if they were too tight...
main_3.caption: 耳罩的松紧度正好呢！再紧一点的话…感觉就会没力气了…

touch_body.captionEn: Would you like a refill, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官，要再来一杯吗？

touch_special.captionEn: There being no danger of skirt-flipping doesn't make this tolerable behavior!
touch_special.caption: 即便不用担心衣服被掀起来也…啊真是的！

complete.captionEn: The commission team has come back! But as it stands now, we can't meet them!
complete.caption: 委托组回来了！不能再这样下去了！

home.captionEn: Ah, Commander! Heehee~ I stumbled across this delicious tea just earlier! Join me on a break and we'll drink it together!
home.caption: 啊，指挥官！诶嘿嘿，这是岛风刚才发现的很好喝的茶哦！一起稍作休息吧！

login.captionEn: After much thinking, I've realized that I'm not Alice, but rather the White Rabbit! So isn't it weird that I'm lost in here?
login.caption: 仔细想想，岛风不是爱丽丝而是怀表兔呢！会迷路误入这里不是很奇怪吗？？

main_1.captionEn: Whoa! There's cake over there! Heehee... No, Commander! Finding the exit comes first, like I told you before!
main_1.caption: 哦哦！在那样的地方竟然有蛋糕！诶嘿嘿……哎呀不行指挥官！已经说了现在重要的是从这里出去—！

main_2.captionEn: If Suruga was here, how would she... Wait, COULD Suruga even find a way out of this place? Because I am completely out of ideas!
main_2.caption: 要是骏河在这里……奇怪？如果是骏河会怎么出去呢？岛风，完全想不到呢！

main_3.captionEn: There's the exit! Watch, I'm going to make a mad dash for– Owie! Th-this is just a dang mirror!
main_3.caption: 出口在那边是吧！好的岛风会尽全力……啊好疼！这，这不是镜子么！

mission.captionEn: Laffey could find a way out if she were here... Whoa! Word of a new mission just came in!
mission.caption: 换做拉菲的话，应付场合应该没问题吧……啊！来新任务了！

touch_body.captionEn: Mhm! Allow me to show you the right path to your destination!
touch_body.caption: 嗯嗯，岛风会带你走向正确的方向哦——

touch_special.captionEn: At least it's not my... No, ears or not, it's embarrassing when you touch me like that!
touch_special.caption: 只要不是耳朵……就算不是耳朵也很害羞啦！真是的！

complete.captionEn: The commission team has come back! But as it stands now, we can't meet them!
complete.caption: 委托组回来了！不能再这样下去了！

home.captionEn: Ah, Commander! Heehee~ I stumbled across this delicious tea just earlier! Join me on a break and we'll drink it together!
home.caption: 啊，指挥官！诶嘿嘿，这是岛风刚才发现的很好喝的茶哦！一起稍作休息吧！

login.caption: 仔细想想，岛风不是爱丽丝而是怀表兔呢！会迷路误入这里不是很奇怪吗？？

main_1.caption: 哦哦！在那样的地方竟然有蛋糕！诶嘿嘿……哎呀不行指挥官！已经说了现在重要的是从这里出去—！

main_2.captionEn: If Suruga was here, how would she... Wait, COULD Suruga even find a way out of this place? Because I am completely out of ideas!
main_2.caption: 要是骏河在这里……奇怪？如果是骏河会怎么出去呢？岛风，完全想不到呢！

main_3.caption: 出口在那边是吧！好的岛风会尽全力……啊好疼！这，这不是镜子么！

mission.captionEn: Laffey could find a way out if she were here... Whoa! Word of a new mission just came in!
mission.caption: 换做拉菲的话，应付场合应该没问题吧……啊！来新任务了！

touch_body.captionEn: Mhm! Allow me to show you the right path to your destination!
touch_body.caption: 嗯嗯，岛风会带你走向正确的方向哦——

touch_special.captionEn: At least it's not my... No, ears or not, it's embarrassing when you touch me like that!
touch_special.caption: 只要不是耳朵……就算不是耳朵也很害羞啦！真是的！

home.captionEn: "Back so soon? You're not as weak as I thought." I'm afraid I cannot serve refreshments while I'm in roleplay mode. My apologies.
home.caption: “这么快就回来了？看来你的实力还过得去嘛。”——在这个模式下，我暂时无法为您送上茶点，抱歉。

login.captionEn: "You didn't just set up a save point here, did you?" Was that good, Commander?
login.caption: “你这家伙，是在这里设置了存档点吗？”——这样的口吻如何呢，指挥官？

main_1.captionEn: I've prepared a new mask based on this setting. Behold this expression, a mixture of coldness and contempt... This is the fruit of my efforts.
main_1.caption: 基于本次的游戏设定……我采取了和平时不同的模式。您看，像现在这种冰冷中又夹杂着一丝轻蔑的表情，就是练习的成果。

main_2.captionEn: Roleplay mode engaged. "Don't press your luck! The very thought that you can defeat me... Wait! Wh-what was that technique?! N-no, stooop!"
main_2.caption: 角色扮演模式——ON。“真是狂妄！你有自信能战胜……等等！什、什么啊！这些都是什么招数……！别，别这样……！”

main_3.captionEn: Correct. You must defeat me to proceed in this scenario. ...Hm? Why are you shaking your head? You don't want to hurt me?
main_3.caption: 没错，在本次的设定中，只要打倒我，您就可以继续通行。嗯？为什么您要摇头呢？…不想伤害我？

main_4.captionEn: Left, right, left, right, B, A, B, A... I heard this is a secret way to win. Commander, would you like to try it?
main_4.caption: 左右左右，BABA。——据说这样就可以快速通关，您要试试看吗？

mission.captionEn: "A request with a reward... Hmph. Do you mean to say that this is worthy of a greater demon's attention?"
mission.caption: “你的赏金任务……啧，竟然要我这个高等魔族来提醒你完成吗？”

mission_complete.captionEn: "You made money off of quests? Good. Use it to buy donuts and pay tribute to me!"
mission_complete.caption: “这些赏金任务的报酬……就都拿去买甜甜圈，然后进贡给我吧！”

touch_body.captionEn: "It's too late to apologise now!" Mm... It lacks energy, doesn't it?
touch_body.caption: “如果是想求饶的话，现在已经晚了。”——啧，感觉气势还不够呢。

touch_head.captionEn: "The insolence! A mere adventurer, laying hands on me?!" I see... This is how you want me to treat you?
touch_head.caption: “放肆……！区区冒险者而已，竟敢触碰我！”——原来如此，您想尝试的是这种口味呢。

touch_special.captionEn: "Heheheh... Can I take this as a sign of surrender?"
touch_special.caption: “……呵呵，这是向我臣服的信号吗？”

home.captionEn: What's with that lax expression of yours as soon as you get back... Ho ho, do you need your master to "tighten up" those loose morals of yours?
home.caption: 一回来就露出松懈的神情呢，哼哼，要不要让身为主人的我帮你「绷紧」一下神经？

login.captionEn: Way! Too! Slow! Are you trying to get my pristine skin sunburnt?
login.caption: 太！慢！了！想害我的皮肤被太阳晒伤吗！

main_1.captionEn: Plebeian, fetch those two towels over there and wipe my body dry.
main_1.caption: 仆人，帮我拿两条毛巾过来擦擦身子！

main_2.captionEn: If your eyes wander any lower, they will get detached from their sockets. I say, there is no remedy for being uncultured swine~
main_2.caption: 眼睛再瞪下去就要掉出来了哦？真是…无可救药的低等动物呢～

main_3.captionEn: A lifebuoy? What would I use that for? Plebeian, were you not going to carry me on your back while swimming?
main_3.caption: 救生圈？要那个干什么，难道不是仆人你背着我游泳吗？

touch_body.captionEn: To think that a plebeian would look at me with such a hungry, bestial expression. A lewd beast like this needs a thorough flogging.
touch_body.caption: 露出了野兽一般的表情呢，仆人。对于这样的野兽，果然还是需要更多的鞭笞吧～

touch_special.captionEn: Ho ho, it looks like this lowly swine cannot even control its basest desires.
touch_special.caption: 哼哼，果然是无法控制自己欲望的低等动物呢

home.captionEn: There's no need to be in a hurry, okay? Unicorn will always wait for you, big brother.
home.caption: 不用那么急也没关系哦？独角兽会一直等着哥哥的

login.captionEn: Big brother, there are a lot of rides that Unicorn wants to go on, together.
login.caption: 哥哥，独角兽有好多…想和哥哥一起玩的项目

main_1.captionEn: Big brother, when we're riding the roller coaster, is it okay to hold your hand?
main_1.caption: 哥哥…坐过山车的时候，能握着你的手吗？

main_2.captionEn: Ferris wheel... recommended for couples, eh? Ah, b-big brother! It's nothing...!
main_2.caption: 摩天轮…推荐情侣共乘…诶，啊，哥哥。没、没什么…！

main_3.captionEn: The carousel... it's so pretty... Huh? Big brother, I can... sit with you?
main_3.caption: 旋转木马…好漂亮…诶？可以和哥哥一起…坐吗？

mission.captionEn: Big brother, if you have some important business, you can go ahead and take care of that first... Unicorn will be waiting for big brother, always...
mission.caption: 哥哥，有重要的事的话，先去也没关系哦…？独角兽，会等着哥哥的…

touch_body.captionEn: Big brother, being able to spend time together at an amusement park... and hold hands like this... makes it seem like we're lovers, ehehe...
touch_body.caption: 像这样…在游乐园和哥哥手牵手，总觉得…就像恋人一样呢，嘻嘻……

touch_special.captionEn: B-big brother... there are a lot of people here...
touch_special.caption: 哥、哥哥，这里人有点多…

home.captionEn: I'm a little nervous, but... with you by my side, Big Brother, I know I can do it...
home.caption: 虽然还是有点紧张…不过，哥哥在的话，独角兽，就觉得安心许多…

login.captionEn: You came to watch me practice, Big Brother...? I'm so glad!
login.caption: 哥哥…来看独角兽练习了吗？嘻嘻，有点高兴…

main_1.captionEn: I hope my song gets through to everyone...
main_1.caption: 独角兽的歌…要是能传达给每一个人就好了呢~

main_2.captionEn: I'm like... an angel? That's, a b-bit much...
main_2.caption: 独角兽，就像天使一样？…呜…有、有点不好意思……

main_3.captionEn: Yuni will stay with me, right? Take the mic for me... Thank you, Yuni♪
main_3.caption: 优酱也一直陪在独角兽身边呢，还会帮独角兽拿话筒…嘻嘻，谢谢你，优酱…

touch_body.captionEn: You're the only audience I need, Big Brother! I'll... always sing my best for you!
touch_body.caption: 只要还有哥哥这个听众，独角兽就会一直…一直努力唱下去！

home.captionEn: Commander, would you like some ice cream? I brought several different flavors of syrup.
home.caption: 指挥官想吃冰淇淋吗？有很多口味可以选哟

login.captionEn: Commander, are you done changing into your swimwear~?
login.caption: 指挥官，泳装换好了么~？

main_1.captionEn: Ice-cream based desserts are delicious, but they melt too easily... I might have to bring a cooler with me next time...
main_1.caption: 冰淇淋做的甜品虽然好吃，但是太容易化了……看来要随身带个冰箱了

main_2.captionEn: It's been a long time since I last was able to enjoy scenery like this without any worries...
main_2.caption: 像这样优哉游哉地坐在沙滩上看风景，感觉是很久没有过的体验了呢…

main_3.captionEn: Commander, are you done changing? The others are calling for us, let's go play with them!
main_3.caption: 指挥官，泳装换好了吗，妹妹们在招呼我们呢，一起过去玩一会儿吧

touch_body.captionEn: Want to try gazing into the ocean horizon together? It always puts my mind at ease.
touch_body.caption: 指挥官要来一起看大海吗，心情会变得平静哦

home.captionEn: The commander's out there working hard, but here I am... Zzz...
home.caption: 指挥官在努力工作，我却在偷懒…呼呼呼…

login.captionEn: Commander... Ice creammm...
login.caption: 指挥官，冰淇淋……

main_1.captionEn: Too bad you can't turn into an air conditioner, Commander... Otherwise, I'd cling to you all day... Zzzzzz...
main_1.caption: 指挥官为什么不能变成空调呢，那样我一定会对指挥官……Zzzzz

main_2.captionEn: In any case, Le Malin will now go take a most elegant nap. Don't bother me even if there's something that needs doing... and save me some Cola and snacks... Zzzzzz...
main_2.caption: 呼啊……指挥官，我要睡午觉了，不准吵我，有任务也不要叫我……可乐不要喝完哦，还有薯片……唔……

main_3.captionEn: Who's that over there? ...Le Terrible?! C-c-c-commander! Hide me! If that girl finds me, I'm not gonna be able to sleep the day away!
main_3.caption: 那边的难道是……可怖！？指挥官，快让我躲一下，被那个家伙找到我一天的睡觉计划就泡汤了！

mission.captionEn: A new mission? Don't wanna... Th-there's ice cream in it for me? F-fine, I'll do it!
mission.caption: 任务？不去……有冰淇淋？我去！

touch_body.captionEn: Swim? Hehehe, not to brag or anything, but I'll show you the most elegant way to float!
touch_body.caption: 游泳？指挥官，不是我自夸，我就给你表演一个随波漂浮吧

touch_special.captionEn: I'm too slovenly...? Meh, haven't you already known that for ages~?
touch_special.caption: 太邋遢了？……唔，反正指挥官早就知道了……

home.captionEn: The commander's out there working hard, but here I am... Zzz...
home.caption: 指挥官在努力工作，我却在偷懒…呼呼呼…

login.captionEn: Commander... Ice creammm...
login.caption: 指挥官，冰淇淋……
