main_1.caption: 指挥官为什么不能变成空调呢，那样我一定会对指挥官……Zzzzz

main_2.captionEn: In any case, Le Malin will now go take a most elegant nap. Don't bother me even if there's something that needs doing... and save me some Cola and snacks... Zzzzzz...
main_2.caption: 呼啊……指挥官，我要睡午觉了，不准吵我，有任务也不要叫我……可乐不要喝完哦，还有薯片……唔……

main_3.captionEn: Who's that over there? ...Le Terrible?! C-c-c-commander! Hide me! If that girl finds me, I'm not gonna be able to sleep the day away!
main_3.caption: 那边的难道是……可怖！？指挥官，快让我躲一下，被那个家伙找到我一天的睡觉计划就泡汤了！

mission.captionEn: A new mission? Don't wanna... Th-there's ice cream in it for me? F-fine, I'll do it!
mission.caption: 任务？不去……有冰淇淋？我去！

touch_body.captionEn: Swim? Hehehe, not to brag or anything, but I'll show you the most elegant way to float!
touch_body.caption: 游泳？指挥官，不是我自夸，我就给你表演一个随波漂浮吧

touch_special.captionEn: I'm too slovenly...? Meh, haven't you already known that for ages~?
touch_special.caption: 太邋遢了？……唔，反正指挥官早就知道了……

complete.captionEn: The commission fleet's back? Y'know, I don't think I should be going outside, looking like this and all... So, you can go by yourself, Commander!
complete.caption: 迎接委托的同伴？你看，我都穿成这样了，再让我去是不是有点…所以，你一个人去就好了！

home.captionEn: Today's "scheduled break time" is still in effect for a few more hours. In other words... Please do it yourself.
home.caption: 我今天的“计划休息时间”还差几个小时，所以…请自便…

login.captionEn: Welcome back. Sure, let's keep it casual... I don't care either way, hehe...
login.caption: 你来了啊，指挥官。嗯…随意就好…我就不招待了…

main_1.captionEn: Le Triomphant is looking for me? Y-you're just trying to scare me! I d-don't believe that at all!
main_1.caption: 凯旋来找我了？哼，反正肯定又是吓唬人的吧，我才不信。

main_2.captionEn: This outfit is great for rolling around on the comfy couch... It'd be a waste to not take a nap... Zzzzz...
main_2.caption: 舒服的新睡衣，还有舒服的沙发，不用来睡觉就太不划算了…Zzzzz

main_3.captionEn: It's time for a lunch break! ...What do you mean there's still more work to do? Let's just push it back to tomorrow...
main_3.caption: 差不多到午休的时间了吧…唔，还有工作吗？能不能放到明天再做呀…

touch_body.captionEn: Huh...? Do you need something...?
touch_body.caption: 唔…有什么事吗…？

touch_special.captionEn: Gwaaah?! Wh-where do you think you're touching! That scared me...
touch_special.caption: 哇！别乱碰啦，吓我一跳……

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back. Hmm... I wonder what they brought.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了，嗯……都有什么奖励呢……

home.captionEn: Master, welcome back. You may choose: piping-hot tea, or a shoulder massage? ...You don't need anything? O-okay, well, we could always just chat...
home.caption: 主人，欢迎回来。想先品尝热茶，还是试试放松的按摩？……唔，要是什么都不想做的话，让风云陪您聊天也是可以的。

login.captionEn: Welcome back, Master. I brought you hot tea. ...You saw pretty flowers in the garden? I-I raised them in my spare time, so... I'm glad you like them.
login.caption: 欢迎回来，主人，热茶已经准备好了。唔…庭院里有很漂亮的花朵？是闲暇时间打理的，主人喜欢就最好了……

mail.captionEn: I put your mail right here, Master.
mail.caption: 寄给主人的信，风云放在这里了。

main_1.captionEn: Yep. I've been waiting here. ...For whom? Come on, you know... Don't tease me!
main_1.caption: 嗯，风云一直在门前等待着呢……在等谁？主人明知故问，真狡猾。

main_2.captionEn: Master, sit down. Here's your tea! ...You feel warm and happy after drinking it? Th-thank you...
main_2.caption: 主人，请坐下吧，你的热茶我已经泡好了。……品尝起来像是轻拂的暖风？谢、谢谢主人的夸奖……

main_3.captionEn: Play a song alongside the wind chimes...? Th-that may be hard... But if you want to hear it, then I'll try. D-don't make fun of me, though!
main_3.caption: 与风铃共奏一曲？嗯……有些困难呢。如果主人想听的话，我会试试的……唔，不准取笑我哦。

mission.captionEn: Missions... We'll do them together, Master!
mission.caption: 任务……嗯，风云会和主人一起解决的。

touch_body.captionEn: Master, if you ever get lonely, just let me know. I know just what to do about it... Heehee, I think you and I are thinking the same thing.
touch_body.caption: 主人，要是感到孤单寂寞了，要把想法率直地说出来哦，这样风云才知道该怎么做……嘿嘿，原来主人的想法和风云一样呢。

touch_special.captionEn: Master, t-today is a good day, if you know... what I mean...
touch_special.caption: 今、今天可以哦，主人……

home.captionEn: Did your operation go well? Oh, and don't worry, I completed all my office work while you were away♪
home.caption: 指挥官大人，作战顺利吗？放心吧，你不在期间的文书工作，戈里齐亚已经都处理好了♪

login.captionEn: (Working late into the night while my beloved boss just... Gosh, enough of that! I need to finish my tasks quickly so I can chat with the Commander!)
login.caption: （持续到深夜的工作，身为帅气的上司的指挥官大人，还有——不能再这样下去了。戈里齐亚，要快点收拾好跟指挥官大人搭话才行…！）

mail.captionEn: That sound again... Must be a new message.
mail.caption: 这声音……好像收到新邮件了。

main_1.captionEn: (I think I've put on weight again... Why did I bluff about it and let Zara pick a size that's too small for me...)
main_1.caption: （难、难道最近又胖了……呜呜，当初让扎拉量尺寸的时候，就不该掩饰着往小的报……）

main_2.captionEn: Once I wrap this task up, I'm going to muster my courage and ask out the Comma– Huh? You're working overtime today?
main_2.caption: 再过一会就下班了，今天一定要邀请指挥官大人——诶？今天要加班吗？

main_3.captionEn: It's just me and the Commander now... If it wasn't for these damn stockings I could try to make a move... *sigh*...
main_3.caption: 和指挥官大人独处……要不是这双袜子碍事，就能和指挥官大人营造出好氛围…呜呜…

touch_body.captionEn: Y-you'll show me how it's done? ...Hm? On the contrary; you need my help?
touch_body.caption: 要，要教我工作…？嗯？其实是想让我帮忙？

touch_special.captionEn: Y-you like this kind of stuff? I... I'm so done with you, perv!
touch_special.caption: 喜，喜欢这种实在是……我不管了啦！变态！

home.captionEn: You say you see ghosts and goblins all around me? ... I think you need a break. Getting into the Halloween spirit is all well and good, but you can't overdo it.
home.caption: 如果你能够看到我身边的鬼魂的话——那代表你需要休息了。节日的狂欢虽然不错，可别兴奋过度了。

login.captionEn: At first I was too embarrassed to wear something like this, but I went along with it and after wearing it for a while, I must say I'm starting to see things in a different light...
login.caption: 一开始还觉得挺害羞的，一旦习惯了就…嗯…总觉得这套衣服穿久了，就会产生和平时不太一样的心境…

main_1.captionEn: If only my sister were here... Now if we had some sort of pumpkin-smashing gunnery competition, that would have gotten her attention.
main_1.caption: 要是姐姐也能一起参加就好了。如果万圣节有个用主炮击碎南瓜的比赛或者活动之类的，她大概才会有兴趣吧

main_2.captionEn: This holiday certainly is well suited to us "Ugly Sisters," isn't it?
main_2.caption: “丑陋的姐妹”…不觉得跟这个节日特别搭配吗？

main_3.captionEn: My tail? Oh it just came with the costume... Still, I'd prefer if you didn't touch it.
main_3.caption: “尾巴”？那只是衣服自带的装饰而已…不过，还请不要随意碰触

touch_body.captionEn: While I haven't prepared any candy, I do have a "treat" for you to enjoy. Would you like to try? I'm afraid there may be some pain involved... Hehehe...
touch_body.caption: 呼呼…虽然我没有准备糖果，不过倒是可以给指挥官一点别的“甜头”…指挥官想要试试看吗？虽然可能会带着些许的痛楚就是了~

touch_special.captionEn: Eek?! Commander, does someone want to be "punished?"
touch_special.caption: 呀啊…！？指挥官…是想要被惩罚了吗！？

home.captionEn: Aren'tcha happy you get to see me perform the moment you come back? I know you are! So forget all your troubles and be happy♪
home.caption: 一回来就能看到我的舞台表演很幸福吧？肯定很幸福啦！很幸福的话就不要去考虑那些复杂的事情啦♪

login.captionEn: Guam here, wishing you a good evening from the stage! Did you not realize how late it is, Commander? Ahah☆ I'm joking, I'm joking – it's all just visual effects♪
login.caption: 这里是关岛，从舞台上向大家问候，晚上好～！指挥官，都已经到晚上了，你没注意到时间吗？啊哈☆只是舞台效果而已，我是开玩笑的啦♪

main_1.captionEn: Don't I look better than Dandy Siego with this fit on? Ahah☆
main_1.caption: 穿着这身打扮，看起来比圣地亚哥前辈还要闪亮吗？啊哈☆

main_2.captionEn: Whoa... This bunny idol thing is popping off! I need to thank Laffey for the idea later!
main_2.caption: 哇哦……兔兔偶像……很不错呢！之后要去向拉菲她们道谢！

main_3.captionEn: "Where are you looking? I'm right over here~" Ahahah! Stop looking away, Commander~
main_3.caption: “在看哪儿~我在这里哦~♪”——啊哈哈，指挥官又移开视线了～

touch_body.captionEn: Yeah, Commander! I love you! Now say "I love you too," loud and clear!
touch_body.caption: 没错！指挥官！我最喜欢你了！接下来要轮到指挥官表白爱意了哦~！

touch_special.captionEn: Save it for AFTER the show, okay? Ahahah♪
touch_special.caption: 这种事要之后才能做哦？啊哈哈♪

home.captionEn: Commander, don't let your guard down... Huh? I'm the one who looks more vulnerable right now?!
home.caption: 指挥官，不能大意…我、我看起来更毫无防备？！

login.captionEn: Commander, the glory of... the glory of the Royal Navy will...! F-forget it!
login.caption: 指挥官，皇家的光荣……光荣会……！没、没什么……！

mail.captionEn: The hot water is over here... Oh, the mail! Um... I'm so sorry, I could've sworn the mail was right there...
mail.caption: 热水的话在这里…邮件！邮件的话…非常抱歉，忘记告诉您了，邮件在那边……

main_1.captionEn: Are you talking about Ark Royal...? Do you not think that it is appropriate for us adults to monitor the growth of our Destroyer sisters, even off the battlefield?
main_1.caption: 皇家方舟小姐怎么了吗？除了战斗之外，我们去关心驱逐妹妹们，守护她们的成长，不是分内之事吗？

main_2.captionEn: I bought this outfit because I thought it looked gorgeous, but... then this happened... Wh-what do you mean I can just leave it like this?
main_2.caption: 原本是觉得好看才买的这件衣服，没想到会变成这样…欸？就、就这么穿着也没问题吗？

main_3.captionEn: The scent of plums wafting upon the evening breeze is so calming... Oh no, I still have to finish my secretary duties!
main_3.caption: 夜晚的微风捎来红梅的清香，让人不禁放松了下来……啊，不行得先把这份光荣的秘书舰工作做好才行。

touch_body.captionEn: You don't want me catching a cold, is it? I appreciate your concern.
touch_body.caption: 小心感冒？谢谢您的关心

touch_special.captionEn: B-but, the glory of the Royal Navy... (blushes)
touch_special.caption: 皇、皇家的光荣是……///

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back. No, it wasn't my SG that told me, but a friend. As for who... that's a secret.
complete.caption: 委托组的大家已经回来了。不，不是SG告诉我的，是同伴告诉我的。至于是谁…是秘密哦。

home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. If you, uh, have a moment, we could go for a swim... I know you just got back from the ocean, but... still?
home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。那个，如果你有空的话，我们要不去游一会儿…啊，刚从海边回来，又邀请你去海边…没关系吗？

login.captionEn: Whew... This breeze is lovely... Hey, Commander, for just a brief moment, I was thinking I could... be more daring around you...
login.caption: 呼…风吹得真舒服。指挥官，一小会儿…就一小会儿，我想在你面前……变得大胆一点……

mail.captionEn: A letter has arrived. Do you want to read it now?
mail.caption: 有新邮件。指挥官，要现在查看吗？

main_1.captionEn: SG, track the Commander's exact location. If we meet before I've mentally prepared myself for it, I might just freak out...
main_1.caption: SG，要时刻掌握指挥官的位置。要是在这副打扮下毫无防备地遇见指挥官的话，我会不知所措的……

main_2.captionEn: I like "you're pretty" over "you're cute" as a compliment... Oh, that doesn't mean you can't say I'm cute or anything... It's obviously up to you to decide how to compliment me, Commander, you can even use both, so... *whimper*...
main_2.caption: 如果指挥官能夸我漂亮而不是可爱，那就……啊，并不是说可爱不好，而是…当，当然，怎么夸都是指挥官的自由，两边都夸也…啊呜…

main_3.captionEn: Just tell me if anything feels wrong. It's my... No, it's all our job to ensure you don't have anything to worry about.
main_3.caption: 如果有什么事，请随时告诉我哦。以免让指挥官不安，我……不，我们在此都是为了这个目的。

mission.captionEn: Commander, please go complete your missions. Don't worry, I'll be here waiting for you.
mission.caption: 指挥官，请先去完成任务吧，我会等你的。

mission_complete.captionEn: You really are incredible, Commander.
mission_complete.caption: 指挥官真厉害呢。

touch_body.captionEn: Mhm, I'm all ears. What is it, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 嗯，海伦娜听着呢。指挥官，怎么了？

touch_head.captionEn: Heehee... *blushes*
touch_head.caption: 呵呵///

touch_special.captionEn: Umm, I... *blushes*
touch_special.caption: 嗯，嗯……////

login.captionEn: Morning, Commander! You here today for a swim, or to check girls out? Hahaha!
login.caption: 指挥官早啊！今天是来游泳，还是来看女孩子的？哈哈哈

main_1.captionEn: Can rabbits swim, or can they not? I wonder if... Wait, why am I letting this question distract me?
main_1.caption: 兔子到底是会游泳呢，还是不会游泳呢…啊我在纠结这个干什么！

main_2.captionEn: Eisen, stop it! That's my swimsuit lace, you can't pull on... Oh gosh! Don't look, Commander!
main_2.caption: 小铁，停！那是泳装的带子不能咬……呜哇哇指挥官不要看！！

main_3.captionEn: Thanks for keeping an eye on everyone, Béarn! You're doing good work!
main_3.caption: 贝亚恩，谢谢你帮忙巡视啦！我也要加油了呢！

touch_body.captionEn: You want me to swim with you? Hahaha~ Sure thing!
touch_body.caption: 想一起游泳吗？好啊好啊~

home.captionEn: What's wrong, Commander? Are you still preoccupied with work?
home.caption: 怎么了，指挥官？还在想着假期前的事情吗？

login.captionEn: I didn't think this swimsuit stood out, so I was surprised when you still found me right away...
login.caption: 我还以为这身泳装不怎么显眼，没想到指挥官却一下子就找到我了…

mail.captionEn: It's the mail? Don't tell me our vacation is over already...
mail.caption: 邮件？该不会是假期要提前结束了……

main_1.captionEn: The sea is a tempestuous battlefield, and yet the beach is a relaxing Eden. What an incredible duality.
main_1.caption: 海上是波涛汹涌的战场，海滩却是安详美好的乐园，真是神奇呢。

main_2.captionEn: Beach volleyball? I've heard it's quite fun. Do you think I could give it a try?
main_2.caption: 沙滩排球？听起来很有趣，我也能试试看吗？

main_3.captionEn: The sand is so soft, so fine. It feels so pleasant between my toes...
main_3.caption: 海滩上的沙子软软的，细细的，踩在上面感觉很舒服呢……

touch_body.captionEn: Are you tired, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官，累了吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, the others are still here.
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，大家好像都在这边呢。

home.captionEn: I've prepared a cool, refreshing drink for you. Please enjoy.
home.caption: 我为了今天特意准备了清凉的饮料哦，请喝吧~

login.captionEn: Commander, please leave work at the office, and relax to your heart's content today.
login.caption: 今天不用考虑工作的事，好好放松吧，指挥官。

main_1.captionEn: These waves feel so nice~ Why don't you dip your feet in too, Commander? ...Hm? A big wave is... Eek!
main_1.caption: 海浪冲在脚上的感觉真舒服呢，指挥官也可以来试一下…欸，好大的浪…呀啊！

main_2.captionEn: Overexposure to the sun isn't good for your skin. Why don't we move somewhere else in a little bit?
main_2.caption: 长时间被阳光照射其实对身体不好哦，再玩一会就换个地方吧。

main_3.captionEn: A nap? Y-yes! Please take your time and relax to your heart's content. If something happens, hm... don't worry, I'll make sure you wake up when that happens.
main_3.caption: 你要睡一会儿吗？没关系，安心地睡吧，我会在合适的时候把你叫醒的。

touch_body.captionEn: Wow, the sea is so pretty~ ...Hmm? I'm even prettier than the sea...? Jeez, Commander... Don't get all sappy on me now.
touch_body.caption: 大海真漂亮呢…欸…？我更漂亮？真是的，我可不吃这一套哦，指挥官。

home.captionEn: Commander, please wait there for a moment. I'm examining someone else right now...
home.caption: 指挥官，稍等一会哦，我先给这孩子做个检查…

login.captionEn: Hm? Commander, what brings you back here...? Umm, are you here to be... inspected?
login.caption: 指挥官，你怎么又来了，啊，是来…视察的吗？

main_1.captionEn: Gosh, Commander... If you pretend to be sick, even I'm going to get mad at you!
main_1.caption: 指挥官，装病的话我可是会生气的哦？

main_2.captionEn: Commander, don't you think this dress is a bit too small for me...? Um... I just feel like it doesn't fit me...
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你不觉得这件衣服稍微有些小吗…唔唔，我穿的稍微有些不习惯呢…

main_3.captionEn: Commander, please make sure that you pay attention to your own health. After all, I can't attend to you around the clock.
main_3.caption: 指挥官，平时不注意作息健康是很容易得病的哦，就算是我，也不可能每时每刻在你身边呢

touch_body.captionEn: Commander, let me perform an examination on you. Please come here and lie down on your side.
touch_body.caption: 指挥官，来这边躺下吧，我先为您做一些检查

touch_special.captionEn: Are we... playing doctor?
touch_special.caption: 指挥官…想当医生吗？

home.captionEn: Ooooooh! Brilliant! Perfect! – Ahem! Erm, well, that's right! This is just your average, everyday record keeping here. I'm not doing anything weird at all! No siree!
home.caption: 哦哦，太棒了，这张简直完美！——咳咳，刚刚……没错！刚刚只是例行记录而已，本人绝对没有做奇怪的事情！

login.captionEn: Commander, status report: all quiet over here.
login.caption: 指挥官，目前会场状况一切正常！

main_1.captionEn: This camera is strictly for security recording purposes. You never know what might happen. Of course, I could also use it to record some tender moments.
main_1.caption: 这个相机是专门用来记录可能出现的突发状况的。当然，本人也会用它留下一些晚会的精彩瞬间。

main_2.captionEn: Are you cold, Commander? You can have my jacket.
main_2.caption: 指挥官，觉得冷的话，需要本人把外套借给你吗？

main_3.captionEn: This party is so noisy, so rowdy. It's my responsibility to take watch over those sweet, innocent, little destroyer girls!
main_3.caption: 晚会会场嘈杂纷乱，本人有义务保证每个驱逐妹妹的安全！

touch_body.captionEn: Oh, don't worry about me. While everyone else sinks into the enrapturing atmosphere of the evening, someone has to stay sober and alert.
touch_body.caption: 不必担心本人。在大家沉浸于晚会的美好之时，需要有一个人保持冷静的头脑。

touch_special.captionEn: You want to dance with me? But, Commander, this... isn't this a little out of the ordinary?
touch_special.caption: 你是想邀请本人跳舞吗？但，但是，等等，这，这有点奇怪吧？

home.captionEn: C-Commander, umm, do you wanna take a cold shower...?
home.caption: 指、指挥官，要来冲个凉吗

main_1.captionEn: *Gasp*! Where the heck is all this water coming from?!
main_1.caption: 呜呜呜这水到底从哪里喷出来的啦！！

main_2.captionEn: Commander, you don't sound convincing at all when you tell me my swimsuit is cute while you're laughing!
main_2.caption: 指挥官，一边笑一边说“泳装真好看”这种话一点说服力都没有好吗！

main_3.captionEn: *Sob*... Everyone's going to laugh at me...
main_3.caption: 呜……去沙滩的时候要被大家笑死了……

touch_body.captionEn: You called over Helena?! This is NOT the way I want to make her laugh!
touch_body.caption: 再坚持一下你叫了海伦娜过来？我不需要用这种方法逗她笑啦！

touch_special.captionEn: How could you, Commander... I'll hose you till you're as soaked as I am!
touch_special.caption: 指挥官你死定了……给我也变成落汤鸡吧！

home.captionEn: Do you want this...? Here, take it...
home.caption: 指挥官也想要这个…？给、给你吧

login.captionEn: I'll say this now: I don't like festivals in any... Ah, you know what, never mind! Just come with me, okay?!
login.caption: 事先声明，我、我可不是因为喜欢祭典才……啊啊啊，算了！指挥官，和我一起逛啦！

main_1.captionEn: Stupid Louis... She just went "I'd rather not be kicked by a horse" and walked off... Let's just forget about her... Commander, do you want... some fried squid?
main_1.caption: 路易斯那个家伙，说什么“那我就不当电灯泡了”就不知道去哪了……哼，不管她了，指挥官，你在看什么呢，吃不吃烤鱿鱼？

main_2.captionEn: Y-you saw how flustered I was just now, didn't you... I don't hate you or anything like that, you know...
main_2.caption: 我说过，我不是讨厌你才对你摆脸色的。现在，你总该相信了吧？不过，突然被看到这一面，果然……还是有些尴尬

main_3.captionEn: Goldfish scooping is pretty hard... Could you lend me a hand, Commander? I want one to give to Helena...!
main_3.caption: 可恶，这些金鱼怎么这么难捞……指挥官，来帮我一下，我想捞几条金鱼送给海伦娜

touch_body.captionEn: Seems there'll be a fireworks display by the harbor... Commander, how about we go there on our walk?
touch_body.caption: 港口那边好像很适合看烟花，指挥官，我们散步过去吧？

touch_special.captionEn: Don't make excuses... I know you did that on purpose...!
touch_special.caption: 虽然人是很多，但别以为我不知道你是故意的…

home.captionEn: Trick or treat! ...Only kids go trick-or-treating? Who cares! Shut up and gimme candy!
home.caption: trick or treat！…只有小孩子才说这个？我不管，快把糖果给我！

login.captionEn: You're back? Thought up a good spooky trick yet?
login.caption: 终于来了？想要怎么出去吓人了吗？

main_1.captionEn: Uhh, Commander? If you're just gonna sit around, then I'll find someone else to hang out with.
main_1.caption: 指挥官，再发呆下去，我就自己去找其他小伙伴玩了哦？

main_2.captionEn: Let's see what candy we're giving out! Hmm... You mind settin' this, this, and some of this aside just for me?
main_2.caption: 万圣节要给孩子们发糖吗？唔…能不能把这几个口味的留点给我？

main_3.captionEn: Putting on a costume and scaring people sounds pretty fun... So that's what Halloween's all about, huh? Makes my costume choice seem kinda out-of-place though...
main_3.caption: 扮鬼吓人好像挺有趣的欸，这就是万圣节的乐趣吗~？…唔？这一身并不吓人？

touch_body.captionEn: Am I supposed to go "meeoow?"
touch_body.caption: 喵~…是不是这样叫一声更有猫的感觉？

touch_special.captionEn: This lingerie won't stop me from gettin' my hands dirty if I need to, y'know.
touch_special.caption: 虽然打扮成这样，但我本职工作的手腕可没落下哦？

home.captionEn: Trick or treat! ...Only kids go trick-or-treating? Who cares! Shut up and gimme candy!
home.caption: trick or treat！…只有小孩子才说这个？我不管，快把糖果给我！

login.captionEn: You're back? Thought up a good spooky trick yet?
login.caption: 终于来了？想要怎么出去吓人了吗？

main_1.caption: 指挥官，再发呆下去，我就自己去找其他小伙伴玩了哦？

main_2.captionEn: Let's see what candy we're giving out! Hmm... You mind settin' this, this, and some of this aside just for me?
main_2.caption: 万圣节要给孩子们发糖吗？唔…能不能把这几个口味的留点给我？

main_3.captionEn: Putting on a costume and scaring people sounds pretty fun... So that's what Halloween's all about, huh? Makes my costume choice seem kinda out-of-place though...
main_3.caption: 扮鬼吓人好像挺有趣的欸，这就是万圣节的乐趣吗~？…唔？这一身并不吓人？

touch_body.caption: 喵~…是不是这样叫一声更有猫的感觉？

touch_special.captionEn: This lingerie won't stop me from gettin' my hands dirty if I need to, y'know.
touch_special.caption: 虽然打扮成这样，但我本职工作的手腕可没落下哦？

home.captionEn: You can feel the festival spirit everywhere you look! Isn't that nice?
home.caption: 节日的氛围真浓厚啊！你觉得呢？

login.captionEn: You're leaving me out in the dust here, Commander! I'll die from sheer boredom if you won't hang out with me!
login.caption: 指挥官，你晾着我很久了！再这么下去，我会无聊到发霉的！

main_1.captionEn: Got any red envelopes for me, Commander? Talk about lame, there's just money inside... I expected something that's like, more novel, and now I'm disappointed!
main_1.caption: 指挥官，“红包”准备好了吗？诶~里面装的是压岁钱啊……好无聊，我还以为会是什么特别的小物件呢！

main_2.captionEn: Get together with the extended family over New Year's, hang up fai chun decorations, aaand... what's left? Courtesy calls? Take me along, Commander! I won't embarrass you, pinky promise!
main_2.caption: 团圆饭、守岁、春联……按照东煌的风俗，还有“拜年”吧？出发吧指挥官，带我出门是绝对不会让你丢脸的！

main_3.captionEn: I know! Let's meet up and do festive stuff with Dunkerque!
main_3.caption: 指挥官，和敦刻尔克她们一起庆祝节日吧！

touch_body.captionEn: What's up? You thinkin' about finally introducing me to your family?
touch_body.caption: 嗯？要把我正式介绍给家人好友吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Watch it, or you'll make it come off!
touch_special.caption: 这里不是能解开的地方啦！

home.captionEn: I've kept the fresh milk in the fridge back there. After you've finished bathing, please feel free to help yourself~
home.caption: 今天的牛奶和冰箱我都搬到那边了哦。总结完之后就在这里好好泡个澡舒服一下吧～

login.captionEn: Commander, are you enjoying the water? Yes, I love the hot springs here~
login.caption: 指挥官泡的舒服吗？我很喜欢这温泉哦

mail.captionEn: By the way, Commander, there was a letter for you... Sorry, I forgot to report it earlier...
mail.caption: 说起来，刚才好像看到一封给指挥官的信……不好意思，忘了给您报告了……

main_1.captionEn: Phew... That feels so good... My shoulders aren't stiff anymore~ Commander, thank you for telling me about this place~
main_1.caption: 呼……肩膀也不酸了，真舒服～谢谢指挥官告诉我这么好的地方～

main_2.captionEn: M-my swimsuit, um... Commander's going to see... Erm, please disregard that!
main_2.caption: 泳装是那、那个……能让指挥官……呜，说不出来啦……

main_3.captionEn: A nice bottle of milk after a refreshing soak really hits the spot~ Let's get another bottle later~♪ ...Um, I knocked the first one over when I slipped earlier...
main_3.caption: 洗完澡果然要喝牛奶呢～一会再来一瓶……第、第一瓶刚才摔倒的时候不小心洒掉了……

touch_body.captionEn: Shall I... wash your back for you?
touch_body.caption: 要我给您冲冲背吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Th-they're pretty heavy, right...?
touch_special.caption: 果、果然很重吧……

home.captionEn: I've kept the fresh milk in the fridge back there. After you've finished bathing, please feel free to help yourself~
home.caption: 今天的牛奶和冰箱我都搬到那边了哦。总结完之后就在这里好好泡个澡舒服一下吧～

login.captionEn: Commander, are you enjoying the water? Yes, I love the hot springs here~
login.caption: 指挥官泡的舒服吗？我很喜欢这温泉哦

mail.captionEn: By the way, Commander, there was a letter for you... Sorry, I forgot to report it earlier...
mail.caption: 说起来，刚才好像看到一封给指挥官的信……不好意思，忘了给您报告了……

main_1.captionEn: Phew... That feels so good... My shoulders aren't stiff anymore~ Commander, thank you for telling me about this place~
main_1.caption: 呼……肩膀也不酸了，真舒服～谢谢指挥官告诉我这么好的地方～

main_2.captionEn: M-my swimsuit, um... Commander's going to see... Erm, please disregard that!
main_2.caption: 泳装是那、那个……能让指挥官……呜，说不出来啦……

main_3.captionEn: A nice bottle of milk after a refreshing soak really hits the spot~ Let's get another bottle later~♪ ...Um, I knocked the first one over when I slipped earlier...
main_3.caption: 洗完澡果然要喝牛奶呢～一会再来一瓶……第、第一瓶刚才摔倒的时候不小心洒掉了……

touch_body.captionEn: Shall I... wash your back for you?
touch_body.caption: 要我给您冲冲背吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Th-they're pretty heavy, right...?
touch_special.caption: 果、果然很重吧……

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back! Uh, umm... I can't exactly greet them like this, can I...?
complete.caption: 好像委托组回来了！那，那个…我这副样子可不好去迎接……对吧…？

home.captionEn: Nnngh! Haah, haah... I just can't get out. They said this store was built well, but this isn't especially reassuring, is it...?
home.caption: 唔唔——哈，哈…果然出不来…虽然听说了这家店的设施很正宗，不过这种时候还是很为难的…

login.captionEn: Commander, if there's anything I can help you with—Oh. Erm, maybe I'm the one who needs help...
login.caption: 指挥官，要是有什么我能帮上忙的——啊，现，现在与其说我来帮忙更希望能帮我一把……

mail.captionEn: Hnnngh... Mail's here! I had to struggle to pick that one up!
mail.caption: 唔嗯，这是邮件。我努力捡起来了♪

main_1.captionEn: How did this happen, you say? Well, um... I'm not too sure, myself. You say this doesn't normally happen? Ooh...
main_1.caption: 你说为什么变成这样？即使你这么说……我其实也搞不懂…一般情况下不会变成这样吗？呜呜……

main_2.captionEn: The ingredients are on the shelves, and the snacks are in the fridge. There's cold milk in there, too, so feel free to help yourself.
main_2.caption: 资料放在架子上，慰问品放到冰箱里了。还有冰好的牛奶可供饮用哦。

main_3.captionEn: Honestly, it's really hard to maintain this posture. Umm, b-because they're really heavy... *blush*
main_3.caption: 这个姿势真的挺累的……嗯，因，因为挺沉的…////

mission.captionEn: W-we've been issued a new mission! Commander, let us check at once!
mission.caption: 是，是任务发布的联络！指挥官，快确认吧！

touch_body.captionEn: Commander?! P-please don't pull on the door right now, or... Hyah?!
touch_body.caption: 指挥官！？现、现在不要拉门……呀？！

touch_head.captionEn: Oh, I... c-can't get out this way, either...
touch_head.caption: 这，这个方向我也是出不来的…///

touch_special.captionEn: Ah, watch your step... (BANG!) Hyah?! C-Commander?!
touch_special.caption: 啊，请小心脚下…（咚）呀？！…指，指挥官？！

complete.captionEn: It looks like the commission team has returned. Umm... May I call them over for a rehearsal...?
complete.caption: 委托组好像回来了。那个…可以叫那些孩子们来一起排练吗…？

home.captionEn: ♪~ Sit the body in my lap, hold the neck with my left hand, the bachi in my right... Hm? Commander? Is something about me bothering you?
home.caption: ♪～把太鼓放在大腿上，左手按弦，右手拿拨子……嗯？指挥官？樫野怎么了吗？

login.captionEn: ♪~ How did you like my performance, Commander? Hehehe, I somehow feel like I'm both making progress and hitting a plateau... What exactly am I doing wrong?
login.caption: ♪～樫野的演奏如何？诶嘿嘿，感觉比以前要好了一些，但又觉得好像没什么变化…到底是哪里的音偏了呢…？

mail.captionEn: There's a letter among the gifts...? Oh, it's addressed to you, Commander.
mail.caption: 慰劳品里有信…？啊，是给指挥官的信呢

main_1.captionEn: *inhale*... *exhale*... Don't think too much, just do as you practiced... You'll do just fine, Kashino...!
main_1.caption: 呼——哈——不用想太复杂，按照练习的感觉去做就好…嗯，樫野，一定没问题的…！

main_2.captionEn: By the way, I call this set the geisha party! Hehehe, I put more effort into the name since I was going to invite you♪
main_2.caption: 对了，这套布景叫做「座敷」呢～嘿嘿，因为是要邀请指挥官，所以名字也下了点功夫♪

main_3.captionEn: You say it's a little hot...? I-I didn't turn up the heat... Maybe it's just because of the lighting and atmosphere...?
main_3.caption: 觉得有点热吗…？不，不会是樫野把房间弄热了吧…可能是灯光或者是气氛的缘故…？

touch_body.captionEn: You'll show me how to do it right? Thank you, Commander...
touch_body.caption: 指挥官要给我做示范吗…？拜托了。

touch_head.captionEn: Ah... *blushes*
touch_head.caption: 啊呜……///

touch_special.captionEn: F-forgive me... *blushes*
touch_special.caption: 还，还请原谅我…？///

home.captionEn: Comrade Commander, you've done well in leading our efforts. Our streets are much safer as a result.
home.caption: 指挥官同志，现场指挥辛苦了。这下航路变得更安全了。

login.captionEn: Bystreye! Yet more enemies of the Revolution lurk in the shadows!
login.caption: Быстрее！还有众多妨碍革命的敌人潜伏着呢。

main_1.captionEn: Wanna take this thing out for a spin, Comrade Commander? Oh, but not right now though. Gotta make some special adjustments first before you can ride it.
main_1.caption: 指挥官同志也想来坐上来吗？啊，现在不行，要能坐下的话得专门调整一下。

main_2.captionEn: Tallinn, Kirov reporting. I'll be there shortly. Now, Comrade Commander, come with us.
main_2.caption: 塔林，这里是基洛夫，马上开始行动。指挥官同志也一起来吧。

main_3.captionEn: Did Kronshtadt flank our mark already? She sure loves doing the flashy stuff...
main_3.caption: 喀琅施塔德已经事先先迂回包抄了吗？她很擅长这种惹眼的行动呢…

mission.captionEn: Comrade Commander, a new mission has arrived. I'll let you decide when to start.
mission.caption: 指挥官同志，来任务了。行动开始的时机就交给你定了。

touch_body.captionEn: Come on, hold on tight! We're about to blow this joint!
touch_body.caption: 来，抓紧了！开始飚车了！

home.captionEn: Welcome back, my darling Commander~ ...What am I doing with the axe? Why, I'm looking for a way into your office without the key~♡
home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官大人~♡……我拿着斧头在做什么？嗯~当然是寻找不使用钥匙就能进入您办公室的办法~

login.captionEn: I've been waiting for you this whole time, Commander♡ ...Did I run into anyone while you were gone? Heehee, you're so sweet when you're agitated♡
login.caption: 指挥官大人，我在这里等您很久了……您不在的时候其实谁也没见？呵呵~指挥官紧张的样子，真是可爱呢~♡

main_1.captionEn: ...Why not give all my tentacles an axe? Heehee, you sure get funny ideas, my darling~ That would turn this into a Halloween comedy, not a horror flick.
main_1.caption: ……如果让每只触手都拿上斧头？呵呵，指挥官大人的想法真是有趣呢~那样就不是恐怖万圣节，而是搞笑剧了吧？

main_2.captionEn: Hm? Hmm? Seems my tentacles got ooze on my clothes... Wouldn't you say that's an upgrade, though, my darling Commander?
main_2.caption: 嗯？看起来是我的触手粘液把这套新衣服弄湿了……不过，这样似乎更好呢，对不对，指挥官大人~♡

main_3.captionEn: "You cheated on me! Die!" ...Hahahah! Was that a bit too intense? Now I'm curious what kind of Halloween bride you do like♡
main_3.caption: “为什么要花心！受死吧！”…哈哈，有点过激了？那么，您喜欢怎样的万圣节新娘呢~♡

touch_body.captionEn: Could you re-tie the knot on my skirt, please? Heehee, of course, you'll need to untie it first... ♡
touch_body.caption: 指挥官大人，可以帮我重新系紧裙子后的绑结么？…呵呵，当然是要先解开才行~

touch_head.captionEn: My veil hardly covers anything because of this antler... Oh, you think it suits me perfectly? Thank you, my darling♪
touch_head.caption: 因为角的原因，我很少戴头纱呢……反而觉得更加合适？谢谢您，指挥官大人。

touch_special.captionEn: A lonely newlywed in a deserted castle... This is how our loving starts, my darling♡
touch_special.caption: 无人的古堡，独居的新娘~接下来会很刺激哟，指挥官大人~♡

complete.captionEn: We're giving Sakura confections to the commission team as a thank-you reward, right?
complete.caption: 给委托组的慰劳品一定是重樱点心对吧！

home.captionEn: Sorry to keep you waiting~ I've brought you your piping-hot tea! ...Oh my, I seem to have forgotten the teacups! Oh, um, what should I do...?
home.caption: 久等了~热乎乎的茶端来了！啊，忘了拿茶杯了！嗯，该怎么办好呢…？

login.captionEn: Come get your delicious and fluffy dango~ One for you, one for me, and we can share the last one~♪ Ehehe, goood morning~!
login.caption: 美味松软的团子~♪你一个，我一个，剩下的我们对半分ー♪诶嘿嘿，早上好！

main_1.captionEn: Dangos are sooo good~ I could eat them for three days straight! But after that... I'd probably get sick of them and want some yatsuhashi instead~♪
main_1.caption: 团子好好吃~只要吃了这个，活个三天不是问题！至于三天之后……会吃腻的所以换成八桥吧♪

main_2.captionEn: The stuff you ordered? ...Oh! I think I ate it by accident! Oh, silly me!
main_2.caption: 点的单是……啊！我又不小心吃掉了！我真是的…！

main_3.captionEn: Since we're trying to make our pop-up café the best it can be, I have to memorize the entire menu~ Heehee, I'll be making a whole lot of goodies later~
main_3.caption: 难得的女仆店活动，我要把菜单都记下才行~嘻嘻，之后要做一大堆出来—

touch_body.captionEn: Alright, what would you like to order?
touch_body.caption: 好的，请问要点些什么呢？

touch_head.captionEn: I feel like I'm on top of the world~
touch_head.caption: 现在心情很好对吧~

touch_special.captionEn: Well, um... I suppose you just couldn't help it because of how cute I am, right...?
touch_special.caption: 嗯，嗯…因为酒匂很可爱呢…？

home.captionEn: Let me just... There, all set. Ah, welcome back, Commander.
home.caption: 嘿咻…这就是最后一个了。啊，指挥官，出击辛苦了。

login.captionEn: I've left your present under the tree... Did you prepare a present for me as well?
login.caption: 礼物就放在这了…指挥官也准备了礼物吗？

main_1.captionEn: Shimakaze! Go get all the destroyers' presents and leave them under the tree!
main_1.caption: 岛风~把驱逐舰的们的礼物也收集到这里来吧——

main_2.captionEn: After a year of hard work, Christmas is finally upon us! And soon it'll be New Year's too! Whew.
main_2.caption: 今年也一直努力到了圣诞节，辛苦了～再过一段时间就是新年了呢~呵呵。

main_3.captionEn: Would you like an oversized sock? You can use it when you want a bigger present. Hehe.
main_3.caption: 大码的袜子放进去了吗？想要更大的礼物的时候可以拿来用哦。

mission_complete.captionEn: Try to keep an eye out so our presents don't get lost amid all the rewards.
mission_complete.caption: 注意别把任务奖励混礼物里了哦。

touch_body.captionEn: No sneak-peeking at what's inside!
touch_body.caption: 禁止偷看礼物内容哦。

home.captionEn: I owe my thanks to the girls who prepared this outfit for me. It'll help me get through the holidays without personally standing out. ...It'll have the opposite effect? Huh?!
home.caption: 要感谢准备了这套东西的伙伴呢。托了这东西的福，我自己就不那么显眼了。…额，反而更引人注目了…？欸！？

login.captionEn: Good morning, Commander. What do you say we take this day off and relax?
login.caption: 早安，指挥官。今天就悠闲地度过吧，如何？

main_1.captionEn: You got this, Team Red! Mop the floor with those Team White clowns! ...Do you want to stay and watch TV with me, Commander? This match is definitely worth watching.
main_1.caption: 就是这样红组！把白组的杂鱼们都干掉吧！…指挥官也要一起看电视吗？这比赛还是挺有趣的哦？

main_2.captionEn: I always end up oversleeping on the day after the holiday's over... *Sigh*... Me dropping the ball when it really matters is not funny at all.
main_2.caption: 长假刚结束的时候总是会不小心睡过头呢…哈啊，关键时刻却搞砸了，可不是什么好笑的事情呢

main_3.captionEn: "Treasure every moment of peace you get," as someone once said. We're only simple "people", after all.
main_3.caption: 和平的日子就要悠闲地度过，似乎听谁这么说过。我们毕竟不是单纯的机械呢

touch_body.captionEn: I hardly ever get the chance to put this outfit on. Aren't you glad to see me wearing it, Commander? Hahaha~
touch_body.caption: 平时没什么机会穿这样的衣服呢，能看到这个，说明指挥官很幸运哦？呵呵

touch_head.captionEn: Y-you don't need to stare at me...
touch_head.caption: 别、别尽盯着这里摸啦…

login.captionEn: The perimeter has been secured, Comrade. Should I brief you on the situation, or do you want to see for yourself?
login.caption: 指挥官同志，我已经完全控制住现场了。状况是由我来说明还是你亲自确认？

main_1.captionEn: What's wrong with using indiscreet methods as means to an end? I quite like how much simpler this job is than information warfare.
main_1.caption: 只要制造点大动静，然后干脆利落地解决掉目标就行了吧？很好，这可比情报工作简单多了~

main_2.captionEn: It was a smart move to set up a barricade. This way, Kirov's squad can catch any suspects that try to flee the scene.
main_2.caption: 事先在这里设卡是正确的选择呢~就算有漏网之鱼，应该也会被基洛夫她们给逮住吧。

main_3.captionEn: Copy that... Arkhangelsk is on the move. It won't be long before this is over.
main_3.caption: 嗯，好的，我明白了…阿尔汉格尔斯克开始行动了，看来我们的任务很快就要结束了呢。

touch_body.captionEn: You turn the megaphone on with this button. Want to try it, Comrade?
touch_body.caption: 扩音喇叭的话，按住这里的键就可以用了。指挥官同志试试吧？

touch_special.captionEn: Well, well. Time to test how sturdy these handcuffs are... by trying them on you. Heehee...
touch_special.caption: 正好，就由指挥官同志来帮我试试这副手铐够不够坚固吧？哼哼哼~

home.captionEn: *Pats thighs* Master, I'm right over here~ Heehee, you must be exhausted, right~
home.caption: （拍大腿）主人，往这里靠哦～呵呵，你很累了吧～

login.captionEn: Goodness, what a troublesome master you are. Where have you been? I've been waiting to continue cleaning your ears~
login.caption: 主人真是淘气，这是又跑到哪去啦？让我继续为你掏耳朵嘛～

mail.captionEn: Your mail's here~ Please make sure you check it afterwards~♪
mail.caption: “邮件来了哦ー”――好的，来邮件了呢～之后请确认哦♪

main_1.captionEn: Umm... Hmm... Oh no, I still haven't finished sewing the outfit Aurora requested... Dear me...
main_1.caption: （坐立不安）…啊，不好，被欧若拉酱拜托的衣服还没做完呢…嗯…

main_2.captionEn: My, someone is at the door... Oh, Master?! Please don't move, I'm not done working on your ears yet...
main_2.caption: 哎呀，外面有人呢…是主人！？对不起，刚刚这下闷到你了吗…？？

main_3.captionEn: Alright, Master~ I'll be cleaning your other ear now, so please turn around... Eek?!
main_3.caption: 好的主人，这次掏另一边的耳朵，请躺好…呀？！

mission_complete.captionEn: The rewards have arrived without any issues. That's a relief~
mission_complete.caption: 任务报酬平安送来了。这下就放心啦～

touch_body.captionEn: Ah, Master, please don't move around so much.
touch_body.caption: 啊，主人请别乱动哦。

touch_special.captionEn: Ahhn...♡
touch_special.caption: 啊…♡

complete.captionEn: You've received the commission rewards? Excellent, let's see if there's anything we can put to use.
complete.caption: 委托物资送到了吗？正好，看看里面有没有什么能派上用场的。

login.captionEn: Let's start from here. Why don't you show me what kind of condition you're in today?
login.caption: 那就先从这里开始吧？看看今天指挥官的手感如何。

main_1.captionEn: Hmm? I'm measuring the wind speed. Or, would you rather me say... that I'm enjoying the warm, gentle breeze?
main_1.caption: 嗯？我在测风速哦。或者说……我在感受这和煦的风？

main_2.captionEn: Don't worry too much, and play however you see fit. This isn't a competition, so relax a bit.
main_2.caption: 不必在意那么多，尽情挥出自己想打的一杆就好。既然不是比赛，随意点，尽可能放轻松吧。

main_3.captionEn: Richelieu holds back too much, worrying about where the ball might fly off to. Jean Bart swings too hard, without worrying about anything at all. Looks like fun, doesn't it?
main_3.caption: 黎塞留和让·巴尔，一位犹豫半天，生怕一挥杆那球就不见了；另一位完全不在乎打到哪，每一杆都抡圆了手臂——真有趣啊。

touch_special.captionEn: Oh my, Commander. Your hands don't seem to be able to calm down.
touch_special.caption: 哎呀，指挥官，你的手好像不怎么安分呢。

home.captionEn: Let me join for the next sortie, Commander. It's not my style to just sit on my butt and wait around!
home.caption: 指挥官，接下来也让我出战吧，等你回来不是我的作风~

login.captionEn: Ready yet, Commander? It's time to go to the party!
login.caption: 指挥官，精神还好吗，接下来可是派对哦！

mail.captionEn: Hm? You brought the Commander's mail, Knight? Aren't you a clever dog! Good boy!
mail.caption: 嗯？骑士你把指挥官的新邮件叼过来了吗？真乖真乖

main_1.captionEn: You wanna come to the party too, Knight? All right... you're coming, too!
main_1.caption: 骑士，你也要想要去宴会吗？那我们就一起去吧~

main_2.captionEn: Quite a few people have asked me for a dance, but I'm not a great dancer... Commander, could ya help me learn the basics of dancing?
main_2.caption: 虽然收到了好多跳舞邀请，不过这方面我完全不懂……指挥官，来陪我练习一下吧？

main_3.captionEn: *Phew*... You wanna go for something to eat when the party's over, Commander? I'll treat you, so don't be shy! I mean come on, we're friends~
main_3.caption: 呼…指挥官，宴会结束后一起吃点什么吧，我请客，别客气，我们俩谁跟谁嘛~

mission.captionEn: Commander, let's wrap up those missions pronto before the party starts!
mission.caption: 指挥官，趁着宴会还没开始，把任务速战速决处理掉吧！

touch_body.captionEn: What's up, Knight? ... A rose...? Just what I needed! Here, Commander. A little gift from me to you, darling.
touch_body.caption: 骑士，怎么了？……哦？是玫瑰啊……正好，指挥官，送你吧~

complete.captionEn: The girls who went out shopping came back! Let's go see what they got!
complete.caption: 备货的同伴们回来了，快看看都有什么吧！

login.captionEn: Do you want to order anything later? ...You want my recommendation? Sure!
login.caption: 等下有什么想点的吗？我来推荐菜单？没问题！

mail.captionEn: Ooh! Even the mail gets sent here... I'll go get it, Commander!
mail.caption: 哇……邮件居然直接转到这边来了，我帮你拿过来哦~

main_1.captionEn: Commander, about the pop-up rehearsal... How does this sound? Ahem... Welcome! What would you—Be more enthusiastic? Okay... "Yo! Back again, huh?" ...Not like that?
main_1.caption: 陪我练习一下主题餐厅的台词怎么样？咳咳，欢迎光临，请问……再开朗热情些？那就——哟，来了啊！……也不对？

main_2.captionEn: You want to know what our special service is? Heheh, that's still a secret. Consider it a surprise for the end!
main_2.caption: 想知道特别服务是什么？哼哼，这是保密内容哦，等到结束后一定给你个惊喜~

main_3.captionEn: It's almost opening time... Huh? My shoes? Th-thank you! No, I can put them on myself!
main_3.caption: 差不多到开始的时间了，我的鞋子呢？哦……谢谢。等、等一下，我自己穿就行啦！

touch_body.captionEn: Little longer until open, huh... Commander, wanna game to pass the time? Heheh, here's an idea: whoever wins gets to ask the loser for anything they want!
touch_body.caption: 看来还要再等一会呢……要不要来一局游戏打发时间？赢家可以向输家提一个要求，怎么样？

touch_head.captionEn: Ooh! So this is how it feels to get headpats... Not bad!
touch_head.caption: 哦——！原来被摸头是这样的感觉啊……不赖！

touch_special.captionEn: A-at least wait until everyone leaves!
touch_special.caption: 等……等到大家都回去后再说！

home.captionEn: Oh, welcome back! ...What's this? You brought me lunch? Thank you so much!
home.caption: 啊，欢迎回来！……这是，带给我的午餐？谢谢指挥官！

login.captionEn: Nnngh... Hnnh! Phew... Who made erasing chalk so difficult?! Huh? C-Commander? How long have you been standing there?!
login.caption: 嘿……嘿~！唔唔，这块笔迹也太顽固了！……欸，指、指挥官？！什么时候来的？

main_1.captionEn: Nnnh... This patch of chalk is beyond my reach. If I stand on a chair... What? You think it can't possibly be that strong? You're making me angry, Commander.
main_1.caption: 唔哦…这处遗留的粉笔痕迹有点高呢。垫个椅子的话……我们没有这么结实的椅子？唔唔，指挥官，我要开始生气了哦？

main_2.captionEn: Commander, do you have any plans for lunch? Umm... If you don't, would you like to join me?
main_2.caption: 指挥官午休期间还有别的安排么？唔唔——没安排的话，就这样陪我一会怎么样。

main_3.captionEn: Today's class was nothing a royal lady such as myself cannot handle. Umm, though I did struggle to understand some of it...
main_3.caption: 今天的课程可难不倒我这个皇家淑女哦？唔唔，不过确实有些难懂的地方就是了……

touch_body.captionEn: Oh... Is there chalk residue on my shoulder? No? You just wanted to give me a massage? Th-thank you.
touch_body.caption: 咦……我的肩膀落灰了吗？帮我按摩？谢谢指挥官。

touch_special.captionEn: Eep?! What do you think you're doing?! You really expect me to believe you were just brushing chalk off? At least come up with a real excuse!
touch_special.caption: 呜哇！你在做什么呀？！……落了粉笔灰？至少给我好好想个借口啊！

home.captionEn: Wait up! Hold on! Gotta catch my breath...! Phew, whew...
home.caption: 不、不行了，先让我休息会……呼哧~呼哧~

login.captionEn: Watch me beat this Sakura girl... then it's you and me, Commander!
login.caption: 等我击败那那个重樱的小姑娘，指挥官，就来一决胜负吧！

main_1.captionEn: Ace shot! Yaaaaaah!
main_1.caption: 看好了，我的ace球！哈！

main_2.captionEn: This is for me? Alright...! Glug glug... Haah!
main_2.caption: 这是给我的运动饮料？谢谢！咕嘟~咕嘟~

main_3.captionEn: A black kitty cat! Where is it...?! Hey now, don't distract me!
main_3.caption: 黑色的猫？哪里哪里！……真是的，别让我分心啊！

touch_body.captionEn: Y-you probably shouldn't touch me. I'm all sweaty right now.
touch_body.caption: 指挥官，我现在身上全是汗，最好不要碰我……

home.captionEn: Where have you been? ...You didn't want to pass out from dizziness? Don't worry about that. Worst case scenario, I'll just carry you back home.
home.caption: 刚刚你去哪了？……担心泡太久会晕？没关系，晕了的话，我把你抱回去不就行了。

login.captionEn: Hmh... The water's nice. What are you waiting for, Commander? Get in.
login.caption: 嗯……感觉真不错。指挥官，愣在那里做什么？赶快进来泡吧。

mail.captionEn: I left your letter in a less humid spot. Don't want your important papers getting wet, do we?
mail.caption: 你的信件已经提前帮你放在干爽的地方了。重要的东西，弄湿了可不好。

main_1.captionEn: Seems the Sakura Empire has the most hot spring enthusiasts. Not that I don't want to bathe with them, but as you know... I'd rather be alone.
main_1.caption: 喜欢泡温泉的同伴里，重樱的最多。倒不是不想和她们一起，只是你也知道……我不擅长应付人多的地方。

main_2.captionEn: The hot steam causes the cold air to fog up, impeding visibility and making this an ideal place to set up an ambush... Heh. Don't worry. I'm right here.
main_2.caption: 空气中氤氲着白色的水雾，能见度很低，是个不错的偷袭地点……呵呵，我在这，不用怕。

main_3.captionEn: How's the temperature? If you want, I can turn up the heat using my rigging.
main_3.caption: 温度够么？不够的话，我再用舰装加点火力。

mission.captionEn: A new mission just got handed down. Go ahead and take a look – we'll have plenty of time to relax later.
mission.caption: 似乎接到了下达新任务的通知……先去确认一下吧。休息这种事，稍后再进行也未尝不可。

touch_body.captionEn: While I hate rubbing shoulders... I can tolerate you being around.
touch_body.caption: 我不习惯和别人贴得太近……不过，是你的话，应该没关系。

touch_special.captionEn: You want to get up close and personal, huh? Heheh.
touch_special.caption: 还想要更进一步……？呵呵~

complete.captionEn: I was actually wondering whether you'd remember it or not, but a commission has been completed, Commander.
complete.caption: 我在想指挥官会不会自己记起来委托已经完成了这件事

home.captionEn: I've returned from the mission. Regrouping with original unit.
home.caption: 指挥官，睡一会儿吗？

login.captionEn: Did you have a good rest, Commander? I'm full of energy. Probably.
login.caption: 指挥官休息的还好吗，拉菲现在很有精神，大概

mail.captionEn: Commander, your mail...
mail.caption: 指挥官，您的信……

main_1.captionEn: Commander, don't you think we should plant some flowers?
main_1.caption: 指挥官，我们要不要种点花呢？

main_2.captionEn: Since you're ignoring me, I might as well... *yawns*... get some sleep.
main_2.caption: 指挥官不理拉菲，哈啊……都要睡着噜……

main_3.captionEn: Yes? This is what I look like when I'm happy.
main_3.caption: 嗯？这是拉菲心情好的表现喔

mission.captionEn: Looks like we've still got a few missions to do...
mission.caption: 看来……我们还有任务要做

mission_complete.captionEn: Mhm, we got some rewards.
mission_complete.caption: 恩，我们收到了一批奖励

touch_body.captionEn: Are you tired, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官，累了吗？

touch_head.captionEn: Mmh... Stop shaking me, Commander...
touch_head.caption: 呣……指挥官，不要摇我……

touch_special.captionEn: Are you... a pervert, Commander...?
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……莫非是变态？！

wedding.captionEn: I thought I wouldn't mind becoming a demon again if it was for you, Commander… But since you've taken such good care of me, I guess my chance for that is gone… Have I disappointed you, Commander?
wedding.caption: 原本还一直想着，为了指挥官的话，就算再次化身鬼神也无所谓…不过…被指挥官这么关心着…看来是没有机会了呢…指挥官…失望吗？

home.captionEn: You know the crackles and pops firecrackers make after you light the fuse... *Ughh*... Those are so noisy...
home.caption: 那个红红的，一串一串，烧起来之后砰砰砰砰的……唔，有点吵……

login.captionEn: The Commander's still not back. I might just fall asleep here... Zzzzz...
login.caption: 指挥官还不回来，拉菲要靠着树睡着了……Zzz……

main_1.captionEn: I'm wearing limited-edition Lunar New Year bunny ears and bunny slippers... do you like them? I like them.
main_1.caption: 春节限定版兔耳和兔兔拖鞋…指挥官喜欢吗？拉菲…很喜欢…

main_2.captionEn: I think Zed is interested in old Lunar New Year folklore...
main_2.caption: Z23，好像对春节的传说很有兴趣的样子……

main_3.captionEn: Sitting on top of this tree makes me feel like I'm going to blossom, too...
main_3.caption: 像这样在树上坐着，拉菲感觉自己也要开花了…

touch_body.captionEn: I totally don't feel like leaning against your shoulder, Commander. Nope, not at all...
touch_body.caption: 拉菲没有想借指挥官的肩膀靠一会，嗯，并没有……

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, are you having weird thoughts again...?
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，又在想奇怪的事了吗…

complete.captionEn: Our commission team just got home. The pop-up shop... is about to get really busy...
complete.caption: 委托组，回来了。店里等一下会很热闹……吧？

home.captionEn: Commander, your order...? "Anything as long as I'm with Laffey"? Aw, thank you...
home.caption: 指挥官，要点餐吗？……陪伴套餐？当然可以。

login.captionEn: I haven't been looking all over the place for you... Nope, not at all.
login.caption: 拉菲才没有在到处找指挥官呢，嗯，没有。

main_1.captionEn: Laffey's job... is to deliver food to the tables... It's not boring because you're here, Commander... Yep.
main_1.caption: 拉菲的任务，把餐点送到桌子上……指挥官在，所以这份工作一点也不无聊……嗯。

main_2.captionEn: If Ingraham made a conveyor belt to deliver the food, would Laffey not have to anymore...?
main_2.caption: 如果英格拉罕能发明菜品传送带的话……拉菲就不用送订单了吧……？

main_3.captionEn: I came to help out... so I'll keep doing my best... I'm not thinking about slacking off with Allen... Nope, not at all...
main_3.caption: 因为是来帮忙的，拉菲想要坚持做完……拉菲没有想和艾伦坐着偷懒，嗯，完全没想过。

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete... Commander, I'm gonna take a nap... Zzzz...
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成，指挥官，拉菲要睡一会儿……Zzzz……

touch_body.captionEn: My bouncy bunny ears look fun to touch...? Umm... I don't understand...
touch_body.caption: 兔兔的耳朵立起来很好摸……？唔……不明白……

touch_head.captionEn: Commander... I'm not eepy, I swear... Okay? Got it?
touch_head.caption: 指挥官，拉菲没有打瞌睡哦……没有，嗯。

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, you pervert... You're gonna make my bunnies fall off...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，变态，衣服上的兔兔要掉下去了……

complete.captionEn: (Grooooowl...) Oh, is the commission team back already?
complete.caption: 是委托组回来了吗？

home.captionEn: Looks like Regina's having a good time with its friends. Why don't you take a break as well? Surely you're not trying to test the limits of your weary body.
home.caption: 雷吉纳好像在和朋友玩耍。你也差不多该休息下了吧？你该不会是想试试看，以你这疲惫的身体能撑多久吧？

login.captionEn: Hehe, even someone like you is powerless before my allure. Those ruled by their emotions are easy to control, just like riggings.
login.caption: 呵呵，即使是你这样的人也难以抵挡我的魅力。被自己的情感支配的存在，就像舰装一样易于控制呢。

main_1.captionEn: Hm? What are you trying to... Hyeep?! G-get your hands off my tail this instant! Didn't you hear me?!
main_1.caption: ？你这是…吓！？快，快把你的手从我的尾巴上移开！没听到吗？！

main_2.captionEn: (Rooooar...) Looks like Regina's gone pretty far out to sea. Hope it doesn't run into any trouble.
main_2.caption: 雷吉纳好像跑到海深处去了，希望它不要遇到什么危险。

main_3.captionEn: Since you're here at the beach, surely you have a thing or two you'd like to do? Come on, let yourself loose already.
main_3.caption: 既然来到了海边，那应该有一两件特别想做的事吧？来，随你心意行动就好。

mission.captionEn: A job? What job could be more important than enjoying your time off at the beach?
mission.caption: 任务啊。现在除了享受大海之外，什么任务都不存在吧？

mission_complete.captionEn: One can never get enough rewards. Same is always true regardless of what form they come in.
mission_complete.caption: 报酬永远不嫌多。无论哪种形式的报酬都是这个道理呢。

touch_body.captionEn: (That's right! Bare your weaknesses to me as I pretend to be subservient...!)
touch_body.caption: （对了…！我就顺势装个乖好了，在我面前暴露你的弱点吧…！）

touch_special.captionEn: Huh?! Wh-why do you know where my weak spot is...?!
touch_special.caption: …！？为，为什么对我的弱点…！

complete.captionEn: Commander, a commission has finished.
complete.caption: ……指挥官，有委托完成了

home.captionEn: Commander, you're a little like me on the battlefield... That's... pretty cool.
home.caption: 指挥官在战场上和我有点像，稍微……有点帅

login.captionEn: Commander, have you eaten yet? Here's some snacks.
login.caption: 指挥官，吃了吗？我这里还有点心

mail.captionEn: There's... new mail...
mail.caption: 有新的……邮件……

main_1.captionEn: Ayanami's ears... are they cute? I don't understand... As long as you're happy, Commander!
main_1.caption: 绫波的耳朵……比较可爱吗？不太懂……指挥官开心就好

main_2.captionEn: I've been having nightmares of all the girls getting lost... I'm certain that it's my fault, too...
main_2.caption: 最近时常会做和大家走散的噩梦，一定是我做的还不够好……

main_3.captionEn: Commander? No, nothing. I just wanted to see if you were here or not.
main_3.caption: 指挥官？…不，没事。我只是确认一下你是不是还在

mission.captionEn: Commander, we've been notified of new missions.
mission.caption: 指挥官的新任务下达了

mission_complete.captionEn: The rewards for the previous mission are here.
mission_complete.caption: 之前完成的任务，奖励送来了……

touch_body.captionEn: Uuu... it tickles...a bit.
touch_body.caption: 唔——有点痒……

touch_head.captionEn: I don't really get it but... I'm a bit happy...
touch_head.caption: 虽然不太明白这样有什么意义……但是有点高兴（蹭蹭）

touch_special.captionEn: Commander... please... don't touch there so much... It's making me feel weird...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，请不要……乱碰，感觉……有点奇怪

wedding.captionEn: Rest assured... This time, no matter what happens, I'll survive and return to you... because I'll always want to see you again...
wedding.caption: 放心吧，这次我无论如何都会活下来，然后回到指挥官面前……因为……我想见指挥官……

login.captionEn: "It is unbefitting to keep a lady waiting." —That was just a joke. Commander, welcome back.
login.caption: “让淑女久等不是绅士所为”——开玩笑的。指挥官，欢迎回来的说。

main_1.captionEn: Z23 seems to be fitting in just fine, but... I'm still a bit nervous. Commander, don't leave me alone.
main_1.caption: Z23…感觉对这种场合很习惯了的说。绫波…有点紧张…指挥官，不要离开绫波身边。

main_2.captionEn: To get rid of my nerves... maybe I should try releasing the †Force† like that one person taught me... Is that a bad idea?
main_2.caption: 要缓解紧张的话，只能发动小伙伴传授的力量<Force>……不行吗？

main_3.captionEn: Listening to the piano makes me a bit sleepy... Commander, you're not getting sleepy?
main_3.caption: 听着弹钢琴的声音，总觉得有点困……指挥官不困吗？

touch_body.captionEn: ...Ah! Ayanami... is awake now...
touch_body.caption: ……啊。绫波，不困的……

touch_special.captionEn: Commander... you're acting a bit weird...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官…感觉有点奇怪？

home.captionEn: When Reno Bunnino's beloved commander comes home to roost, that's her time to shine.
home.caption: 在最尊敬的指挥官休息的时候，就是bunny reno开始行动的时候……

login.captionEn: What can I get you, Commander?
login.caption: 指挥官，今天想喝点什么呢？

main_1.captionEn: So I was telling everyone about Reno Bunnino, and for whatever reason, North Carolina was super keen to hear it... Not like that's a bad thing. More friends is always good!
main_1.caption: 不知道为什么，把bunny reno的设定告诉大家后，北卡罗来纳好像很感兴趣，甚至想要加入呢……不过同伴增加是好事呢！

main_2.captionEn: Hungry, Commander? Vestal taught me a handful of recipes. I could cook something up for you.
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你饿了吗？嘻嘻，我有向女灶神请教过厨艺哦，我来为你做点什么吧~

main_3.captionEn: Y'know, I think this Reno Bunnino's thing really gonna take off. I'm counting on you to facilitate that, Commander.
main_3.caption: 感觉……说不定bunny reno意外地能成为潮流呢！指挥官也请多多捧场哦~

touch_body.captionEn: This gauntlet I'm always wearing? Oh, uh, I've not made my Reno Bunnino tool belt just yet, so I'm making do with this for now.
touch_body.caption: 啊，我的手甲吗？这个啊，因为bunny reno专属的武器还没有做好，所以就暂时拿来代替了~

touch_special.captionEn: If you're doing what I think you are... Yeah, sorry, there aren't many clothes my size.
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……要找到适合我尺寸的衣服可不太容易！

home.captionEn: When Reno Bunnino's beloved commander comes home to roost, that's her time to shine.
home.caption: 在最尊敬的指挥官休息的时候，就是bunny reno开始行动的时候……

login.captionEn: What can I get you, Commander?
login.caption: 指挥官，今天想喝点什么呢？

main_1.captionEn: So I was telling everyone about Reno Bunnino, and for whatever reason, North Carolina was super keen to hear it... Not like that's a bad thing. More friends is always good!
main_1.caption: 不知道为什么，把bunny reno的设定告诉大家后，北卡罗来纳好像很感兴趣，甚至想要加入呢……不过同伴增加是好事呢！

main_2.captionEn: Hungry, Commander? Vestal taught me a handful of recipes. I could cook something up for you.
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你饿了吗？嘻嘻，我有向女灶神请教过厨艺哦，我来为你做点什么吧~

main_3.captionEn: Y'know, I think this Reno Bunnino's thing really gonna take off. I'm counting on you to facilitate that, Commander.
main_3.caption: 感觉……说不定bunny reno意外地能成为潮流呢！指挥官也请多多捧场哦~

touch_body.captionEn: This gauntlet I'm always wearing? Oh, uh, I've not made my Reno Bunnino tool belt just yet, so I'm making do with this for now.
touch_body.caption: 啊，我的手甲吗？这个啊，因为bunny reno专属的武器还没有做好，所以就暂时拿来代替了~

touch_special.captionEn: If you're doing what I think you are... Yeah, sorry, there aren't many clothes my size.
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……要找到适合我尺寸的衣服可不太容易！

complete.captionEn: We have a really good view from up here. I can even see a commission group starting to return out there.
complete.caption: 这里的视野很好，指挥官，你看，恰好能看到海平线上返回的委托组

home.captionEn: I don't wish for my absence to become a burden on you, Commander. If there's anything I can help with, please let me know.
home.caption: 我并不希望我的休息是以你的额外劳动换来的，指挥官，有任何需要帮忙的地方请尽管提出来

login.captionEn: Scenery that calms the heart... Commander, you've got good taste.
login.caption: 一个风景优美的地方，指挥官，你很会挑选

main_1.captionEn: Commander, I'll be heading to the beach for a bit. ... Hehe. Indeed, this is a bit different from how I am usually. Would you like to come along with me?
main_1.caption: 我去海里稍微游一会儿。…？呵呵，确实和我平常的印象不太一致呢。指挥官，你要一起来吗？

main_2.captionEn: Frozen treats are most effective against hot and humid weather like this... Shall we ask Dunkerque to prepare some more next time?
main_2.caption: 炎热的盛夏与冰凉的甜食…不得不说是绝配呢，下次请敦刻尔克再多做一些好了…

main_3.captionEn: Jean Bart... Perhaps it's better to spend some more time with her... Sigh...
main_3.caption: 我偶尔也会思考，与让·巴尔共同度过一段时间对于我们的关系或许是有必要的呢…哈啊…

touch_body.captionEn: My... Where are you taking me, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 你要带我去哪里，指挥官？

touch_special.captionEn: If you know what's good for you, I wouldn't assume that a girl is defenseless just because she's in a swimsuit.
touch_special.caption: 穿着泳装就变得毫无防备了——还是不要有这么天真的想法比较好哦，指挥官

complete.captionEn: It seems the commissions team made it back safely. This counts as good fortune, doesn't it?
complete.caption: 委托组平安回来了。所谓的“开门大吉”就是这样吧。

home.captionEn: Please calm down and ponder what we should do. I'll be waiting right over here.
home.caption: 不要着急，先安排出击的各位休息吧，我会在这里等你的。

login.captionEn: It looks like you went out to take a glimpse of the morning sun. I look forward to being in your company today, Commander.
login.caption: 又迎来了一轮崭新的朝阳，今天也请多指教了，指挥官。

mail.captionEn: So this is what the Sakura Empire's New Year's greeting cards look like... How interesting. Hehehe.
mail.caption: 重樱的贺年卡是这种感觉的吗…挺有意思的，呵呵…

main_1.captionEn: nil
main_1.caption: nil

main_2.captionEn: nil
main_2.caption: nil

main_3.captionEn: What these fortunes tell may be your fate. Even so, is it not mankind's strength to overcome fate?
main_3.caption: “抽签”展示的或许正是命运，即便如此，人类的顽强，还是能够打破既定宿命的吧。

touch_body.captionEn: You'd like to sit by my side? Up we go... Good kitty... Alright, here you go, Commander.
touch_body.caption: 指挥官也要坐过来吗？请稍等…乖孩子…好了，请坐。

touch_special.captionEn: Is this a greeting... for the New Year?
touch_special.caption: 这是…新年的打招呼方式吗？

home.captionEn: You can leave the purification to me if Fusou and Yamashiro are both busy, all right? After all, I happen to be quite knowledgeable about that subject.
home.caption: 如果扶桑和山城忙不过来的话，辟邪的仪式交给我也可以哦？这方面还是有点心得的呢

login.captionEn: Good work, Commander. Please allow me to prepare the hamaya!
login.caption: 指挥官，辛苦了。破魔矢的准备就交给我吧！

main_1.captionEn: The thing about Junyou is... Well, Commander, if something's bothering you, you can consult me, you know?
main_1.caption: 隼鹰那样子…嗯，指挥官，感到困扰的时候可以找我聊聊没关系哦？

main_2.captionEn: Because I'm in Shigure's debt, I cook her some food from time to time. She's really a good girl, even if she doesn't always act like one.
main_2.caption: 时雨以前帮过我不少忙呢，所以现在我还会偶尔做点东西给她吃。别看她那样，其实是个好孩子呢

main_3.captionEn: Commander, would you like to write an Ema? Even if your wishes don't get fulfilled, it's still great to just be able to write down your thoughts.
main_3.caption: 指挥官要写写绘马吗？就算没能实现愿望，能写下当下的所思所想也是不错的呢

touch_body.captionEn: Hehe... Commander, are you here to enjoy some sweet sake as well? Don't worry, you won't get drunk...
touch_body.caption: 呼呼…指挥官也来喝点甜酒吧？不会醉的

touch_special.captionEn: ...W-What are you planning...?
touch_special.caption: ……你、你想做什么…？

home.captionEn: You can leave the purification to me if Fusou and Yamashiro are both busy, all right? After all, I happen to be quite knowledgeable about that subject.
home.caption: 如果扶桑和山城忙不过来的话，辟邪的仪式交给我也可以哦？这方面还是有点心得的呢

login.captionEn: Good work, Commander. Please allow me to prepare the hamaya!
login.caption: 指挥官，辛苦了。破魔矢的准备就交给我吧！

main_1.captionEn: The thing about Junyou is... Well, Commander, if something's bothering you, you can consult me, you know?
main_1.caption: 隼鹰那样子…嗯，指挥官，感到困扰的时候可以找我聊聊没关系哦？

main_2.captionEn: Because I'm in Shigure's debt, I cook her some food from time to time. She's really a good girl, even if she doesn't always act like one.
main_2.caption: 时雨以前帮过我不少忙呢，所以现在我还会偶尔做点东西给她吃。别看她那样，其实是个好孩子呢

main_3.captionEn: Commander, would you like to write an Ema? Even if your wishes don't get fulfilled, it's still great to just be able to write down your thoughts.
main_3.caption: 指挥官要写写绘马吗？就算没能实现愿望，能写下当下的所思所想也是不错的呢

touch_body.captionEn: Hehe... Commander, are you here to enjoy some sweet sake as well? Don't worry, you won't get drunk...
touch_body.caption: 呼呼…指挥官也来喝点甜酒吧？不会醉的

touch_special.captionEn: ...W-What are you planning...?
touch_special.caption: ……你、你想做什么…？

home.captionEn: Welcome back! Want some tanghulu? Ning Hai and Ping Hai brought some over. They're really tasty~
home.caption: 回来啦……要吃冰糖葫芦吗？是宁海和平海给我的，很好吃呢！

login.captionEn: Happy New Year, Commander. Hmm? Lucky money present for me? Thank you very much... That makes me very happy~♪
login.caption: 指挥官，新年好~……这是给我的红包？好开心……谢谢！

mail.captionEn: So many messages... Are they all cards wishing you a happy new year?
mail.caption: 好多新邮件……是寄给指挥官的新年贺卡吗？

main_1.captionEn: What in the world is this baozi?! The texture of the dough, the exquisite flavor of the filling! I hate to admit this, but it's better than what I can make! I, I need to research this later...!
main_1.caption: 这包子！这面粉的口感，这内馅的调味！虽然有点不甘心，但是这包子确实比我做的好吃！之后一定要好好钻研一下！

main_2.captionEn: Commander, I hope everything goes well this coming year~ Ehehe. Please let me handle all of your daily meals as well. I'll make sure everything is delicious and healthy~♪
main_2.caption: 祝指挥官在新的一年，万事如意！嘿嘿……新的一年里，就让我来包揽指挥官的每日三餐吧！保证美味又健康~

main_3.captionEn: Heehee~ I snuck into the kitchen earlier to make those spring rolls I put on your desk. ..Too spicy? Spicy is good! You're supposed to welcome the new year with a bang! Ugh, my head is spinning... Who swapped out all the cooking wine in the kitchen with Hua Tiao wine?
main_3.caption: 嘿嘿~桌上的春卷是龙武溜进厨房做的……好辣？辣就对了！新年……当然要红红火火……！头好晕，是谁把厨房的料酒换成了花雕……

mission.captionEn: New missions, huh? Let's work together to get things taken care of. The food's gonna go cold if we take too long.
mission.caption: 有新任务啊……让我们一起快速解决掉吧？再拖拉下去，饭菜都要冷掉了。

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! Let's count up the rewards, then head back to enjoy a nice New Year feast!
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了！一起去清点报酬，然后一起回来吃新年大餐吧~！

touch_body.captionEn: Hmm? Commander, want some baozi?
touch_body.caption: 嗯……？指挥官，要来个包子吗？

touch_head.captionEn: Nngh... If my hair gets all messy, you'll be responsible for combing it back...
touch_head.caption: 唔……发型要是乱了的话，你要负责重新帮我梳好哦……

touch_special.captionEn: Commander... H-Hu Pen can still see us...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……虎、虎贲还在呢……

complete.captionEn: I can see the commission team all the way from up here. Well? Are you heading out to greet them?
complete.caption: 从这里可以看到委托组的伙伴们哦？怎么办？要去迎接她们吗？

home.captionEn: Welcome back! Let's give you a nice, waaarm hug♪
home.caption: 欢迎回来~给你治愈的拥抱♪

login.captionEn: Good timing, actually – the party was starting to bore me. Thanks for pulling me out, Commander~
login.caption: 其实我也刚开始觉得派对有些乏味了呢。谢谢你，指挥官♪

main_1.captionEn: While I like vistas as much as the next person, I'm awfully fed up with the port's scenery at this point. Battlefields differ in that regard... Ahh... I'll never tire of seeing them.
main_1.caption: 欣赏风景是不错，不过总是看着港区的景色，难免有些腻了呢~果然还是战场的风景好呀…啊啊…无论何时看都不会腻呢…

main_2.captionEn: Heehee~ Don't you worry, I'm not going anywhere. Why would I, when it's you who brought me here?
main_2.caption: 呵呵，不用担心，我哪里都不会去的~毕竟带我来这的可是指挥官呢，对吧？

main_3.captionEn: Since we have access to a piano, could you help me work on my singing? I'm starting to feel restless from sitting around for too long... Heehee~
main_3.caption: 难得有钢琴在这里，能陪我练习唱歌吗？什么都不做的话，总觉得有些静不下心呢，呵呵~

touch_body.captionEn: Oh, you're back already? Then please, come here and let your heart be soothed♪
touch_body.caption: 想回去了吗？那么，请去治愈疲累的心吧♪

touch_special.captionEn: Go on – we're all alone here~♥
touch_special.caption: 没有别人在哦～♥

complete.captionEn: New commission rewards have just arrived.
complete.caption: 新的委托物资，现在送到了。

home.captionEn: I told you to stay here, didn't I? To make up for leaving, you shall spend twice as long rehearsing a pas de deux with me.
home.caption: 我说过的吧？哪里也不要去。作为擅自离开的代价，双人舞的部分你可要付出双倍的时间来配合我。

login.captionEn: Our march fades into the blackness on nights with dim moonlight. That is likely the reason I why couldn't detect your presence here.
login.caption: 月光稀薄的夜晚，能有效地掩盖行军的痕迹。这大概就是我没能第一时间发现你的原因吧。

mail.captionEn: You have a new letter. I believe it's a ballet invitation. Shall we attend, or are you too busy? I shall dispose of it if so.
mail.caption: 新的信件，看起来是演出的邀请函。要答应么？不答应的话，我替你撕了吧。

main_1.captionEn: You wish to see me perform on the stage? I'd be happy to if it would spread Romulus' splendor... However, I ask that you be patient until I've perfected my dance.
main_1.caption: 希望我也能在众人面前表演？若是能展示罗穆路斯之威光，那自然是好事。不过，这得等到我认为能做到“完美”之后。

main_2.captionEn: While the cursed princess-turned-swan can only reassume her human form at midnight, I can dance whenever I please.
main_2.caption: 身受诅咒的公主唯有午夜时分，才能片刻地摆脱天鹅之躯。至于我，自然是想何时起舞，便何时起舞。

main_3.captionEn: Garibaldi, despite the nonchalance she ordinarily displays, plays the black swan quite well. I sincerely acknowledge her skill.
main_3.caption: 平时散漫的加里波第，扮演起黑天鹅时倒是有模有样的。她作为舞者的实力，我认同了。

mission.captionEn: New missions? I'm afraid now is not the right time for those.
mission.caption: 任务？现在不是被这种东西打扰的时候。

mission_complete.captionEn: A mission has been completed. Strange, as I could've sworn you've been here from the start... Are you able to clone yourself? Heehee.
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了。但你一直在这里。莫非你会分身的邪术？

touch_body.captionEn: This is what a pas de deux is like? How novel.
touch_body.caption: 原来双人的舞步是这样的么？有趣。

home.captionEn: They've changed my port so drastically I don't know what's what anymore... I should've stayed home since the Commander's away... Whuah?! C-Commander?!
home.caption: 明明是自己的港区却搞不懂发生了什么……指挥官也不在，早知道就不来了……呀？！指，指挥官？！

login.captionEn: So for the Spring Festival, a carp is needed as decoration, which then turns into a dragon... Doesn't make any sense to me. Besides, how in the world is a fish supposed to turn into... Whuah?! What the heck was that?!
login.caption: “春节”要用鲤鱼装饰，然后那个鲤鱼变成龙……真是搞不懂。说起来为什么鲤鱼会变成龙——哇？！怎，怎么回事？！

main_1.captionEn: Ägir mentioned a lion that dances in the air – I want to check it out... If I SAY it flies, then it FLIES, okay?! And you're going with me, obviously!
main_1.caption: 去看下埃吉尔说的，在天上飞的狮子好了……本小姐说在天上飞就是在天上飞！当然，你也要和我一起来！

main_2.captionEn: A red envelope? Are you that strapped for cash even though you run this place? ...Hm? You're giving it to me? I don't want it! Blep!
main_2.caption: 压岁钱？平时运营着港区结果自己却囊中羞涩吗？……嗯？是要给我的？我才不要呢！

main_3.captionEn: Here's what happens to idiots who don't pay attention to me! Hahaha! That's right, run in fear from my firecrackers!
main_3.caption: 总是不理我的笨蛋，看招！哈哈，被爆竹吓得抱头鼠窜吧！

touch_body.captionEn: Where did that cretin bumble off to... Hyeep?! D-don't just sneak up on me out of the blue!
touch_body.caption: 指挥官那家伙，跑到哪里去了……呜哇！我我我刚才才没有叫指挥官你呢！不许随便搭茬！

touch_special.captionEn: D-don't you dare blame it on my dress!
touch_special.caption: 你、你对我这身有什么意见吗！

home.captionEn: I would much rather wield my spear upon the seas of battle than sit up here like a statue, Commander.
home.caption: 比起像一尊雕塑一样坐在这里，我更想与你一起踏上战场，指挥官

login.captionEn: Commander, making me sit up here waiting for you by myself is a tribulation in its own right.
login.caption: 指挥官，让我一个人坐在这里是一种煎熬

main_1.captionEn: So I've managed to capture your gaze? Your eyes are... Nevermind, it doesn't bother me.
main_1.caption: 指挥官，现在的我有这么惹人注目吗？我能感受到你的视线——不，我对此并不反感

main_2.captionEn: My arbitration is needed? ...Very well, please excuse me for a moment. I will make sure to hear them out.
main_2.caption: 坐在这里仲裁同僚之间的纠纷？那就…失礼了，让我先好好听听她们所言所感吧。

main_3.captionEn: As the one guiding this fleet forward... Commander, you are the one best suited to this throne.
main_3.caption: 指挥官，你是这里的统帅，我想这王座应当由你来坐才最合适

touch_body.captionEn: My weapon is always within reach. Should you will it, I am ready to sortie at any time.
touch_body.caption: 武器就在我的身边，如果要上战场，我随时都可以

home.captionEn: You're under my complete control, and will always come back to me... Heehee, I call this plot device "the curse of Dracula's Castle."
home.caption: 兜兜转转了一阵子，最终还是回到我身边了呢。这个就是“来自吸血鬼古堡的诅咒”的设定~

login.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. Now where's my crimson elixir? As in, my daily glass of wine~
login.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。今天的“鲜血”准备好了吗？当然指的是葡萄酒哦~

main_1.captionEn: Garlic? Crosses? Those don't work on me... Those are meant to repel a vampire? Well then, I'm throwing those weaknesses right out the window.
main_1.caption: 大蒜？十字架？那种东西对我可没有用哦。吸血鬼都是这种设定？那我只要把这个设定吃掉就好了~

main_2.captionEn: Seydlitz, the key to acting is to fully immerse yourself in your role. You don't have to think about it too hard.
main_2.caption: 塞德利茨，所谓“扮演”只要把自己想象成那个角色就好了，不用顾忌那么多的~

main_3.captionEn: Hrmph. I'm trying my absolute best here, and you're not even looking, Commander... I'll just have to MAKE you pay attention!
main_3.caption: 欸，人家在这里专心扮演，你怎么一副心不在焉的样子…不行，我要咬你两口让你清醒清醒！

touch_body.captionEn: Aww, come ooon. I'm comfy right where I am – don't make me get up.
touch_body.caption: 欸——我还不想起来，再让我坐会~

touch_special.captionEn: When a human feels bliss, that's when their blood tastes sweetest♪
touch_special.caption: 据说，人感到最幸福的时刻，也是其血液最美味的时刻呢~

home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander! It was cold out on the seas, right? I've kept the water nice and hot for you, so warm up before you head out again!
home.caption: 指挥官，欢迎回来！海上很冷吧？玛莉事先弄好了热水的温度，请来泡澡暖下身子吧！

login.captionEn: Hum, humdeedum duuum♪ Heheh, come and relax in the onsen with me, Commander!
login.caption: 哼~哼哼~♪呵呵，指挥官也来泡温泉放松下吧♪

main_1.captionEn: Haha, everyone looks so comfy~♪ Thank you for bringing us to such a nice place♡
main_1.caption: 哼哼~大家都好舒服的样子♪谢谢你带我来这样的好地方♡

main_2.captionEn: I hear this hot water is great for your skin! Maybe it'll make me even more mature♪
main_2.caption: 听说这个温泉对皮肤很好！玛莉，说不定要比现在更成熟了♪

main_3.captionEn: Heheh, Commander? I know I'm adorable, but staring is bad manners, y'know.
main_3.caption: 呵呵，指挥官？就算玛莉很可爱，一直盯着看可不太礼貌哦？

touch_body.captionEn: Heheh, I'm getting all hot and lightheaded~♪
touch_body.caption: 呼呼，玛莉泡得有些晕了，身子都发热了♪

touch_special.captionEn: Geez! Quit messing around, Commander!
touch_special.caption: 真是的！可不能恶作剧呀，指挥官！

complete.captionEn: The girls from the commission fleet have returned~ Akashi will check to see if they're injured, nya~!
complete.caption: 委托组的姐妹们回来了喵，明石去看看她们有没有受伤喵！

home.captionEn: If you are broken anywhere, Akashi can fix you up.
home.caption: 指挥官哪里坏了的话，明石可以帮你修……

login.captionEn: Commander~ good meowning~ *yawns*
login.caption: 指挥官好~……哈啊

mail.captionEn: *stares*... New mail has arrived~
mail.caption: 叽——新邮件已经送达了

main_1.captionEn: ...n...nya? Nnnh... zzzZZ...
main_1.caption: …ny…nya？嗯……zzzZZ

main_2.captionEn: Commander, what’s the matter? Can it be that you broke?
main_2.caption: 指挥官怎么了…难道是坏掉了？需要我修修喵？

main_3.captionEn: Commander, care for a beverage? Freshly squeezed from another ship nya~!
main_3.caption: 指挥官要来点饮料喵？我刚从别的船身上榨出来的喵

mission.captionEn: Commander, Commander~! You've got a new mission!
mission.caption: 指挥官指挥官，新的任务发布了哦

mission_complete.captionEn: Rewards are here~! Anything tasty... nya...?
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励到了，会有好吃的吗……

touch_body.captionEn: Akashi isn't malfunctioning, right?
touch_body.caption: 明石没有故障哦？

touch_head.captionEn: ...n...nya? Nnnh.... zzzZZ...
touch_head.caption: …ny…nya？嗯……zzzZZ

touch_special.captionEn: Nn? What's this feeling? It's as if I've been damaged.
touch_special.caption: 嗯……？这种感觉是？好像需要修理一下……

wedding.captionEn: What's this, Commander?  Does it need fixing? I don't really get it but, I'll keep it safe, nya~!
wedding.caption: 指挥官，这是什么，要明石来修理一下喵？——虽然不太明白，是很重要的东西的话明石就帮指挥官保管好了喵！

complete.captionEn: I hear footsteps. The commission team must be back... but I can't let you leave already♥
complete.caption: 脚、脚步声……？好像是委托组回来了……但我还不想指挥官离开呢♡……

home.captionEn: Commaaander! Welcome baaack! *sniiiff sniiiff*... God, you should really mark this place with your scent.
home.caption: 您回来了，指挥官……（嗅嗅）怎么办呢，好想让指挥官在这里每一处都留下气味……

login.captionEn: Commaaander, welcome baaack. My skin is all sticky and soft and cool... I think you'd really like touching it. Heheheh♥
login.caption: 指挥官……您终于回来了，我身上现在变得冰冰凉凉的……您摸起来的话，一定会觉得很舒服♡……

mail.captionEn: Go ahead and read your letter. In the meanwhile, I'm gonna have my way with you... Heheh...
mail.caption: 您可以查看邮件哦……不过我可能会趁机对您做点什么……嘿嘿♡……

main_1.captionEn: There's just us two in this quiet, cramped little place... Ahh, my heart is beating through my chest! Come closer and listen, Commander♥
main_1.caption: 这地方只有我和指挥官两个人……哈啊，我现在心跳得非常厉害哦……指挥官，来听听看吧……♡

main_2.captionEn: You look awfully hot, Commander. You're sweating even more than me... *sniff sniff*... God, smelling both our odors at the same time is next-level stuff♥
main_2.caption: 指挥官的脸很红哦……看起来现在反而是您容易出汗了……（嗅嗅）整个房间里都是我和指挥官的气味♡……哈……太美妙了♡……

main_3.captionEn: I wasn't lying when I said I wanted to swim with you, I just had a change of heart. This is a rare situation and I need to jump on it. Heheh...
main_3.caption: 想和您一起游泳不是借口哦……只是我中途就改变主意了，毕竟这样的机会很难得嘛，嘿嘿♡……

main_4.captionEn: All this moving around has made my bikini strings mighty tight... Come loosen them up for me, Commander♥
main_4.caption: 因为刚刚一直在动来动去，系带有点勒进去了……指挥官，快点用您的手帮帮我吧♡……

mission.captionEn: Commandeeer... Do you have any "missions" I can do here and now?
mission.caption: 指挥官，要不要在这里，让我也执行些什么任务呢♡……？

mission_complete.captionEn: Wooow, completing missions despite your current situation. Impressive, Commander♥
mission_complete.caption: 这种状态下也能出色地完成任务，真不愧是指挥官呢♡……

touch_body.captionEn: Commandeeer! Between this and my usual clothes, which do you like touching more?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官♡……穿成这样的我和之前的我……哪个触感更棒呢？……

touch_head.captionEn: C-Commander... Talk about sudden... Ahah♥
touch_head.caption: 指、指挥官♡……突然就……哈啊♡……

touch_special.captionEn: Hahh... Ahh... Yes, this is exactly what I locked the door for!
touch_special.caption: 哈……啊……把门紧锁就是为了这一刻哦♡……

home.captionEn: Where were you all this time? Don't tell me... you got lost?
home.caption: 啊，指挥官，你刚刚去哪里了？该不会…是迷路了吧？

login.captionEn: It'll be a bit of a walk, but won't you come along with me?
login.caption: 指挥官，稍微陪我走一段路吧。

main_1.captionEn: I only found this place by pure chance. Thinking back on it, I wonder how I was feeling when I stumbled upon this back alleyway instead of following the main road...
main_1.caption: 这个地方是之前来参拜的时候偶然发现的。回想起来，当时不走大路反而走进这种小路的我究竟是怎样一种心情呢…

main_2.captionEn: Please, watch your step. The road is very narrow.
main_2.caption: 路有点窄，请注意脚下

main_3.captionEn: If we're talking about dressing up properly for the festival, this is definitely the getup. However, I struggled a bit while changing into this. I even got laughed at by Agano. ...*sigh*
main_3.caption: 祭典自然是要换上与之相符的衣裳，不过穿起来确实很麻烦。还因此被阿贺野笑了好久…唉

touch_body.captionEn: Hm... Ah, I'll be fine even if you don't prop me up like that. ...Um, thank you very much.
touch_body.caption: 唔，这里不用扶着我也没问题的…总之，谢谢了。

touch_special.captionEn: Apologize and reflect upon your actions. Don't think that you're going to get away with it just because we're at a festival!
touch_special.caption: 就算是节日，也是免不了反省和检讨的！

complete.captionEn: I've received word that the commission team has returned. Why don't you take a quick break from work and go welcome them back?
complete.caption: 是委托队的伙伴们的回港联络。这点小事也算不上工作，要不先休息一下去迎接她们？

home.captionEn: Welcome back. Care for refreshments? Heehee, make sure to finish the soda before it goes flat.
home.caption: 辛苦了。要不要来点冷饮？里面还有不少气泡，喝的时候要注意一点哦。

login.captionEn: You should enjoy yourself at the beach, just like you ordered me to. Hehe.
login.caption: 好好享受海水吧，就像你要求我的那样，呵呵~

main_1.captionEn: If you're stuck trying to think about what fun things to do next, why don't you ask the others? I'm sure they'd love to join you for anything you'd like.
main_1.caption: 若是不知道接下来要玩什么，不妨问问大家的意见？我也和你一起。

main_2.captionEn: Sakawa... I have an inkling of where she might be. Wouldn't surprise me if she's at a beachside hut somewhere, stuffing her face with sweets. Sigh...
main_2.caption: 酒匂她…我大概知道她在哪了。反正应该就在海边小屋里面享受着甜食吧。

main_3.captionEn: I picked this swimsuit because you told me we were going to play on the beach, but instead... No, never mind. But did you perhaps... want to see me in something more risqué?
main_3.caption: 为了放松玩耍所以选了这件泳装，或许…啊，没什么。还是说，你其实想看…更刺激一些的吗？

touch_body.captionEn: Want another go?
touch_body.caption: 要再来一次吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Wh-where are you touching... *blushes*
touch_special.caption: 这、这里是……///

complete.captionEn: The commission's done? Okay then, take five. Commander, you should probably go out and meet them.
complete.caption: 委托完成了？那中场休息5分钟，指挥官，你先去接她们吧

home.captionEn: Nice work out there, got a request you want me to sing?
home.caption: 辛苦了，就给你唱首歌吧

login.captionEn: Thank you very m–! It's you, Commander.
login.caption: 请多多支持——啊，是指挥官啊

mail.captionEn: There's so many fan letters...! Being an idol is so exhausting...
mail.caption: 今天又收到了好多信件……做偶像也真是不容易

main_1.captionEn: C- Commander... "Jia you! ☆" Was that cute enough...? Don't look at me like that! This is serious business right here!
main_1.caption: 指挥官，你看——加油~这个姿势够不够可爱和吸引人？……干什么那副表情，这是工作，我可不会敷衍

main_2.captionEn: After studying all that kung fu, Idol dancing is a piece of cake for me and Ping Hai! Hah hah!
main_2.caption: 因为学过功夫，偶像的舞蹈功课对我和平海来说简直小菜一碟呢，哼哼！

main_3.captionEn: Oh, right! Commander, next time me and Ping Hai put out a single, we'll definitely save you one.
main_3.caption: 啊，对了，指挥官，我和平海哪天真的出专辑了的话就送你一张吧

mission.captionEn: A new offer...? Heh, hehehehe... Sure, I'll keep packing in as much work as my schedule can take!
mission.caption: 又有新的演出？没问题，在日程表排满前，多少工作我都会做的

mission_complete.captionEn: The fans make me really happy, sure, but next time I'll have to teach them how to save money!
mission_complete.caption: 虽然粉丝们的心意我很高兴，但是，下次我要好好教她们勤俭节约的道理！

touch_body.captionEn: Don't worry, I'm wearing shorts underneath. And anyway if somebody tried something gross, I've got a roundhouse kick with their name on it!
touch_body.caption: 放心吧，下面好好穿着底裤呢——而且，要是遇到图谋不轨的人，我就赏那家伙一记回旋踢

touch_special.captionEn: Roundhouse kick!
touch_special.caption: 吃我回旋踢！

complete.captionEn: Commissions completed. Hehe, don't you want to go check up on them together?
complete.caption: 委托完成了。呵呵，一起去看看吧？

home.captionEn: Make sure you clean every last bit. ...Hehe, I'm talking about the machine, of course.
home.caption: 来好好地把每~一寸地方都洗干净吧。…呵呵，我说的可是这些机械哦？

login.captionEn: Commander, you're working pretty hard. Hehehe, take care not to wear yourself out~♪
login.caption: 指挥官挺努力的嘛。呵呵，小心别累坏了就好♪

main_1.captionEn: Here, let's pop a bottle to practice uncorking the celebratory champagne~ What's wrong, Commander? Are you not going to drink?
main_1.caption: 先来干一杯作为到时候庆祝喝香槟的练习吧~指挥官~怎么，不能喝吗~？

main_2.captionEn: Heinrich wants to compete in the race? How very like her... Wait a second, does she even know how to drive?
main_2.caption: 听说海因里希也想参加比赛？确实像是她会喜欢的……等等，她会开车吗？

main_3.captionEn: Why don't you try getting changed into something too, Hipper? You know the Commander's secretly looking forward to it, right? ...If you want, I'll even lend you the outfit I'm wearing.
main_3.caption: 姐姐你要不要也换一身衣服？指挥官其实很期待的哦…需要的话，我这一身借给你也行哦？

touch_special.captionEn: Just like that~♡
touch_special.caption: 就是这样子的哦♡

home.captionEn: Let's celebrate the wonderful outing we had together, Commander~ It'd be such a waste to not drink one more glass... hmm? Is something wrong? Cat got your tongue?
home.caption: 为庆祝指挥官陪伴的这美好一刻~不再来一杯就太可惜了…嗯？怎么了？有什么在意的吗？

login.captionEn: "Welcome back. What'll be your order?" Is that what you were expecting? Heehee.
login.caption: “欢迎光临，想要喝点什么？”…这时候是不是该这么说才应景呢？呵呵呵~

main_1.captionEn: Hehe. What are you all nervous for? Why don't you sit down at the counter? Here's the wine I recommend.
main_1.caption: 呵呵，别这么紧张，在吧台坐下吧，我给你介绍下我推荐的红酒。

main_2.captionEn: You know, when we ran into Hipper the other day on our day out, she started sulking and turned beet-red the moment she saw your face. I wonder why? Heehee.
main_2.caption: 说起来，之前一起出门遇到希佩尔时，姐姐一看到指挥官就脸红闹别扭了。不知是怎么了呢？呵呵呵~

main_3.captionEn: It's customary to pour wine into a wine glass, but I'd like to try a different container. I wonder how I'd make a cocktail out of it.
main_3.caption: 喝红酒时一般是用玻璃杯，不过将来想也试试用别的容器品尝。酒要怎么调配才好呢？

mission_complete.captionEn: Though I doubt the rewards can beat this moment, shouldn't you go pick them up anyway?
mission_complete.caption: 虽然不觉得有什么奖励能胜过此刻，不过还是去领取一下吧？

touch_special.captionEn: Hehehe, don't be in such a hurry. The night has only just begun♡
touch_special.caption: 呵呵呵，别着急。夜晚才刚刚开始呢♡

home.captionEn: Let's celebrate the wonderful outing we had together, Commander~ It'd be such a waste to not drink one more glass... hmm? Is something wrong? Cat got your tongue?
home.caption: 为庆祝指挥官陪伴的这美好一刻~不再来一杯就太可惜了…嗯？怎么了？有什么在意的吗？

login.captionEn: "Welcome back. What'll be your order?" Is that what you were expecting? Heehee.
login.caption: “欢迎光临，想要喝点什么？”…这时候是不是该这么说才应景呢？呵呵呵~

main_1.captionEn: Hehe. What are you all nervous for? Why don't you sit down at the counter? Here's the wine I recommend.
main_1.caption: 呵呵，别这么紧张，在吧台坐下吧，我给你介绍下我推荐的红酒。

main_2.captionEn: You know, when we ran into Hipper the other day on our day out, she started sulking and turned beet-red the moment she saw your face. I wonder why? Heehee.
main_2.caption: 说起来，之前一起出门遇到希佩尔时，姐姐一看到指挥官就脸红闹别扭了。不知是怎么了呢？呵呵呵~

main_3.captionEn: It's customary to pour wine into a wine glass, but I'd like to try a different container. I wonder how I'd make a cocktail out of it.
main_3.caption: 喝红酒时一般是用玻璃杯，不过将来想也试试用别的容器品尝。酒要怎么调配才好呢？

mission_complete.captionEn: Though I doubt the rewards can beat this moment, shouldn't you go pick them up anyway?
mission_complete.caption: 虽然不觉得有什么奖励能胜过此刻，不过还是去领取一下吧？

touch_special.captionEn: Hehehe, don't be in such a hurry. The night has only just begun♡
touch_special.caption: 呵呵呵，别着急。夜晚才刚刚开始呢♡

home.captionEn: Commander, you must be tired. Ahem! Please have some refreshments while you enjoy my upcoming performance!
home.caption: 辛苦啦~那么，一壶盖碗茶，一碟盐花生，接下来，请欣赏欧若拉的表演吧~

login.captionEn: What kind of performance should I prepare for today? I have too many things to choose from...
login.caption: 那么，今天该为指挥官准备什么样的剧目呢——选择太多有时候也很苦恼呢~
