main_1.captionEn: One of the specialities of Sichuan opera is something called "mask changing." It lets you quickly portray different emotions, or even different characters. Hehe, it took a lot of practice to be able to do this.
main_1.caption: 川剧的一大特色，就是变脸哦，就像这样~您看，各种不同的身份，不同的感情，都可以表现在脸上。嘻嘻，这可是我好不容易才学来的呢

main_2.captionEn: "Behind each minute on the stage is ten years of practice." The Dragon Empery's old adages are quite thought-provoking...
main_2.caption: 台上一分钟，台下十年功，东煌的谚语真是充满了智慧呢。

main_3.captionEn: Commander, do you know how many different types of plays there are in the Dragon Empery?
main_3.caption: 指挥官，您知道东煌的戏曲分多少种吗~

touch_body.captionEn: What are these weapons for? Um, right now, I mostly play the flower girl character, but I hope to be able to play some warriors too! Hehe~
touch_body.caption: 您问背后的武器架？这个啊，虽然我是花旦，但是一直很想试试刀马旦呢~

touch_special.captionEn: C-Commander?! If you keep this up, I'm going to use my polearm and sword, and um... it's going to hurt!
touch_special.caption: 指、指挥官？再这样，就要让你尝尝我身后的刀枪了…会很疼的哦？

complete.captionEn: Commander, can I go with you to welcome everyone home?
complete.caption: 指挥官，要平海和你一起去接大家吗？

login.captionEn: Commander, are you here for my show?
login.caption: 指挥官，来看平海的演出吗？

mail.captionEn: Commander, can you help me reply to all this fan mail? I can't do it all by myself...
mail.caption: 指挥官，可以帮平海一个忙吗？给粉丝回信，平海忙不过来

main_1.captionEn: Big sister says all I need to do is be myself up on stage, but the truth is I don't know how to be myself unless she tells me...
main_1.caption: 姐姐说，平海在舞台上只要做自己就好了，但是，平海平时都要听姐姐的话才知道要做什么……

main_2.captionEn: Commander, do you think I should try doing kung fu up on stage? Like this.. hiyaa!
main_2.caption: 指挥官，平海在舞台上给大家表演功夫可以吗？像这样，嘿——呀——！

main_3.captionEn: I think everybody really likes Baobao. Let me do a show with Baobao next time!
main_3.caption: 大家好像很喜欢二宝和平海一起演出，下次，让二宝也一起上台吧~

mission.captionEn: Big sister says more offers means more money...
mission.caption: 姐姐说，演出要尽量去接，这样才能赚到很多钱

mission_complete.captionEn: They gave me so much good stuff to eat. I love it!
mission_complete.caption: 大家给平海送了好多好吃的，好开心

touch_body.captionEn: Commander, you want to get up on stage with me?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官也要和平海一起上台演出吗？

touch_special.captionEn: I think I'm wearing it right?
touch_special.caption: 平海有好好穿着哦

home.captionEn: I'm... so hungry... Maybe just a little bite... No! Ning Hai told me not to!
home.caption: 平海肚子饿了，只吃掉一点点蛋糕的话……不行不行！平海要听姐姐的话！

login.captionEn: Here's your cake. Eat up. Ning Hai is passing out blueberry cake, but I've got strawberry.
login.caption: 指挥官，这份蛋糕是你的！和姐姐分的蓝莓味不一样，平海分的是草莓味哦。

main_1.captionEn: Baobao, where do I bring the next slice...?
main_1.caption: 二宝，下一块蛋糕要送到哪桌呀……？

main_2.captionEn: There's going to be so much good stuff at the party... Commander, they have to have some baozi, don't they?!
main_2.caption: 指挥官，既然宴会上有很多好吃的，那也一定会有很多包子吧！！

main_3.captionEn: Ning Hai always says I need to make more friends... But really I have so many friends already!
main_3.caption: 姐姐总说平海要多交些新的朋友。平海现在已经有很多很多的朋友了！

touch_body.captionEn: Ning Hai told me to pass out my cake without bothering the Commander!
touch_body.caption: 姐姐说，送蛋糕的事情就不用麻烦指挥官了！

touch_special.captionEn: Mm. I've known for a long time, my sister and I are very different in that department.
touch_special.caption: 唔，平海其实一早就注意到了，这里和姐姐差很多呢。

complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned to port. I shall accompany you to them.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了，我将伴您一同迎接。

home.captionEn: A salute for the Commander's return! By the way, bring me along for the next sortie, would you?
home.caption: 向指挥官的归队敬礼！那么，下次出击的时候，理所当然会把我编入队伍的对吧？

login.captionEn: The Commander has arrived! ...I know that's not what a maid would say, but it's not like I could pull it off anyway...
login.caption: 指挥官来了！…就算你说我台词不对，我也做不来女仆那种的…

main_1.captionEn: While Royal Maids also participate in battle, their approach differs greatly from us knights. The only way I can put it is... they hold back too much?
main_1.caption: 虽说女仆队也会战斗，不过和骑士还是不一样呢。该说太拘谨了还是…说不清就是了。

main_2.captionEn: Yes, Master? ..."Getting the hang of this," eh... Are you making fun of me?
main_2.caption: 主人，有什么事？…说我有模有样的……是在挖苦我吗？

main_3.captionEn: I alone get to protect you, my honourable Commander. No one will take this privilege from me!
main_3.caption: 现在守卫着引以为傲的指挥官的人，是我前卫——交给我的任务绝不会让给任何人！

main_5.captionEn: I have both secretary AND maid work to do... *sigh*... Will I ever get to sortie again?
main_5.caption: 除了秘书舰的工作之外，还有女仆的工作…唉…什么时候才能出击呢……

mission.captionEn: You have a new mission, Master. Please review it.
mission.caption: 新的任务来了，请做好应对。

touch_body.captionEn: As you say. Your wish is my command.
touch_body.caption: 是的主人，请您尽管吩咐。

touch_special.captionEn: Compare me to any of the other maids and I'll destroy you.
touch_special.caption: 要是敢跟女仆队其他的人比较，我就戳了你的眼睛。

login.captionEn: Didn't we agree to go to the beach? Where were you?
login.caption: 不是说好一起去沙滩吗？你去哪了

main_1.captionEn: Is there a nice vantage point on the beach to sit at? ...There isn't? Oh well...
main_1.caption: 沙滩上有什么很高的可以坐的地方吗？……没有吗…好吧

main_2.captionEn: I only wore this... "clothing" because you told me to. If you didn't come to the beach with me, I'd be... rather upset.
main_2.caption: 这件衣服是你说了我才会穿上的，要是你不和我去沙滩，我会……比较生气

main_3.captionEn: Eugen, don't rush me, the commander is still working. What am I going to do on the beach by myself...
main_3.caption: 欧根，不要催我，指挥官还在工作，我一个人在沙滩又有什么意思呢…

touch_body.captionEn: Is it time to depart? Wait a moment, these shoes are a bit hard to put on... Come help me out for a second...
touch_body.caption: 要出发了吗？等一下，鞋子有点难穿……来帮我一下

touch_special.captionEn: Hmph... Commander, do you also wish to become food for this child here?
touch_special.caption: 哼，你也想成为这孩子的食粮吗，指挥官？

complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned. We'll continue after you've welcomed the girls back.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了。指挥官，先去迎接她们，然后我们再继续吧。

home.captionEn: Confirming activation of energy circuit. I can move more now. You should recharge your batteries as well, Commander. Just give me your order.
home.caption: 已确认能量回路的启动。嗯，这样就更有活力了——指挥官也需要进行能量补给。你可以随时告诉我你的要求。

login.captionEn: Eagle Union bunny girl Kearsarge will charm you tonight. Don't worry, I can keep dancing as long as you're watching my– Oh. I don't recommend staying up all night for it.
login.caption: 白鹰兔女郎·奇尔沙治，今晚为指挥官带来魅惑一夜。请放心，只要你还在注视着我，我就能一直舞蹈下去——啊。最好不要勉强自己熬夜哦？

main_1.captionEn: Confirming rise in vital signs. Heart rate, pulse, body temperature, and... Ahem. Is this what is called a "state of arousal"?
main_1.caption: 监测到生命体征上升。心率、脉搏、体温，还有……咳，这算是一种兴奋状态吗？

main_2.captionEn: This pole was originally installed to suit your needs in all kinds of scenarios. Naturally, this performance will go perfectly... Heh.
main_2.caption: 原本就是为了应对各种场合下您的需要而设计的，自然为您而进行的表演也不会有任何纰漏。……如何（得意）？

main_3.captionEn: ...Oh. Right, I'm still in the middle of my pop-up store performance. Have you been watching me, Commander?
main_3.caption: ……啊，说起来现在还是模拟店内表演的中途呢。指挥官，有好好看我的表演吗？

main_4.captionEn: Let me show you some moves New Jersey taught me. I even made a few original modifications, based on the data from your reactions.
main_4.caption: 让我来展示新泽西传授的舞步吧。呵呵，我还加了一些自己的原创，都是基于你的反应数据加入的哦。

main_5.captionEn: (Kearsarge's breathing is faintly audible. Is she meditating again, or is she just pondering what to do for her next performance?)
main_5.caption: ……（听到了奇尔沙治的细微呼吸声。是在进行常规的冥想，还是在思考如何进行下一场表演呢……？）

mission.captionEn: Confirming there are unfinished missions... but right now, you're meant to enjoy my performance. The missions can wait.
mission.caption: 确认有尚未完成的任务。……现在是让指挥官休息的时候。任务待会儿再完成也没关系。

mission_complete.captionEn: Confirming that mission rewards have arrived. Would you mind getting it yourself, Commander?
mission_complete.caption: 确认任务报酬已送达。指挥官，抱歉……能麻烦你去领取吗？

touch_body.captionEn: Mhh... Is that better?
touch_body.caption: 嗯……这样可以吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Confirming activation of contact circuit... Oh, um, you could increase the contact area for greater efficiency...
touch_special.caption: 已确认接触回路启动。……啊，嗯，如果能更有效地增加接触面积的话……

complete.captionEn: The commission fleet has returned. Sorry, but could you welcome them back in my place?
complete.caption: 委托组的伙伴们回来了啊。抱歉，能麻烦你去迎接么？

home.captionEn: Good work, Commander. Go ahead and take a break, I'll handle the follow-up work for the others.
home.caption: 指挥官，辛苦了。你先稍微休息一下吧，后续大家的后援工作交给我就好。

login.captionEn: Let's do our best today. I'll be cheering you on.
login.caption: 今天也加油吧。我已经做好应援的准备了。

main_1.captionEn: Is that... Zuikaku? That's a pretty showy outfit... though I'm not exactly in a position to talk myself.
main_1.caption: 那是…瑞鹤？衣服还挺夸张的啊…不过…我也没什么资格说别人的样子呢。

main_2.captionEn: Essex, be careful when you're charging ahead! ...Oh, um, I didn't mean to patronize, I just can't help but get a bit worried...
main_2.caption: 埃塞克斯，前进的时候要冷静点！…咳咳。抱歉，我没有说教的打算，只是忍不住担心起来…

main_3.captionEn: You'd like to help me with the maintenance? Sure. To be honest, you might be better suited for this job. Ahaha~
main_3.caption: 要帮忙维修…？明白了。老实说，也许你更适合做这个呢，哈哈哈。

touch_body.captionEn: A photo op? Sure, but what kind of pose should I make?
touch_body.caption: 拍照吗？我知道了，要我摆什么样的姿势？

touch_special.captionEn: That's against the rules, Commander.
touch_special.caption: 这是犯规的哦，指挥官。

complete.captionEn: The commission fleet has returned. Sorry, but could you welcome them back in my place?
complete.caption: 委托组的伙伴们回来了啊。抱歉，能麻烦你去迎接么？

home.captionEn: Good work, Commander. Go ahead and take a break, I'll handle the follow-up work for the others.
home.caption: 指挥官，辛苦了。你先稍微休息一下吧，后续大家的后援工作交给我就好。

login.captionEn: Let's do our best today. I'll be cheering you on.
login.caption: 今天也加油吧。我已经做好应援的准备了。

main_1.captionEn: Is that... Zuikaku? That's a pretty showy outfit... though I'm not exactly in a position to talk myself.
main_1.caption: 那是…瑞鹤？衣服还挺夸张的啊…不过…我也没什么资格说别人的样子呢。

main_2.captionEn: Essex, be careful when you're charging ahead! ...Oh, um, I didn't mean to patronize, I just can't help but get a bit worried...
main_2.caption: 埃塞克斯，前进的时候要冷静点！…咳咳。抱歉，我没有说教的打算，只是忍不住担心起来…

main_3.captionEn: You'd like to help me with the maintenance? Sure. To be honest, you might be better suited for this job. Ahaha~
main_3.caption: 要帮忙维修…？明白了。老实说，也许你更适合做这个呢，哈哈哈。

touch_body.captionEn: A photo op? Sure, but what kind of pose should I make?
touch_body.caption: 拍照吗？我知道了，要我摆什么样的姿势？

touch_special.captionEn: That's against the rules, Commander.
touch_special.caption: 这是犯规的哦，指挥官。

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back home. What do you wanna do? Should we get out and go see 'em?
complete.caption: 委托组的孩子们回来了。怎么办？先上岸吗？

home.captionEn: Good work today, Commander. Do you have some time after you review the mission? Uh, it's nothing related to fighting. It's just, the order you put this gear on is really complex...
home.caption: 指挥官，辛苦了。总结完之后有空吗？啊，不是关于战斗。是这套装备的穿着顺序有些复杂……

login.captionEn: ...Phew, okay, I'm getting used to this. Are you okay, Commander? I appreciate you joining me, but, uh... Don't push yourself too much.
login.caption: …呼，稍微适应些了。指挥官还好吗？很高兴你能陪着我，就是嗯…希望你不要太勉强自己。

mail.captionEn: ...Eagle? Oh, just new mail, huh?
mail.caption: …小鹰？啊，是来新邮件了。

main_1.captionEn: Diving with a buddy is a really rational way of doing things, right? It's reassuring to have a partner when things go south.
main_1.caption: 潜水时规定需要有一个潜伴，想来的确合理。万一发生什么状况，有伙伴在身边真的很令人安心。

main_2.captionEn: Who's that over there... Hornet? She's going crazy on that jet ski. You've ridden with Hornet, haven't you, Commander? How was it?
main_2.caption: 在那边的是…大黄蜂吗？真是马力十足呢...对了指挥官，和她一起乘坐快艇的感觉如何？

main_3.captionEn: Diving and flying are a lot alike, when you think of it as moving freely in three dimensions. We oughta try out skydiving sometime, Commander.
main_3.caption: 在现实里可以自由移动这一点上，潜水和跳伞挺相似的。指挥官，下次我想试试一起跳伞。

mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, our bonus is here. Can't wait for tonight's barbecue!
mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，奖励送来了。真期待晚上的烧烤大会。

touch_body.captionEn: Need some help?
touch_body.caption: 需要帮忙吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Ack...! That wasn't on purpose, was it?
touch_special.caption: 啊...！是...是事故吗？

home.captionEn: Would you stop comin' here right after returning to port? Don't want people catching wind of this place and turning it into a playground.
home.caption: 别一回来就往我这里跑，我可不想这里变成派对场地

login.captionEn: Don't you go touchin' my stuff without permission! I'll knock ya out cold.
login.caption: 别乱动我的东西，小心我把你轰飞

main_1.captionEn: Sorry, but this hammock's only big enough for one of us. Ya wanna relax, get your own. I ain't your personal servant.
main_1.caption: 吊床只有一张，想休息自己想办法，我可不是你的保姆

main_2.captionEn: Just how much damn work do you have if you're even bringin' it up here...? You just like being with me...? Tsk...
main_2.caption: 竟然把工作也带到这里来做，你就这么喜欢这个地方吗？……喜欢和我相处？啧……

main_3.captionEn: Wha–? Is... Is that Surcouf? The hell... How'd she end up dozing off in here? That girl's a real piece of work.
main_3.caption: …咳咳咳！什么玩意…这不是絮库夫吗，啧，这家伙是怎么找到这里还睡得这么香的？真是麻烦的家伙

touch_body.captionEn: Ack! Don't put your damn ice-cold soda on me! You're on thin ice, buddy...
touch_body.caption: ……！用冰可乐搞突然袭击，你这家伙，最近胆子越来越大了啊

touch_special.captionEn: You're not the only one who can do whatever ya want just 'cause nobody else will come here. I can, too. Understand?
touch_special.caption: 没人会来不意味着只有你可以为所欲为——我也可以，明白吗？

home.captionEn: You're back? Seems you've got girls queuein' up to meet you. Me, not so much...
home.caption: 结束了？想要见你的同伴们都排起队了。…我可不是啊……

login.captionEn: Work, same as always, huh? Tell me if there's anything I oughta know.
login.caption: 今天也要干活吗？有什么我能帮忙的就说一声吧。

main_1.captionEn: Sakura Empire-style badminton? Sounds fun. I'll knock that shuttlecock beyond the horizon!
main_1.caption: 打羽板球？有意思，就让这羽球一直飞到海平线的尽头吧！

main_2.captionEn: I hate it when people approach me to either give or get a hug. Never asked for their damn compassion.
main_2.caption: 什么都不做小家伙们就会自己蹭上来，真想要摸的时候又…真是的…唔，我可不需要你的同情

main_3.captionEn: Wagashi, for me? Thanks. Dunkerque sure is considerate as always.
main_3.caption: 敦刻尔克新做的日式点心？谢谢。她手脚还真快。

touch_body.captionEn: What, you wanna see me brandish one of these?
touch_body.caption: 想看我挥舞这玩意儿吗？

touch_head.captionEn: Hmh...
touch_head.caption: ……呼

touch_special.captionEn: Umph! What now?!
touch_special.caption: ……！？你干嘛？

main_1.captionEn: How I wish I could bring this chair with me on sorties... Helena, could you help upgrade my rigging?
main_1.caption: 如果出击的时候也能带着这把椅子就好了……海伦娜，能帮我改造下舰装吗？

main_2.captionEn: I am Lucky Lou. I may not look like it, but I actually have experience with fortune-telling.
main_2.caption: 身为Lucky Lou，我对推算运势很拿手哦

main_3.captionEn: Brr... It's actually a bit cold... Commander, could you come a little closer and... share your body heat with me?
main_3.caption: 哇，果然还是有点冷啊，指挥官，再靠近我一点，帮我暖暖手吧~

touch_special.captionEn: Oh, do you mean I've put it on wrong? Have I really...?
touch_special.caption: 欸，这里的穿法不对？真的吗（怀疑）？

home.captionEn: Welcome back. I've put on the heater for you. Oh, me? I'd like to stay here and enjoy the snow a little longer.
home.caption: 欢迎回来，房间里的暖气已经开好了。我？让我再坐会儿吧

login.captionEn: You should drink a little something to warm yourself up before getting to work.
login.caption: 工作之前，先来一杯小酒暖暖身子吧

main_1.captionEn: A "hatsumode," huh... Do you have any wishes to make, Commander? It so happens I don't, so you can have my wish.
main_1.caption: 重樱的新年参拜啊……指挥官有什么愿望吗？我没什么愿望，帮你一起许也可以哦？

main_2.captionEn: Not to say the Eagle Union's new year celebrations are lonesome, but the Sakura Empire's and Dragon Empery definitely celebrate New Year's with more festivity. And I like festivities.
main_2.caption: 白鹰的新年虽然也不算冷清，不过可没有重樱和东煌这么热闹，我果然还是喜欢热闹的场合呢~

main_3.captionEn: Oh, Commander, if you're hoping to get me drunk... well, it depends on how much you yourself can drink. Ahahah~
main_3.caption: 指挥官，想灌醉我的话，可要看你的本事咯？

touch_body.captionEn: Are we heading out? Ahah, then let me get out my umbrella. Hey, come closer, otherwise you'll get snow on your clothes.
touch_body.caption: 要出去吗？那我来为你撑伞吧，靠近一点，不然会被雪碰到的

home.captionEn: Do you have everything, Commander? We're not driving back if you forgot to bring something.
home.caption: 没有遗漏的东西了吧？再有我也不管了哦？

login.captionEn: The view here is lovely~ Let's pull over for a moment to take in the winds of good luck.
login.caption: 景色不错呢，在这里稍微吹吹风如何？

mail.captionEn: Helena messaged me, saying the party's starting soon. Check your mail, then let's hurry on back to the venue.
mail.caption: 哎呀，海伦娜来短信说宴会要开始了，看来我们在这里待的有点久了呢……走吧，指挥官

main_1.captionEn: Oh dear, was that... Jamaica? Hehehe... Fasten your seatbelt, Commander. This'll be a bit of a wild ride.
main_1.caption: 哎呀，刚刚经过的摩托骑手……是牙买加吧？……呵呵，指挥官，上座，系好安全带，接下来会有点刺激哦？

main_2.captionEn: You want to use my car? You can, of course, but promise me one thing in return: take Honolulu on a nice trip.
main_2.caption: 指挥官，要是你想向我借车的话也可以，不过你要答应我，至少要去邀请一次火奴鲁鲁出去兜风，好吗？

main_3.captionEn: Whew... Finally we've arrived at the party. Now, Commander, wait here for thirty minutes while I reapply my makeup. Relax, I'm just joking! Hehehe~
main_3.caption: 呼，终于到了宴会场地了呢……指挥官，等我一下哦，我要稍微补个妆，嗯……半个小时就够了~呵呵，开玩笑的

mission.captionEn: You have an urgent mission? I'll wait another five minutes for you, then.
mission.caption: 紧急任务？我只会等你5分钟哦，指挥官~

mission_complete.captionEn: Oh, you went and claimed those mission rewards? You could've taken your time if you wanted. Hehehe~
mission_complete.caption: 哎呀，任务完成了吗？不要那么急也没关系的哦？呵呵

touch_body.captionEn: Let's see here... Ah, thanks, Commander. Hehehe, you're getting quite good at this.
touch_body.caption: 哎呀，指挥官也变得会察言观色了呢，确实，我的脚有些麻了……呵呵，那就麻烦你扶我一下了

complete.captionEn: You want to go greet the commission team? Oh, fine... I'll help you change clothes♥
complete.caption: 要去迎接回来的委托组？真是没办法呢~我来帮指挥官把衣服穿上吧♥

home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. Want a drink? Unfortunately, I only have one straw...
home.caption: 欢迎回来，要不要喝点饮料？但是只有一根吸管了哦，或者，让我喂你也可以呢~

login.captionEn: Welcome back. Heheh, I think my sunscreen is starting to wear off. Commander, it's time for you to make up for making me wait♪
login.caption: 终于来了，我身上的防晒乳都要失效了~指挥官可要好好负起责任哦？

mail.captionEn: You've got mail. Wanna check it after we relax a little longer?
mail.caption: 好像有邮件到了，不如先休息会儿再去看吧~

main_1.captionEn: I've been waiting for you so long that I'm all hot and flushed now. Hm? A cold drink is nowhere near enough. Heheheh... You'll have to think of other methods.
main_1.caption: 指挥官，我一直在这里等你，身上都被晒得有些发烫呢。嗯？光喝冰镇饮料可不够……还需要其它的降温手段呢~

main_2.captionEn: ...Mmh, this swimsuit's a little tight. Geez... Commander, can't you help me out a little? Yeah, that's the spot.
main_2.caption: 衣服……有些勒住了呢，真是不太方便，指挥官，能不能过来帮我调整一下……就在那里~

main_3.captionEn: Wanna lie down on my floatie with me, Commander? We can probably fit together. Or do you wanna snuggle in closer?♪
main_3.caption: 指挥官~跟我一起趴在泳圈上休息一会如何，应该可以挤得下哦~还是说，指挥官想要更亲密的接触呢~？

main_4.captionEn: Going on this cruise with you was a great idea. Watching the sea together is refreshing.
main_4.caption: 邮轮之旅的感觉很不错哦，以这种方式与你一同欣赏海上的风景，让人觉得很是新鲜呢。

main_5.captionEn: Do you think traveling with Lucky Lou herself might bring you good luck? Heheh, I know eeeven better ways for you to... get lucky♥
main_5.caption: 嗯？与Lucky Lou一起出游，觉得自己的运势也变好了？呵呵~我还有让指挥官的运势变得更好一点的方·法·哦♥

mission.captionEn: I wanted you all to myself for a little longer, but it looks like you still have missions left.
mission.caption: 哎呀，虽然很想再独占指挥官一会儿，但还有任务要完成呢……

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! As a reward, I'll put your sunscreen on for you. Mind if I touch you, Commander?♪
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了哦~作为奖励，就让指挥官来我怀里，由我为指挥官涂上防晒乳，如何~？

touch_body.captionEn: You'll put my sunscreen on for me? Okay. Then I'm all yours, Commander. Heehee.
touch_body.caption: 要帮我涂防晒乳吗？没问题，那我就把全身都交给指挥官了哦，呵呵~

touch_head.captionEn: Heehee. Is that enough to satisfy you, Commander?
touch_head.caption: 呵呵，指挥官只是这样就满足了吗~？

touch_special.captionEn: Geez, you're impatient, Commander... You can't bear to wait anymore, can you?♥
touch_special.caption: 指挥官真是心急……不过这也就意味着，我也不用再忍耐了呢~

complete.captionEn: The commissions have been completed. Please leave their reception to me. There's no need for you to waste your time, Officer.
complete.caption: 委托完成了。让我去迎接她们吧，不需要用上你的时间。

home.captionEn: Go take a break, and leave the deliberation to me. It's not yet time for you to make your appearance, Officer.
home.caption: 战术总结交给我就好，后面的事情就不需要你烦恼了。

login.captionEn: So you're working over the holidays. How commendable of you.
login.caption: 节庆时刻也不忘应做的工作，指挥官，值得表扬。

main_1.captionEn: I hear this is the time of year when New Year's gifts are handed out. Officer, would you rather be the one handing out the gifts or receiving them?
main_1.caption: 重樱的习俗里，这时候是要发“压岁钱”的吧，指挥官，你是希望收到我的，还是发给我呢？

main_2.captionEn: Eugen, Heinrich, there's a limit to how much rucku... teasing you should do.
main_2.caption: 即便是节庆，闹腾也要适可而止哦，欧根、海因里希。

main_3.captionEn: Graf Zeppelin, why don't you try studying the Sakura Empire's shrines? Even if you don't pay your respects to their gods, the Sakura Empire's amazake seems quite interesting.
main_3.caption: 齐柏林，一起去重樱的神社参观参观如何？即便不“参拜神明”，尝试下重樱的“甜酒”也是挺好的。

touch_body.captionEn: The plan already takes the holidays into account. There won't be a problem even if you take some time off to rest, Officer.
touch_body.caption: 之前定制的工作计划中已经将这些节日也计算进去了，所以稍微休息一下也无妨哦，指挥官？

touch_special.captionEn: Officer, are you telling me that this much is enough for you to not be able to hold back?
touch_special.caption: 这样就把持不住了可不太行哦，指挥官。

home.captionEn: "Commander, you did so well...! Commander, keep at it...!" That should be idolish enough, right?
home.caption: 指挥官辛苦了，指挥官真棒——偶像似乎应该这么做的样子

login.captionEn: Commander, do you mind if I practice here?
login.caption: 指挥官，我在这里练习可以吗？

mail.captionEn: Commander, I got a new offer. Should I take it?
mail.caption: 指挥官，有新的演出邀请，我应该去吗？

main_1.captionEn: Um... Maybe it's because I'm so used to working with everyone, but I feel like it's actually pretty easy being onstage.
main_1.caption: 嗯……是因为已经和大家熟悉起来的原因吗，感觉，在舞台上表演，也没有想象中那么困难

main_2.captionEn: Commander, do you think you can stop my sister from getting everyone to hold up those "World's♡Cutest" signs when I go on? It's really embarrassing...
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你能让姐姐不要每次演出的时候都让人举“铁血♡最可爱”的牌子吗，那个实在是太丢人了……

main_3.captionEn: Idols are there to make people smile... I never thought I could do something like that.
main_3.caption: 偶像，是为其他人带去笑容的职业……真不可思议，原来我也能做到这样的事

touch_body.captionEn: These hands are no longer weapons of war, but for returning the admiration of my fans. Right, I can do this...!
touch_body.caption: 这双手，如今不仅仅是为了战斗，更是为了响应大家的应援而存在的。嗯，我会加油的…！

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, have you forgotten what my hands can do?
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，没忘记这双手原本是做什么的吧？

home.captionEn: Excellent work. How's the stage-setting going? ...Oh, the camera was rolling. Please send that take to the cutting room floor.
home.caption: 辛苦了，场地的布景设置工作还顺利吧？……啊，现在还是拍摄中，刚刚的就算NG吧。

login.captionEn: Perfect timing, Comrade Commander. Everything is prepped and ready. Give the order to sortie.
login.caption: 来得正好，指挥官同志。一切准备已就绪，请下达作战指令。

main_1.captionEn: Did you think you could escape justice by hiding in a fortified skyscraper? You banked on a naive hope – which I'm now going to crush.
main_1.caption: 妄想着躲在坚固的高楼之中，就能回避正义的突击么……呵呵，这样天真的幻想，就由我来粉碎。

main_2.captionEn: That was a pretty visually stunning take, wasn't it? ...Hm? You're worried your performance as my rival won't be that good? I understand. Once we're done filming, let's go find a place for you to rehearse.
main_2.caption: ……刚刚的那一幕，很有冲击力吧？嗯？开始担心无法接下我的对手戏了？那这场拍摄结束后，找个人少的地方，我来指导你吧。

main_3.captionEn: Changing careers and trying a different life... It's more fun than I expected. I'd love to do this again if I ever get the chance.
main_3.caption: ……换个身份，享受不一样的人生，对我来说意外地有趣。以后要是还有这种类型的拍摄，我还想试试看。

touch_body.captionEn: My way in is... Rappel down from the roof, then break directly into the room with the objective. A plan full of highlights, it seems.
touch_body.caption: 进攻路线是……从楼顶索降，直接突入目标所在的房间……还真是充满看点的路线呢。

touch_special.captionEn: So you like roleplay, do you, Comrade Commander?
touch_special.caption: 指挥官同志……原来你喜欢这种刺激的“玩法”啊……

home.captionEn: Ah, Commander, welcome back... I'm making a lantern... Would you mind helping me hang it up?
home.caption: 啊，指挥官，欢迎回来…我在做灯笼…一会能麻烦指挥官帮忙挂起来吗？

login.captionEn: Fu Shun gets really excited around the Spring Festival, and will even drag Chang Chun and me around...
login.caption: 一到春节抚顺姐姐就特别兴奋呢，还会拉着我和长春姐姐到处跑……

main_1.captionEn: F-Fu Shun, it... it's dangerous to take apart firecrackers like that... Eh? You're doing an experiment?
main_1.caption: 抚、抚顺姐姐，这、这样拆爆竹很危险的啦……欸？要做新的试验？

main_2.captionEn: This year's couplet... Um, Commander, can you help me brainstorm ideas?
main_2.caption: 今年的对联…唔，指挥官也来帮忙想想吧？

main_3.captionEn: Chang Chun, it's a once-in-a-year occasion, it's not good to stay inside your room all day...
main_3.caption: 长春姐姐，难得过年，不要一直待在房间里啦…

touch_body.captionEn: I made this outfit myself. My sisters all said it looks good, ehehe...
touch_body.caption: 这身衣服是我自己做的，姐姐们都说好看呢，欸嘿嘿…

touch_special.captionEn: C-commander... if you keep messing around, someone's going to get mad!
touch_special.caption: 呜…指、指挥官，乱来的话，这孩子会生气的！

complete.captionEn: The commission is complete. Take it easy and relax, Commander.
complete.caption: 委托结束了。主上，请放松休息吧。

home.captionEn: You returned right on time. How punctual of you, Commander. Hahaha, I'm just happy that my strategies could help.
home.caption: 不愧是主上，恰如计划地归来了呢。呵呵，天城的作战能帮上忙，真是太好了。

login.captionEn: Care for some Sakura confections, Commander? Hiei and the others made a whole bunch, and I just can't stop myself... Heehee, I'm sure Akagi will be worried about me again.
login.caption: 主上也来一个吗？比叡她们准备的重樱点心，一不小心就想伸手一探…呵呵，又要被赤城她们担心了呢

main_1.captionEn: I've heard that in Sardegna, they have banquets where you eat lying down. Why don't you try it out, Commander? Heehee!
main_1.caption: 听说古时候的撒丁有躺着享受的宴会，主上也试着效仿一次如何？呵呵~

main_2.captionEn: Katsuragi, prattling on for too long will only bother the Commander. At least divide your monologue into two... No, four or five segments would be better...
main_2.caption: 葛城，一次性说太多主上只会觉得困扰哦？至少分成一半…不，按这个分量，应该分4、5次传达比较好…

main_3.captionEn: Commander, I know the feast is bountiful, but try not to eat too much, okay? Call it... advice from an expert. Hahaha!
main_3.caption: 主上，即使宴会的菜单再怎么豪华，也要注意别吃太多哦？嗯，这就算是…经验之谈吧。呵呵

mission.captionEn: Commander, may I accompany you on your next mission?
mission.caption: 主上，下次任务也能让我一起吗？

mission_complete.captionEn: Your mission rewards are here. Yes, I think the fruits of our efforts ought to be reflected in the coming banquet.
mission_complete.caption: 任务报酬送到了。嗯，像这样的努力也反应到了宴会丰富的菜单上呢。

touch_special.captionEn: Mm... I already know what you're thinking and feeling, Commander. Heehee!
touch_special.caption: 嗯…主上的所思所想，我已经摸得一清二楚了哦。呵呵~

login.captionEn: No matter where we are, I shall do my utmost to keep you safe. My honourable Master, simply enjoy yourself, however you please.
login.caption: 无论在何处，天狼星都会侍奉并保护好主人。主人只要做自己想做的事就好。

main_1.captionEn: My honourable Master, why are you staring at me so intently? Did this humble maid err somewhere?! ...I'm overthinking things...?
main_1.caption: 主人，为何一直看着天狼星？莫，莫非我给主人带来了困扰？…是我多虑了吗…

main_2.captionEn: Swimming? If... if you wouldn't mind teaching me... Um, sorry, a lowly maid has no right to request your valuable time...
main_2.caption: 游泳吗？如，如果主人能教我的话……不，区区女仆，无权劳烦主人……

main_3.captionEn: My honourable Master, are you tired? Something to rest on...? ...Um, if you wouldn't mind, then... feel free to use my body...!
main_3.caption: 主人是累了吗？方便休息的地方……唔……如果主人不嫌弃的话，就，就用天狼星的身体代替吧！

touch_body.captionEn: My honourable Master, allow me to protect you from the sun.
touch_body.caption: 就让天狼星为你遮挡阳光吧，我骄傲的主人。

touch_special.captionEn: Understood. If you would like to see me in a bikini, then... Is, is that so? I'm terribly sorry... I prematurely jumped to conclusions yet again.
touch_special.caption: 我明白了，我骄傲的主人，如果您希望身着泳装的天狼星…—啊…又会错意了吗？万分抱歉……

login.captionEn: Commander, there's no need to rush yourself. There is meaning in simply waiting for you.
login.caption: 指挥官，不用急，对我来说，等你是一件有意义的事

main_1.captionEn: As long as you're by my side, even looking off into the horizon is meaningful.
main_1.caption: 和你一起在沙滩，即使只是坐着看海平线，也丝毫不会觉得无聊

main_2.captionEn: Some of my colleagues seem to mistake me for some unapproachable ice queen... Perhaps playing beach volleyball with them would help...
main_2.caption: 部分同僚对我似乎有些误解，我并不是深居闺中的大小姐…呼，稍微陪她们玩玩好了，排球之类的

main_3.captionEn: The sunset and the beach at night are wonderful views. When you're done with work, want to accompany me for a walk along the shore?
main_3.caption: 夕阳下和夜晚的沙滩景色很美，工作结束后一起去散散步吗？

mission.captionEn: Even I can't get fired up about doing missions during the summer... because it's too hot...
mission.caption: 就算是我，在夏天时也不会热衷于完成任务的，因为…很热

touch_body.captionEn: It's a bit stuffy... Commander, would you mind turning up the air conditioner?
touch_body.caption: 稍微有些热……指挥官，空调能开大一点吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Even though it's summer... there are still some things you shouldn't do...
touch_special.caption: 既然是夏天……也是没办法的事

home.captionEn: Would you care to sunbathe with me? It's delightfully pleasant, I assure you.
home.caption: 指挥官，你也过来晒一会儿太阳吧，很舒服的

login.captionEn: Basking in the sunlight, feeling the sea breeze, and listening to the sound of the waves... Ahh, it's wonderful to have a relaxing day off.
login.caption: 海风，海浪，阳光……真是个惬意的假日呢

main_1.captionEn: Only when you take the time to recline can you truly take in the beauty of the vast, blue sea. One day, we will have finally reclaimed it in its entirety. Won't we, Commander?
main_1.caption: 像这样放松下来的时候，又一次感受到这片大海的美丽呢…总有一天，我们会靠自己的双手将它夺回来，对吧，指挥官？

main_2.captionEn: Are you going fishing, Commander? I see, then if you don't mind, I will take my leave for a while. I'd like to finish building my sand Colosseum.
main_2.caption: 虽然大海很美丽，不过，如果指挥官想在这里钓鱼的话，我就先不奉陪了…我的罗马角斗场才刚堆了一半呢

main_3.captionEn: Please do come and spectate our beach volleyball game later in the evening, Commander. If luck is on our side, you may get to see us go up against the Royal Navy's team.
main_3.caption: 对了，指挥官，下午的沙滩排球大会不要忘记来观看。和皇家几位过去曾经错过的宿命对决，也许会在这里延续哦

touch_body.captionEn: Littorio said I am terrible at photography and now she prohibits me from using the camera. Why, I've never heard something so rude before... Commander, would you ask her to let me take a picture?
touch_body.caption: 利托里奥说我的摄影技术太差了，所以禁止我给她照相，有这么糟糕吗……指挥官，我给你照一张试试看吧？

touch_special.captionEn: Commander? I'm still awake, for your information.
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，我醒着哦？

home.captionEn: How about doing something else for a change of pace? Just let me know if you want to spend some time together, whether it's inside the banquet hall or outside.
home.caption: 稍微喘口气吧，无论是宴会场还是外面，若需要我陪你，知会一声就好。

login.captionEn: There's still plenty of time until the party ends. If there's anything you wanted to do with me, then go ahead, Commander.
login.caption: 宴会的时间还很充裕，你有充足的时间做你想做的事情，指挥官。

main_1.captionEn: Even though we've toasted over so many drinks already, I can't believe that you're still so lively. I might have underestimated you a bit, Commander.
main_1.caption: 接受了那么多人的频繁碰杯居然还能这么精神，看来之前多少小看你了啊，指挥官。

main_2.captionEn: As my lovely knight in shining armor, Commander, don't you think you should be asking your princess for a dance?
main_2.caption: 作为绅士，是不是应该主动邀请淑女跳只舞呢，指挥官？

main_3.captionEn: The girls of the Iron Blood are calling for me. Come greet them with me, Commander.
main_3.caption: 铁血的同伴们在喊我了，指挥官，一起去打个招呼吧。

touch_body.captionEn: Are you getting bored? Want to head out to enjoy the breeze together?
touch_body.caption: 觉得闷了？要我陪你到外面透透风吗？

touch_special.captionEn: That is not a chivalrous way to conduct yourself.
touch_special.caption: 这可不是一名绅士应该做的事情呢。

complete.captionEn: It's warm here compared to my motherland's waters. I can drink while wearing little clothing and still be fine. *glug glug*
complete.caption: 这里和北方联合的海上比起来要暖和得多呢，就算穿得薄了些，只要像这样喝点东西就不觉得冷了，咕嘟咕嘟…

login.captionEn: No need to drop off my rations today, comrade Commander. I'm not sleepy yet.
login.caption: 指挥官同志，今天就不用送吃的了哦，威严还不困

main_1.captionEn: *burp*... Drinking from a can doesn't feel the same...
main_1.caption: 咕嘟咕嘟…唔，易拉罐喝起来不太过瘾…

main_2.captionEn: Comrade Commander, this exercise is surprisingly fun since I don't need to do any thinking. You should try it too.
main_2.caption: ♪～指挥官同志，这个演习，什么都不用想，意外地轻松愉快呢。你也要来试试吗？

main_3.captionEn: The ball and chain? It doesn't weigh much. See? Oh, sorry for startling you...
main_3.caption: 这个铁球其实还挺轻的。嘿咻——啊，抱歉，吓到你了？

touch_special.captionEn: I don't have my кролик, so I'll have to use this ball and chain.
touch_special.caption: кролик没在身边呢，嗯，那就用这个铁球吧

complete.captionEn: Avrora? Never mind – it's the commission team. They're back.
complete.caption: 阿芙乐尔？不对，是委托组的大家回来了啊。

home.captionEn: Mwahahah... The port is mine now, Comrade Commander. Not really, just joking.
home.caption: 指挥官同志，哼哼，这个港区已经被我拿下了。…开玩笑的。

login.captionEn: Time to get to work, Pirožkí. Roar!
login.caption: 熊熊，该干活了，噢~

mail.captionEn: Here's your mail, Comrade Commander. Mwahahah...
mail.caption: 指挥官同志的邮件在这里哦。哼哼哼。

main_1.captionEn: Nobody's getting through us, not even you, Comrade Commander... Hot chocolate? For me? Thanks. The entrance is over there.
main_1.caption: 即使是指挥官同志，也不能轻易通过。要给我热可可？嗯，入口在那边。

main_2.captionEn: Kent's scones are so good... I'll take those as today's payment, please.
main_2.caption: 肯特做的司康饼…今天的报酬就要这个了。

main_3.captionEn: Show me what you can do, Porta-Królik.
main_3.caption: 轻量版кролик，今天很努力哦。

touch_body.captionEn: Here, Pirožkí. Food.
touch_body.caption: 是点心哦。熊熊，接着~

touch_special.captionEn: Don't tempt fate, or you'll see Królik's bad side. Mwahahah...
touch_special.caption: 别小看кролик的威力哦，哼哼哼。

complete.captionEn: Avrora? Never mind – it's the commission team. They're back.
complete.caption: 阿芙乐尔？不对，是委托组的大家回来了啊。

home.captionEn: Mwahahah... The port is mine now, Comrade Commander. Not really, just joking.
home.caption: 指挥官同志，哼哼，这个港区已经被我拿下了。…开玩笑的。

login.captionEn: Time to get to work, Pirožkí. Roar!
login.caption: 熊熊，该干活了，噢~

mail.captionEn: Here's your mail, Comrade Commander. Mwahahah...
mail.caption: 指挥官同志的邮件在这里哦。哼哼哼。

main_1.captionEn: Nobody's getting through us, not even you, Comrade Commander... Hot chocolate? For me? Thanks. The entrance is over there.
main_1.caption: 即使是指挥官同志，也不能轻易通过。要给我热可可？嗯，入口在那边。

main_2.captionEn: Kent's scones are so good... I'll take those as today's payment, please.
main_2.caption: 肯特做的司康饼…今天的报酬就要这个了。

main_3.captionEn: Show me what you can do, Porta-Królik.
main_3.caption: 轻量版кролик，今天很努力哦。

touch_body.captionEn: Here, Pirožkí. Food.
touch_body.caption: 是点心哦。熊熊，接着~

touch_special.captionEn: Don't tempt fate, or you'll see Królik's bad side. Mwahahah...
touch_special.caption: 别小看кролик的威力哦，哼哼哼。

complete.captionEn: I hope Gromky's team comes back soon... I'm going to melt soon...
complete.caption: 洪亮她们还没回来吗…这样下去威严要先融化了…

home.captionEn: You wanna join me, Comrade Commander? I'll shuffle over. There. I'll go get some borscht and chocolate mix.
home.caption: 指挥官同志也来吗？可以坐我旁边哦。嘿咻，威严去拿罗宋汤和可可过来。

login.captionEn: *gulp gulp*... Pfahh! Ahh, I'm coming back to life... Oh, need to give myself a little splash... Urgh, now I spilled my borscht...
login.caption: 咕嘟咕嘟……活过来了…浇点水浇点水…呜哇，把罗宋汤弄洒了…

main_1.captionEn: *gulp gulp*... Pfahh! The more I drink, the hotter it gets... Must be because I'm drinking HOT chocolate. Makes sense...
main_1.caption: 咕嘟咕嘟…越喝越热……嗯。因为现在喝的是热可可，所以会觉得热…

main_2.captionEn: There's many ways to enjoy a sauna? Really, huh... How do you usually do it, Comrade Commander?
main_2.caption: 和蒸桑拿的方式不一样？是吗……指挥官平时是怎么做的？

main_3.captionEn: Us Northern Parliament girls can handle the cold, but heat, not so much. It's not what we're used to... Between hot and cold, which do you handle best, Comrade Commander?
main_3.caption: 北方联合的伙伴们不怕冷，但是怕热。这也是没办法的…指挥官是比较怕热还是怕冷？

mission.captionEn: We'll take a cold bath after the mission? Okay. Be quick.
mission.caption: 做完任务就洗冷水澡？嗯，快点快点——

touch_body.captionEn: I'm getting dizzy again...
touch_body.caption: 头又开始晕了……

touch_special.captionEn: That's odd... I haven't even cracked open the vodka...
touch_special.caption: 明明没喝酒…好奇怪…

home.captionEn: *Glug, glug* ...Ahh, that hits the spot. Tsk, it's already empty... Sorry, mind grabbing me another can?
home.caption: （咕嘟、咕嘟）又喝完一罐了么……正好，你顺手帮我再拿一瓶过来吧。

login.captionEn: What's going on with you today? Spill it.
login.caption: 是什么风把你吹到这里来的？说来听听吧。

main_1.captionEn: I really need to head back, but the little'un just... *sigh* what a pain in the ass.
main_1.caption: 一会还是得回去啊，不过这孩子……呼...真难办啊

main_2.captionEn: The fan outside is so frickin' loud, but I really need my alone time... Huh? Who put these damn stickers here...?
main_2.caption: 室外的空调机，真是嘈杂啊……不过，能让人单独呆着的地方还是挺珍贵的——嗯？这些贴纸，是谁顺手贴在这里的吗？

main_3.captionEn: You already know what I'll do to people who start shit inside, don't you? ...Yep. I'll give them their one warning.
main_3.caption: 如果有人在店里调皮捣蛋，那我就会……呵呵，你知道我会怎么做。麻烦你事先提醒下那些喜欢恶作剧的孩子们了。

mission.captionEn: So, you accept a mission and then immediately begin procrastinating...? What a piece of work you are. Want me to do the same thing to you?
mission.caption: 你是身上带着任务出来偷闲的么？勇气可嘉啊。不过换成是我，估计也会和你一样就是了。

touch_body.captionEn: "Welcome back, Master. May I take your order?" ...You happy with that?
touch_body.caption: “欢迎回来主人请问需要点些什么”……好了，这下满足了吧？

touch_head.captionEn: The little'uns really like when you do this to them.
touch_head.caption: 小孩子们应该喜欢被这样摸吧。

touch_special.captionEn: Tsk... Again with that shit just 'cuz we're here? What a pain in the ass...
touch_special.caption: 什么，在这种地方…你可真会给我添麻烦……

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back. Now go talk to them. Cheering them on is your job.
complete.caption: 委托组已经回来了。快去吧，去支持那些孩子们可是你的工作。

home.captionEn: You look like you're in good shape. Hmph, so I worried for nothing.
home.caption: 看来你那边也进展得很顺利。哼，亏我还担心了你一下。

login.captionEn: Make it clear – do you want support, or a scolding? Standing around doing nothing isn't my style.
login.caption: 搞清楚了么，你是想被鼓励还是被责备？光站着什么都不做不合我的性子。

mail.captionEn: A letter... Just go check it and don't mind me.
mail.caption: 来信了……不用在意这边，你去确认就好。

main_1.captionEn: Seeing as you've got nothing better to do, go give the girls some refreshments. It'll cheer 'em up, knowing that you're here.
main_1.caption: 如果有空，就别在这儿呆着，去送点慰劳品来。有那么几位只要一知道你在场，就能马上涌出干劲的。

main_2.captionEn: Maintaining hardware is one thing we Iron Blood excel at. We're expert tamers, both of machinery and riggings.
main_2.caption: 我们铁血擅长维护机械。无论是机器还是舰装，我们都惯于驯服它们。

main_3.captionEn: Wonder when we're gonna rehearse for the victory party performance... I should go talk to Hipper and Eugen after my shift's over.
main_3.caption: 庆功会的现场彩排在什么时候呢…交班后去见见欧根和希佩尔吧。

touch_body.captionEn: Are you gonna race, too? Then I'll at least give you some pointers and support.
touch_body.caption: 你也要参加吗？我会给你些建议，为你加油的。

touch_special.captionEn: Hmph. You're a hopeless case.
touch_special.caption: 啧，真拿你没办法。

home.captionEn: Commander, would you mind giving me a moment of your time? Only for a little bit. I'd just like to know what it feels like to monopolize you for a while... Hehehe, I'm only joking.
home.caption: 指挥官介意单独陪我一下吗？一小会就好，有时候也想享受下单独占有指挥官的感觉呢…呵呵，开玩笑的~

login.captionEn: Commander, the Spring Festival is a busy, exciting time. But do take care not to catch a cold when you're out having fun.
login.caption: 指挥官，春节的夜晚很热闹，不过，在外面逛的时候，要小心别感冒了哦。

main_1.captionEn: I understand these "Tangyuan" soup balls have some association with "unity" or "gathering" in the language of the Dragon Empery, but if I eat the tangyuan, doesn't that mean I've broken the unity?
main_1.caption: 我听说东煌的传统小吃汤圆是团圆的象征。不过，吃掉它的话，不就是把“团圆”吃掉了吗…？

main_2.captionEn: Our friends are drawing that "Fu" character everywhere, so I went ahead and tried my hand. I think I did alright... Ahahaha...
main_2.caption: 东煌的友人们带着大家写了不少“福”字，我也写了一幅，不过好像一般般呢……

main_3.captionEn: Do you need help with the decorations in your office? I'd like to give decorating a try.
main_3.caption: 办公室的装饰需要帮忙吗？我也想亲手布置试试看。

touch_body.captionEn: Having you here, Commander, makes me feel at ease.
touch_body.caption: 能有指挥官陪在身边，我感到非常开心哦

touch_special.captionEn: Don't do that! At least, don't do it right now...!
touch_special.caption: 不能做这样的事。至少，现在不行哦。

home.captionEn: Because it's a special occasion, I'll call a one-day truce with those seniors of mine~♪
home.caption: 既然是难得的舞会，今天就暂时和前·辈们和解吧~

login.captionEn: I wonder how you plan on asking me out to the banquet, Commander~ I'm looking forward to it, just a little. Hehe~♪
login.caption: 你会如何邀请我呢，指挥官？稍微有些期待呢~

mail.captionEn: I hear a little tune that's not coming from the banquet... What could it be~?
mail.caption: 来自舞会外的小插曲，会是什么呢~？

main_1.captionEn: Zuikaku, you're being too nervous. Just do what your sister tells you to. First, relax, just relax...
main_1.caption: 瑞鹤，你太紧张了。听姐姐的，先放松，放松……

main_2.captionEn: Before the banquet begins, shall we practice one more time?
main_2.caption: 在舞会正式开始前，再来一次练习如何？

main_3.captionEn: Who will be the star of tonight's show? Will it be me... or us? Hehe~♪
main_3.caption: 今晚的主角会是谁呢？是我吗？还是说……我们？呵呵~

touch_body.captionEn: Don't worry, Commander, all you have to do is follow my steps slowly~
touch_body.caption: 不用担心，指挥官，跟着我的步伐慢慢来就行了~

touch_special.captionEn: Just what are you doing, Commander? Please keep your eyes on mine when we're dancing~
touch_special.caption: 你在做什么呢，指挥官？舞蹈时要好好注视我的眼睛才行哦，指挥官~

home.captionEn: A precarious battle, was it? Heehee, Contract Binder, you should know that you'll find greater pleasure in an evenly-matched back-and-forth than a one-sided stomp.
home.caption: 刚才的战况很惊险？嗯哼~♡契约者，比起绝对的实力碾压，跌宕起伏的胜负更·加·有·趣哦——

login.captionEn: You're late, Contract Binder. I had a little to drink in your absence... Heehee. A few sips would never intoxicate me. Don't believe me? Watch me walk over to... Oof. It seems I've stumbled and bumped into you.
login.caption: 来得真慢呢，契约者~等你的时候，我一个人喝了一点…呵呵，不过是这种程度而已，我又怎么会醉呢？不信的话看我走几圈……啊，摔到你身上了~

main_1.captionEn: Won't you drink, too, Contract Binder? Right here. Heehee. Come over♡
main_1.caption: 契约者要一起喝吗？…在这里哟？呵呵，来吧~

main_2.captionEn: This card? You dropped it earlier when you were shuffling the deck. Use your hand and take it yourself.
main_2.caption: 这张扑克？是契约者你刚才洗牌时不小心掉到这里的…所以，请你亲自拿下来吧~

main_3.captionEn: Drunk, you say? Hmph. I'm certainly not. I don't get drunk when I'm with you... Now, go on, show me what you're really like when you're at your wit's end♡
main_3.caption: …我已经醉了？……呵呵，才没有呢，陪你喝多少都没关系♪……也向我展现出来吧，契约者你真正的样子~

mission.captionEn: Missions, missions... You can surely finish those in no time, Contract Binder.
mission.caption: 任务…这种东西，你会很快解决好的对吧，契约者。

mission_complete.captionEn: Wine, cards, chips – everything is here. Resume the game.
mission_complete.caption: 红酒、扑克、筹码都已经准备好了，那就让我们继续开始吧。

touch_body.captionEn: Heehee. Why so stressed? The game isn't over yet.
touch_body.caption: 呵呵，这么心急吗？我们的游戏还没结束呢。

touch_head.captionEn: You touched my horn, Contract Binder... You meant to touch my bunny ears, you say? Again with the lame excuses... Just hold still and accept your punishment♡
touch_head.caption: 契约者，你碰到我的角了。只是摸了兔耳朵？居然还试图狡辩…乖乖接受惩罚吧~♡

touch_special.captionEn: Are you satisfied now? Mmh♡ ...Don't celebrate prematurely. If you want to seize the lead, now is the time... Heehee. This game will not end until I've grown bored of it♡
touch_special.caption: 这样的奖赏…你满意么~♡……但，不要得意忘形了，契约者，我会把主动权赢回来的……今夜，我们兴尽方休哦？

home.captionEn: Hopefully my form is not so burdensome as to break this... The task you have entrusted this one is difficult to bear, but I may beseech advice from Shoukaku and Taihou...
home.caption: 希望这不会不堪妾身躯体之重……汝所希望之责，并不容易…之后向翔鹤和大凤她们请教一二吧…

login.captionEn: Mm... Nnh... Will this do...? This one offers wholehearted support in all your struggles... I pray for your first-round triumph...
login.caption: 嗯……呼…如此便好吗…？信浓会在此全力应援汝之奋斗的——预祝初战告捷……

main_1.captionEn: Gleaming chrome, roaring reverberations... Who emerged victorious? Alas, this one must apologize...for missing it...
main_1.caption: 银轮闪烁，轰鸣交融…比赛的结果到底如何……啊，妾身虽然想看但无法实现……非常抱歉…

main_2.captionEn: Subjected thusly to the eyes of many... The heart is elated, yet its tranquility is disturbed... Do you feel the heat this one feels...?
main_2.caption: 众目睽睽之下此般的高温……即使兴致高昂，但实在谈不上安宁……汝是否也和妾身一般辗转难安呢？

main_3.captionEn: Initially, this one wondered if you had ulterior motives...but knowing that this is to add flair to the race, I joyously accept this duty...
main_3.caption: 当初还以为汝有所图谋……既然知道了这是为了炒热比赛气氛，接下这份职责自然是乐意的……

mission.captionEn: Trite it may be, but your work is of vital import... See it done anon...
mission.caption: 虽说是一直以来的事务，不过汝的职责很重要……快快完成吧……

mission_complete.captionEn: A prize of Western spirits... Alas, I suppose...this one must open it...?
mission_complete.caption: 赐予的奖赏是…啊，这西洋的酒，妾身可能……只需打开就好吗……？

touch_body.captionEn: You want this one to change posture? Mm... If that is my destined task, then I will try...
touch_body.caption: 需要换个姿势吗…？嗯…既然是职责所在，妾身自当尽力……

touch_head.captionEn: Alas... This one's ears are sensitive...
touch_head.caption: 啊……耳朵有点……

touch_special.captionEn: As a reward for your valiant efforts...
touch_special.caption: 如果说这是对汝奋斗的奖赏的话……

home.captionEn: Hopefully my form is not so burdensome as to break this... The task you have entrusted this one is difficult to bear, but I may beseech advice from Shoukaku and Taihou...
home.caption: 希望这不会不堪妾身躯体之重……汝所希望之责，并不容易…之后向翔鹤和大凤她们请教一二吧…

login.captionEn: Mm... Nnh... Will this do...? This one offers wholehearted support in all your struggles... I pray for your first-round triumph...
login.caption: 嗯……呼…如此便好吗…？信浓会在此全力应援汝之奋斗的——预祝初战告捷……

main_1.captionEn: Gleaming chrome, roaring reverberations... Who emerged victorious? Alas, this one must apologize...for missing it...
main_1.caption: 银轮闪烁，轰鸣交融…比赛的结果到底如何……啊，妾身虽然想看但无法实现……非常抱歉…

main_2.captionEn: Subjected thusly to the eyes of many... The heart is elated, yet its tranquility is disturbed... Do you feel the heat this one feels...?
main_2.caption: 众目睽睽之下此般的高温……即使兴致高昂，但实在谈不上安宁……汝是否也和妾身一般辗转难安呢？

main_3.captionEn: Initially, this one wondered if you had ulterior motives...but knowing that this is to add flair to the race, I joyously accept this duty...
main_3.caption: 当初还以为汝有所图谋……既然知道了这是为了炒热比赛气氛，接下这份职责自然是乐意的……

mission.captionEn: Trite it may be, but your work is of vital import... See it done anon...
mission.caption: 虽说是一直以来的事务，不过汝的职责很重要……快快完成吧……

mission_complete.captionEn: A prize of Western spirits... Alas, I suppose...this one must open it...?
mission_complete.caption: 赐予的奖赏是…啊，这西洋的酒，妾身可能……只需打开就好吗……？

touch_body.captionEn: You want this one to change posture? Mm... If that is my destined task, then I will try...
touch_body.caption: 需要换个姿势吗…？嗯…既然是职责所在，妾身自当尽力……

touch_head.captionEn: Alas... This one's ears are sensitive...
touch_head.caption: 啊……耳朵有点……

touch_special.captionEn: As a reward for your valiant efforts...
touch_special.caption: 如果说这是对汝奋斗的奖赏的话……

complete.captionEn: The commission team makes their return... This one asks that you greet them soon...
complete.caption: 委托组的孩子们回来了…之后的迎接，便拜托了…

home.captionEn: If regarded as illusions that will eventually fade, one can even accept seas and skies that defy the laws of nature... If it is your desire, this one will make the last moments of your dreams eternal.
home.caption: 若是看做终将消逝的南柯一梦，此等悖于自然法则的海天一色，亦无可厚非…若是汝之所望，直至梦醒刹那，亦可化作永恒—

login.captionEn: The swimsuit you requested is too small for this one... Mm... This one hopes it isn't too strange compared to the others...
login.caption: 汝之所盼的海边装扮，于妾身而言却略显褊急……嗯…若与伙伴无异便好…

main_1.captionEn: A lover's tryst, both in reality and in our dreams... Your loving and longing warm this one so much that it makes me sweat. Sorry you have to see this one like this...
main_1.caption: 不止现世，梦中也相逢交织…汝之思慕之情，跨越一切使妾身身心火热……情难自持，此般流露，在此致歉…

main_2.captionEn: It was not this one's intent for my swimsuit to malfunction... Every time this one adjusts it, the next small motion throws it back into disarray... How can one escape this plight?
main_2.caption: 衣衫凌乱，并非本意……然，纵使急欲打理，却因小家伙作乱难有作为…此等困境，该如何是好…

main_3.captionEn: If you desire a cool breeze... M-mm... By fanning this one's tail as such... Mm... Hopefully this does not simply blow hot air at you...
main_3.caption: 若是期盼凉风…嗯……像这般煽动尾巴的话…嗯…但愿送达于汝的并非热气…

mission.captionEn: Even in your dreams, you diligently fulfill your responsibilities... It is astounding.
mission.caption: 即使于梦中，也勤于尽忠职守，令人惊叹…

mission_complete.captionEn: An ever-growing pile of rewards... May this dream of your efforts being rewarded come true...
mission_complete.caption: 获酬众多，硕果累累……愿天道酬勤，汝之所梦皆成真…

touch_body.captionEn: An invitation to swim... This one will gladly join you...
touch_body.caption: 游术之邀…汝若钟意，妾身自当为伴…

touch_head.captionEn: You so persistently strike this one's weaknesses... Mmh...
touch_head.caption: 汝何故要这般执拗地……嗯嗯…

touch_special.captionEn: This one graciously accepts your touch...
touch_special.caption: 既是汝，妾身便甘之如饴…

complete.captionEn: Commission team's here! ...You're still putting on your sunscreen? Come ooon.
complete.caption: 委托组已经回来了呢！…还没涂完？诶——

home.captionEn: Good work out there! Oh, honey, you look a little burned. Hahaha, I'm kidding! Here, I'll get you a drink. Take it easy♪
home.caption: 出击辛苦了！咦，Honey是不是晒黑了？哈哈开玩笑的！来，饮料给你，慢慢休息吧♪

login.captionEn: It's a scorcher out there... Midsummer sunlight is rough no matter where you go. Honey, did you put on sunscreen? We'd better get some on you~ Hahaha♪
login.caption: 好热啊——盛夏的阳光真是到哪儿都毒……Honey有涂防晒霜之类的吗？总之涂了比较放心~哈哈♪

main_1.captionEn: Aloe works as sunscreen, too? Then get to putting it on me! ...Whoa, it's all slippery and sticky... Hyah?!
main_1.caption: 芦荟也有防晒效果？Honey，拜托了！…呜哇，这个黏黏滑滑的感觉…呀！？

main_2.captionEn: Mm... I want ice cream now... Okay! Want one, honey? Don't worry– all of us Eagle Union ships brought ice cream.
main_2.caption: 嗯…想吃冰淇淋了…Honey也来一根吗？没事没事，白鹰的大家都带了冰淇淋来哦？

main_3.captionEn: Wanna go see Ticonderoga with me later? Tanning is fun and all, but I'd love to lie down in a cool place. You decide, honey.
main_3.caption: 之后去提康德罗加那里吧？晒晒太阳是好，不过也想在稍微凉快的地方躺着休息♪就交给Honey决定啦~

touch_body.captionEn: I'm counting on you, honey!
touch_body.caption: 就拜托你好好涂啦！Honey♪

touch_special.captionEn: Hyah?! Geez, honey. I know you like this stuff, but c'mon... *blushes*
touch_special.caption: 呀！？真是的Honey，虽然我知道你喜欢这种啦…///

complete.captionEn: Commissions? Go forth, but do not keep me waiting too long~
complete.caption: 委托？去吧，可别让人家等太久哦？

login.captionEn: Commander, art thou prepared to play with me until I'm satisfied?
login.caption: 指挥官，今天，可要陪人家玩到尽兴才行哦？

main_1.captionEn: Nnh... Commander, how is this goldfish so hard to scoop? Hurry and help me!
main_1.caption: 喂，指挥官，这个金鱼怎么这么难捞，快来帮人家！

main_2.captionEn: Hmm... these "yukata" things are more interesting than I had thought. I will have to try wearing one next time.
main_2.caption: 嗯……浴衣这种服装，似乎比想象的要有意思呢，人家下次也穿穿看吧

main_3.captionEn: Commander, there appears to be something interesting over there. But I can't see... lift me onto thy shoulders?
main_3.caption: 指挥官，那边似乎有什么有趣的东西，不过人家看不到，背人家起来嘛

touch_body.captionEn: For one like myself, the night hath only begun. Thou art not allowed to be sleepy yet~
touch_body.caption: 对人家来说，夜晚才刚刚开始呢，汝可不许说困了哦？

complete.captionEn: Woof! Are you sure that barking increases the likelihood of getting a better reward...?
complete.caption: 汪！你确定委托完成时喊一声奖励会更好吗……

home.captionEn: You were only able to return safely because of my luck, so be thankful!
home.caption: 你能平安无事也是多亏了我的幸运，快感谢我吧！

login.captionEn: You've finally returned! Now, get to work for Yukikaze the Great!
login.caption: 终于回来了，为了雪风大人赶紧好好工作吧！

mail.captionEn: Here's your mail... Grrrr, even more popular than me...
mail.caption: 你的信……可恶，居然比我还要受欢迎

main_1.captionEn: Wa ha ha! Yukikaze the Great is invincible!
main_1.caption: HO,HO,HO，雪风大人可是无敌的口牙！

main_2.captionEn: If you beg me like that, I have no choice but to lend you my aid!
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你求我的话也不是不能帮你一下哦~

main_3.captionEn: Eheh~ Hmph. Yukikaze the Great is only giving you the time of day because she's in a good mood!
main_3.caption: Na,Nya……哼，雪风大人心情好，就难得满足一下你

mission.captionEn: How naïve, Commander! You still have tasks left to do!
mission.caption: 还有任务剩下，指挥官，你还嫩啊（鄙视）

mission_complete.captionEn: Let's take a little peek... Wh-what am I doing? N-not peeking, of course... I just wanted to check the rewards in advance!
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励是……干，干什么，我才没想偷看！我只是事先帮你确认一下！

touch_body.captionEn: Phew... that was scary... Huh? I didn't say anything!
touch_body.caption: 呼……吓我一跳（小声）嗯？没什么

touch_head.captionEn: Eep! That scared me... Huh? None of your business!
touch_head.caption: 呼……吓我一跳（小声）嗯？哼，没什么，继续做你的事去吧

touch_special.captionEn: What are... you doing... nngh!? Go die!!
touch_special.caption: 你……竟敢……呜……！去死吧！

wedding.captionEn: Since you asked so earnestly, Yukikaze the Great shall grant you a favor and allow you to carry her! Come on, what are you waiting for? It's a once in a lifetime opportunity!
wedding.caption: 既然这是你发自内心的请求，雪风大人就大发慈悲收下好了，特别允许你把雪风大人抱起来也没关系哦，来吧，你还在等什么，这可是千载难逢的好机会！

login.captionEn: Heheh~ As long as the lucky Yukikaze is at your side, everything's going to be smooth sailing this year!
login.caption: 哼哼，有幸运的雪风大人在，指挥官当然整年都会一帆风顺了！

main_1.captionEn: Is it snowing?! Hooray! Now I can play in the... A-ahem! Commander, why don't we go enjoy the scenery together?
main_1.caption: 外面好像下雪了！？一起出去玩雪…咳咳、要一起去看看雪吗，指挥官？

main_2.captionEn: That Chang Chun girl gave me some special-looking firecrackers. They look pretty neat, so can we set them off right now? Ehh?! I can't...?
main_2.caption: 长春给了我这个，说是特制的鞭炮，很好玩的，嘿嘿，要不要在这里放一个试试啊！欸？不行吗……

main_3.captionEn: Happy New Year! In the Dragon Empery, it doesn't count as a new year 'til this time rolls around! Of course Yukikaze the Wise would know that~♪
main_3.caption: 新年好！博学的雪风大人知道，东煌是这个时期才算过新年的！

mission.captionEn: Hmm... Let's finish the work first, then play later.
mission.caption: 唔…还是把该做的事情做完再来享受节日氛围吧…

touch_body.captionEn: Ehh?! Y-You're going to give me New Year's money?!
touch_body.caption: 嗯？难道是要给我压岁钱吗！？

touch_special.caption: 成，成熟的雪风大人早就习，习惯这些了！唔，唔……

login.captionEn: Commander, are you ready? Then we're off to the next stop~
login.caption: 指挥官，准备好了吗，让我们向着下一家店出发吧～

main_1.captionEn: Commander, you can give me puppy-dog eyes all you want, but I won't share my ice cream... F-fine, just one lick, got it?
main_1.caption: 指挥官，就算你这么盯着我，冰淇淋也不会……唔，好吧，就只能舔一口哦，真的哦？

main_2.captionEn: My twin-gun turrets are also on vacation today! Gotta work hard and play hard!
main_2.caption: 路路通和连装炮今天都在休息！该玩的时候要好好放松啦～

main_3.captionEn: Uhh, I don't think I'll bring the puppy with me next time... He's way too jumpy and almost even fell off the scooter once...
main_3.caption: 唔，下次不带这个小家伙出来了…它真的很爱动欸，有一次还直接从车上跳了下去……

touch_body.captionEn: Oh, you finally noticed, Commander! That's right, I put my hair up just for today's ride! This is your only chance to see it like this.
touch_body.caption: 哦，指挥官终于注意到了吗！没错，今天的发型是兜风特战版！只有现在能看到哦？

touch_special.captionEn: I can't believe you. You almost made me drop my ice cream!
touch_special.caption: 真是的，人家冰淇淋都差点被你弄掉了啦！

home.captionEn: Welcome back, Comma– Whuah! Geesh, that last wave was huge! You could've warned me that it was coming! Hmph!
home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官——哇啊！？怎么突然来了个大浪！真是的，指挥官看到了就提醒我一下嘛…

login.captionEn: Hey, Commander, done anything fun lately? I wanna know!
login.caption: 指挥官，最近都遇到了什么好玩的事？都和我说说嘛！

main_1.captionEn: Hey, Commander! Just lie on your back and I'll cover you with sand~
main_1.caption: 指挥官，快躺下快躺下！我要用沙子把你埋起来！

main_2.captionEn: Go get the camera, Commander! I wanna take a photo of this.
main_2.caption: 其实我包包里还装防水相机哦，指挥官，来拍张合影吧！

main_3.captionEn: Passepartout, could you get me some sunscreen? Oh, and Commander, would you mind rubbing it on for me?
main_3.caption: 指挥官，能帮我抹下防晒霜吗~？

touch_body.captionEn: You're head over heels for my gorgeous body, aren't you? Heheh, stare all you want, because I don't mind♡
touch_body.caption: 被我的身材魅惑得神魂颠倒了吗？哼哼，想看的话就尽情地看吧，我不会介意的！

home.captionEn: Welcome back, Comma– Whuah! Geesh, that last wave was huge! You could've warned me that it was coming! Hmph!
home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官——哇啊！？怎么突然来了个大浪！真是的，指挥官看到了就提醒我一下嘛…

login.captionEn: Hey, Commander, done anything fun lately? I wanna know!
login.caption: 指挥官，最近都遇到了什么好玩的事？都和我说说嘛！

main_1.captionEn: Hey, Commander! Just lie on your back and I'll cover you with sand~
main_1.caption: 指挥官，快躺下快躺下！我要用沙子把你埋起来！

main_2.captionEn: Go get the camera, Commander! I wanna take a photo of this.
main_2.caption: 其实我包包里还装防水相机哦，指挥官，来拍张合影吧！

main_3.captionEn: Passepartout, could you get me some sunscreen? Oh, and Commander, would you mind rubbing it on for me?
main_3.caption: 指挥官，能帮我抹下防晒霜吗~？

touch_body.captionEn: You're head over heels for my gorgeous body, aren't you? Heheh, stare all you want, because I don't mind♡
touch_body.caption: 被我的身材魅惑得神魂颠倒了吗？哼哼，想看的话就尽情地看吧，我不会介意的！

complete.captionEn: Hyeep?! ...Oh, that was just the commission fleet coming back? Thank you very much...
complete.caption: 呀？！…委，委托组回来了吗？谢谢…

home.captionEn: I'm a bad girl, aren't I? For wearing this to try to get Commander to notice me... A-actually, p-please don't look at me after all! *whimpers*...
home.caption: 肯定是雅努斯不好，想让指挥官来看穿成这样的自己……果、果然还是不要看！呜呜呜……

login.captionEn: I'll be just fine, I can handle going out alone on Halloween night... C-Commander, I'm sorry! I need your help after all...
login.caption: 雅努斯，没事的，不就是万圣节一个人出来玩……指、指挥官对不起！还是救救我吧……

main_1.captionEn: C-Commander, it's not your fault. I wasn't watching where I was going... No, I'm sure it was because I was too jumpy and ended up spooking the kitty...
main_1.caption: 不，不是指挥官的错哦？都是因为我不小心…不，肯定是因为我害怕结果吓到了猫咪所以…

main_2.captionEn: All my friends around the port are dressing up for Halloween, huh... By the way, what is this supposed to be a costume of? It has cat ears, but bat wings...
main_2.caption: 港区的同伴们都穿着万圣节的装扮呢…说起来我的装扮是什么来着…？有猫耳朵，还有蝙蝠的翅膀…

main_3.captionEn: Commander, are you not scared of Halloween? Well, when I think about it a bit more... I'm the only one who's scared of Halloween, aren't I? Oh no, I'm sorry for bringing up weird things...
main_3.caption: 指挥官不会害怕万圣节吗……？想想也是呢……对不起我又在说奇怪的话了…！怎么办，如果只有我一个人害怕的话…呜呜……

mission.captionEn: Commander, there's new mission here! Err, umm... I hope you can come back sooner... S-sorry!
mission.caption: 指挥官，有新任务！那，那个…希望你能早点回来…不好意思…！

touch_body.captionEn: Don't you worry, Janus, there's nothing to be afraid of... Jervis and the Commander are here!
touch_body.caption: 没事的雅努斯，没什么好怕的，还有贾维斯和指挥官在呢……！

home.captionEn: Thank you for your continued efforts. Um... Wh-why are you looking at me so expectantly?
home.caption: 辛苦了。嗯…为，为什么用期待的眼光看着我？

login.captionEn: I-it's about time we went on a... date, isn't it, Commander?
login.caption: 那，就开始…约会…吧？指挥官…？

main_1.captionEn: I-I don't mind if you sit here! Today, you have special permission to be next to me!
main_1.caption: 可…可以坐旁边的哦！今天特别允许你坐在我身边！

main_2.captionEn: Heheh, I will gladly let you carry my things! Where should we go next? Or...do you need a minute to rest?
main_2.caption: 呵呵，包也给你拎！接下来想去哪里？还是有点累了所以…想休息？

main_3.captionEn: (Things have been so awkward for a while now... I have to scoot a little bit closer...) B-Bwuh?! Did you hear that?!
main_3.caption: （从刚才开始一直在紧张…要再拉近点距离才行…）诶？！刚才说的都听到了吗？！

mission.captionEn: Why don't we forget about all the missions for a day? Come and be bad with me!
mission.caption: 今天就别管任务了吧？和我一起，当个坏孩子吧♡

mission_complete.captionEn: Here are your rewards. Allow me to hold your things for you.
mission_complete.caption: 是任务报酬。来，包还是我来拿吧。

touch_body.captionEn: I-is this a massage?
touch_body.caption: 按、按摩…？

touch_special.captionEn: ...Hwaah?!
touch_special.caption: ……呀！？

home.captionEn: The snow is coming down outside... Milord, let me get an extra sweater for you.
home.caption: 外面在下雪呢……主上，我给您再添一件毛衣吧

login.captionEn: Milord, shall we go outside together?
login.caption: 主上，要一起外出吗？

main_1.captionEn: Achoo! ...I'm cute when I sneeze? D- don't make fun of me...
main_1.caption: 阿嚏！……打喷嚏的样子很可爱？请、请不要笑话我了……

main_2.captionEn: This is... real snow... beautiful...
main_2.caption: 这就是真正的雪……真漂亮啊

main_3.captionEn: Aren't there some big festivals in the wintertime? I guess you could say... I'm a little interested... only a little!
main_3.caption: 冬天会有很热闹的祭典吗？……稍微……有些感兴趣

touch_body.captionEn: Is there someplace you'd like to go, Milord? Of course I'll accompany you.
touch_body.caption: 主上……有想去的地方吗？我会陪您一起去的

touch_special.captionEn: Um, Milord, your hands are cold...
touch_special.caption: 主、主上，手好冷……

home.captionEn: Nothing beats Edinburgh's hand-brewed black tea! Wouldn't you agree, my servant?
home.caption: 果然爱丁堡泡的红茶很好喝呢！仆从你也这么觉得吧？

mail.captionEn: I shall check the mail in your stead, my servant! ...Hmm, I wonder what this says...
mail.caption: 就由我代替仆从确认邮件好了！…嗯，上面写了些什么呢…

main_1.captionEn: Warspite, what's taking you so long? ...What do you mean you can't move around easily in a skirt?!
main_1.caption: 厌战，太慢了！…因为穿了裙子行动不方便？你这是在说什么啊？

main_2.captionEn: Being a maid is no easier than carrying out public duties... So come help me already, you lowly servant!
main_2.caption: 女仆的工作，还有公务，都很辛苦呢…快帮我一下啊仆从！

main_3.captionEn: Bel, come clean up around the office! Heheh, any job that someone as noble as me carries out becomes a noble endeavor in turn!
main_3.caption: 贝法，办公室的打扫就拜托你了！哼哼，高贵的我做的工作也得足够高贵才行！

mission.captionEn: Hurry up and take care of the missions, you lowly servant!
mission.caption: 仆从，快点去完成你的任务！

mission_complete.captionEn: Excellent, the rewards are here! Warspite, take these over to my servant!
mission_complete.caption: 是报酬啊！厌战，给我送到仆从那边去吧！

touch_special.captionEn: Do you also do this to the girls in the Maid Team...?
touch_special.caption: 仆从，你该不会对女仆队的其他人也做了这样的事吧…

home.captionEn: Nngh~ My legs sure are sore... Oh, Commander, you're back. Say... would you mind helping me out a little?
home.caption: 嗯~腿有些酸了呢…啊，指挥官，你回来啦，那个…能帮帮我吗…？

login.captionEn: An old saying goes, "it's better to be lucky than it is to be punctual." Since you've come at quite the fortuitous moment, why not come sit next to me and enjoy the show? As for what's going on over here, don't sweat the small details~♪
login.caption: 俗话说，来得早不如来得巧。既然您来了，不如就在旁边坐会吧？不必在意这边的状况~

mail.captionEn: Got some mail for you, Commander, but it's not easy for me to move right now. I'll just leave it on the table for you.
mail.caption: 指挥官，有您的信件。恕我行动不便，给您就近放在桌子上了。

main_1.captionEn: What's the matter, Chao Ho? Still haven't been able to get your stuff back? ...I tricked you? What could you possibly be talking about?
main_1.caption: 肇和？怎么了，还没有抓到它吗？……恶作剧？你在说什么呀，我怎么听不懂。

main_2.captionEn: We're almost completely out of ink for our Spring Festival couplets. Commander, mind helping me grind up the inkstick? I'm a bit busy right now, but I'll make a cup of tea for you later.
main_2.caption: 写春联用的墨水见底了。指挥官，能拜托您帮忙磨一点吗？我现在有点不方便，之后我会给您泡一杯茶的。

main_3.captionEn: The goods Akashi sent over sure are convenient. There's the mechanical errand-running Manjuus, the automatic fireworks launchers, and the lion dancers as well... I'm sure Fu Shun and her gals would have an absolute blast with these.
main_3.caption: 明石送的小道具真是方便。除了跑腿用的特制机器啾啾外，好像还有能放烟花的，表演舞狮的……抚顺她们应该会喜欢吧。

touch_body.captionEn: You also want to try playing a prank on Chao Ho? Sure, but don't go too overboard~
touch_body.caption: 你也想试试捉弄姐姐的感觉吗？当然可以，不过要轻点~

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, are you sure you want to do this with Chao Ho watching? I never knew you had kinks like that...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，肇和就在旁边哦？没想到你还有这种特殊癖好啊……

complete.captionEn: A commission's been completed. Oh well, nothing too important to our sleepy bird here.
complete.caption: 委托，完成了……不过，对懒惰的指……鸟儿来说不那么重要呢，嗯。

home.captionEn: Back at long last. Whew... You have more stamina than any person has any right to.
home.caption: 终于回来了。指挥官，你还真是精力旺盛欸……

login.captionEn: Hm? Did you give up on being the early bird? ...Me? I'm the spring worm that sleeps in.
login.caption: ……嗯？指挥官，是不想做早起的鸟儿了么？……我？我不一样哦。我今天扮演的是在早春打盹的虫子，嗯。

mail.captionEn: There's a Lunar New Year card with your name on it, Commander.
mail.caption: 有你的春节问候邮件，指挥官。

main_1.captionEn: Whew... Lunar New Year's a nice holiday. You can just lie down and someone will feed you... Hm? They won't?
main_1.caption: 嗯，真是个美好的节日，只需要躺着享受，自然有人投喂……嗯？不是这样的么？

main_2.captionEn: Looks like Theseus is into the hustle and bustle of the season. Though, I guess I'm the same when it comes down to it... *yaaawn*...
main_2.caption: 忒修斯，好像很享受春节热闹的样子。其实我也一样……在享受节日这件事上。哈啊……（哈欠）

main_3.captionEn: A cannon to inaugurate the new year with? That's a neat idea... Crap, now I'm interested...
main_3.caption: 贺岁大炮……？真是独特的构想呢……糟糕，有点感兴趣了…

touch_body.captionEn: ...Do you wanna lie down with me? Knock yourself out. Like they say, Lunar New Year is a holiday for resting.
touch_body.caption: ……想一起躺会？没问题。春节，就是来睡懒觉的节日呢……

touch_head.captionEn: ...Oh. Now it's your responsibility to comb my hair.
touch_head.caption: ……唔，指挥官，负起责任给我梳头哦。

touch_special.captionEn: ...Baozi... or rice cakes? C-Commander... *blushes*
touch_special.caption: ……包子还是年糕？指挥官，你这人啊……

home.captionEn: Commander~ Welcome home~♥ I see, so this is what makes you happy? It seems I still have much to learn... Heehee.
home.caption: 指挥官大人～欢迎回港～♥原来如此，这样子会更让您感到高兴吗？看来云仙还有许多不懂的事情呢……呵呵。

login.captionEn: Commander~ Heheh, come sit over here with me. It may be... a little cramped, but it's enough space for two, isn't it?
login.caption: 指挥官大人～呵呵，可以的话来我身边坐坐吧？嗯……虽然稍微有些狭窄，但两人挤挤的话也是可以的哦。

mail.captionEn: It seems there are letters waiting for you. It's okay. You may enjoy your break first and read it later.
mail.caption: 来信了呢。无需在意。好好休息后再确认便是。

main_1.captionEn: Would you like to join me, Commander? Soak your feet and feel heaven and earth's energy through the land, sea, and ocean breeze...
main_1.caption: 指挥官大人也要来试试吗？只需把脚浸于水中，海洋与大地，以及海风传递而来的天地灵气便会吸纳融汇于身——

main_2.captionEn: There are some underwater hot springs nearby. How about you and I visit them later? They're quite close—it's just two days if we swim.
main_2.caption: 说起来这附近有海洋温泉呢。可以的话，之后一起去泡泡如何？……游过去的话两天左右就能到，还挺近的吧？

main_3.captionEn: Commander, when you go on vacation, you should have fun. Yes, it's a rare opportunity to... move your body a little, don't you think?
main_3.caption: 指挥官大人，都出门游玩了，就更应该尽情享受才是。对吧，像这样活动身体——不是很难得的机会吗？

touch_body.captionEn: This feeling of liberation... I'd love to feel more of this place's energy with my bare skin... Oh, I can't?
touch_body.caption: 这般周身无拘无束之感……还想再更直接地感受这里的灵气……不行吗？

touch_special.captionEn: You'd even do that out here...? Heehee♥
touch_special.caption: 不用换个地方吗……？呵呵♥

complete.captionEn: It’s about time! Please put aside your work, and check on the results of your commissions.
complete.caption: 时间到了，工作先放一放，去检查委托成果吧

home.captionEn: We still have so much to review about the previous battle...
home.caption: 刚才的战斗还有许多要检讨的地方呢……

login.captionEn: There's still quite a lot to be done today. No procrastinating!
login.caption: 今天还有好多事情要做呢，可不要偷懒哦

mail.captionEn: There’s mail for you, Commander. You sure are popular.
mail.caption: 有你的信，指挥官意外地挺受欢迎嘛

main_1.captionEn: Don’t worry, Commander. The fact that you care about me is enough.
main_1.caption: 不用担心，我的话，指挥官有这份心就够了

main_2.captionEn: I wonder if there’s something I can do for you, Commander. You seem tired lately, so maybe a massage would be good?
main_2.caption: 给指挥官准备什么点心好呢……最近好像也挺累的，稍微给那个人按摩一下吧……

main_3.captionEn: See, Commander? You can do it if you set your mind to it!
main_3.caption: 嗯嗯，指挥官只要用心的话还是办得到的呢

mission.captionEn: Completing missions is a great way to hone your skills. Don't ever forget that!
mission.caption: 完成任务是熟练技巧的好途径哦，不要忘了

mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, the mission rewards have arrived.
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励发放了喔

touch_body.captionEn: If you’re free, why not help with some paperwork?
touch_body.caption: 有这个时间多处理些公文如何？

touch_head.captionEn: I’m not the kind of girl who you can fool with just a few headpats. Get back to work, Commander.
touch_head.caption: 我可不是那种被摸摸头就可以蒙混过去的女孩子哦，指挥官，请好好工作

touch_special.captionEn: This isn’t something a commander should be doing...
touch_special.caption: 这可不是指挥官应有的行为哦

wedding.captionEn: This is the proof that Commander acknowledges me... Understood. From now on, I shall stay by your side and work hard to ensure that your life is happy and upstanding.
wedding.caption: 这就是指挥官对我的认可……我明白了，我Z23从今往后也会一直陪在指挥官你的身边，为你能够正确又愉快的生活努力的

complete.captionEn: It’s about time! Please put aside your work, and check on the results of your commissions.
complete.caption: 时间到了，工作先放一放，去检查委托成果吧

home.captionEn: We still have so much to review about the previous battle...
home.caption: 刚才的战斗还有许多要检讨的地方呢……

login.caption: 今天还有好多事情要做呢，可不要偷懒哦

mail.caption: 有你的信，指挥官意外地挺受欢迎嘛

touch_special.caption: 这可不是指挥官应有的行为哦

wedding.caption: 这就是指挥官对我的认可……我明白了，我Z23从今往后也会一直陪在指挥官你的身边，为你能够正确又愉快的生活努力的

home.captionEn: Have you prepared yourself? Then let us proceed to our next battlefield. This battle shall thusly be dubbed: "Soaking in the Shallows!"
home.caption: 准备好了吗？那就前往下一个战场吧，名为「海水浴场」的战场——

login.captionEn: The midsummer seaside is full of the unknown... Let's go explore it together!
login.caption: 盛夏的海边，充满了未知与谜团…一起去探索吧！

main_1.captionEn: The hot summer and the refreshing ice... what a wonderful contradiction.
main_1.caption: 酷暑与冰，真是妙不可言的一对矛盾。

main_2.captionEn: Trust your instincts and your courage. They will guide you forward.
main_2.caption: 相信你心中的直觉与勇气吧，它会指引你前进的。

main_3.captionEn: No matter how many times, I will always believe in your words. I can always trust that you will guide me down the right path.
main_3.caption: 无论多少次，我都会相信你的话。只要是你，一定指引我走向正确道路的吧。

touch_body.captionEn: I truly do exist, and am needed by everyone...
touch_body.caption: 我确实的存在着，被大家需要着……

touch_special.captionEn: Why... is there hesitation in your eyes?
touch_special.caption: 为何…你的双眼正诉说着犹豫？

home.captionEn: Steel yourselves for this upcoming battle! Intense fights await, at our next sports meet!
home.caption: 新的战斗已经迫在眉睫，做好准备吧，迎接名为“运动会”的紧张战斗——

main_1.captionEn: To compete with others and prove your worth, through different means than fighting battles... To be crowned "champion," 'tis a great feeling.
main_1.caption: 与他人竞争，通过战斗之外的方式证明自己，夺取“冠军”……这样的感觉，很奇妙

main_2.captionEn: Even in this little academy, there are so many things to do and see...
main_2.caption: 光是在小小的学园中，就还有这么多我未曾经历与体验的事物…

main_3.captionEn: Whether your sweat is falling on the track, or your words are encouraging others, all of this is an unforgettable experience.
main_3.caption: 无论是在赛道上挥洒汗水，还是在赛道旁为她人加油，都是令人难忘的体验

touch_body.captionEn: Just a small piece of paper... can create such a profound tie between people... this "scavenger hunt" is more interesting than I thought.
touch_body.caption: 仅凭小小的纸条，就能与她人产生不一样的联系…「借物竞赛」，比想象中的更加有趣

touch_special.captionEn: Where are your fingers... Is there really anything worth exploring right there?
touch_special.caption: 这里…有什么值得探索的事物吗？

complete.captionEn: A commission fleet has returned to port. I wish for them to see me as I am now, as a beloved idol.
complete.caption: 委托的舰船回港了。作为受人崇拜的偶像，向她们展示自己的存在吧

home.captionEn: The stage is yet another battlefield, where wars are fought not with steel and fire, but with our charm and earnest desire.
home.caption: 此处亦是战场，是名为“偶像”的存在赌上一切战斗的，唤作“舞台”的战场。

login.captionEn: As long as your eyes are fixed upon me; Upon this stage I shall sing bravely.
login.caption: 只要你注视着，我就有在舞台之上一直唱下去的勇气。

main_1.captionEn: The star-lit stage is another world of its own, an ajar door to the unknown that now beckons me...
main_1.caption: 光芒照耀下的舞台，是一方独立的世界，未知的世界之门，正在向我打开……

main_2.captionEn: My dear friend, there is no reason to worry about me. All of this was made possible by Z23, Z35, Graf Spee, Admiral Hipper... We are all connected by the bonds of the Iron Blood.
main_2.caption: 吾友，无须为我担心。这一切皆是Z23和Z35、斯佩和希佩尔，以及我等铁血全员之羁绊所创造之物

main_3.captionEn: Take heed of where the other performers and your audience are looking? ...I see. I understand why such a thing is important, but can you explain to me why it is called the "Evil Eye?"
main_3.caption: 望向同台上演出者与台下之观众们的视线…原来如此，确实很重要，其被称为“魔眼”的原因也一块告诉我吧

touch_body.captionEn: My singing voice... is proof of my existence.
touch_body.caption: 这“歌声”，便是此刻的我存在于此的证明。

home.captionEn: Legs straight, calves stretched– Ah, welcome back, Commander. I suppose you can tell I've been teaching the others to swim. Would you like me to teach you as well?
home.caption: 打水的时候腿部自然伸直，脚面要绷直——…啊，欢迎回来。如你所见，我正在教她们游泳呢，指挥官想要接受我的指·导吗~？哈哈

login.captionEn: Commander, please be careful swimming in the deep end, okay?
login.caption: 指挥官，如果想去深水区游泳的话，还请稍微注意安全哦？

main_1.captionEn: Hey, no horseplay in the pool!
main_1.caption: （哔哔——）那边的小朋友们，泳池里不能做刚刚那样的危险动作哦！

main_2.captionEn: I really like swimming, but the submarines and destroyers are always faster... Why is that, Commander...?
main_2.caption: 唔…虽然我很喜欢游泳，不过速度总是比不过潜艇和驱逐们呢…指挥官，你知道为什么吗~？

main_3.captionEn: Speed is one thing, but I'm quite confident in my stamina. How about it, Commander? Want to try me?
main_3.caption: 虽然速度不敢说，不过对于耐力我可是很有自信的哦？指挥官想要和我比比吗~？

touch_body.captionEn: Your eyes are wandering. Hehe, what's on your mind? You can tell me.
touch_body.caption: 眼睛在看着哪里呢？嘻嘻~有什么想法的话，不妨都告诉我吧。

touch_special.captionEn: Really now, Commander? I understand your eagerness, but there's a time and place, no?
touch_special.caption: 真是的~指挥官？就算再怎么心急，也要看看周围的环境吧？

home.captionEn: Ugh, my back and legs are all sore... Commander, hang in there a bit longer for my sake, alright? I'm done for... I need to rest first...
home.caption: 呜，腰和腿都好酸……指挥官，你再努力一会！我不行了，我先休息一下……

login.captionEn: Almost got it... Huh? Commander, what are you doing here all of a sudden? Hey, get back here, you dumb bird! Now look what you did! It got away because of you! Ughhh, why is this even happening?!
login.caption: 就差一点了……等下，指挥官，你怎么突然来了！啊，又给它跑掉了！……我也没有怪你啦！哎，怎么会这样……

mail.captionEn: Why's there a letter addressed to you in a place like this? Did you misplace it or something?
mail.caption: 为什么这里会有指挥官你的信件……是不小心落下的吗？

main_1.captionEn: Ying! Swei! I know you're behind all this, so get these little guys to knock it off already!
main_1.caption: 应！瑞！我知道是你搞的鬼，快让这小家伙停下来！

main_2.captionEn: Commander, um... Can you try to make things less awkward? You know, the two of us hiding under a table like this, umm... might cause some serious misunderstandings...
main_2.caption: 指挥官，那个……说点什么缓解下尴尬吧？两个人趴在桌子底下，会，会招来奇怪的误解的……

main_3.captionEn: I wonder how the decorations for the other parts of the port are coming along... Huh? You've already taken care of everything? W-wow, you're pretty reliable, huh...
main_3.caption: 不知道港区里其它地方装饰得怎样了……欸，你说你都已经安排好了？你还挺可靠的嘛！

touch_body.captionEn: I, I didn't touch you on purpose, okay? I'm sorry! It's all because this little bugger here made me do it...
touch_body.caption: 我，我不是故意要碰到你的，对不起！都怪这小家伙和应瑞……

touch_special.captionEn: Y-y-y-y-y-you pervert! I can't believe you'd take advantage of another person's misery like this...!
touch_special.caption: 你你你你这乘人之危的坏家伙！呜呜……
